parōṭāvil naṭanta āl-intiya caṅkīta kāṉpareṉs aṅkaṇattiṉarkaḷukku.
	1916-m varuṭam mārccu mātam 20-m tētiyil Indian Music eṉṟa talaippiṉkīḻ ‘parōṭā kāṉpareṉs’ eṉṟa tuvakkattuṭaṉ Mr.E.Clements, I.C.S., turaiyavarkaḷ Madras Mailš l eḻutiya viyācattaip pārvaiyiṭṭēṉ. itil “All India Music Conference”l naṭantavaikaḷaik kuṟittuc colvatākat terikiṟatu. cāstira viṣayamāka naṭakkum oru periya capaiyiṉ cārām cattai taṅkaḷ taṅkaḷ aṟivukku eṭṭiya vitam palar pala vitamāy eḻutuvatu vaḻakkameṉṟu nām aṟivōm. capaiyil naṭanta viṣayaṅkaḷil intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum curaṅkaḷ curutikaḷ iṉṉavaiyeṉpatum avaikaḷai ellōrum vaḻaṅkakkūṭiya vitamāy Staff notation-l kuṟippatu eppaṭi eṉpatumē mukkiyamāṉavai. ivviṣayattaip paṟṟic cila kuṟippukaḷaic colla virumpukiṟēṉ.
intiya caṅkītattil iṉṉiṉṉa curutikaḷ vaḻaṅka vēṇṭumeṉpataip paṟṟiyum avaṟṟiṉ kaṇakkukaḷaip paṟṟiyum cāraṅkar muṟaippaṭi Mr.Clements avarkaḷ tām putitākac ceyta ārmōṉiyam vācittu mika virivāka viyākkiyāṉam paṇṇiṉārkaḷ. curaṅkaḷukkuḷḷa oṟṟumaiyaik kaṇita mūlamākavum ataṉ ōcaiyai ārmōṉiyam mūlamākavum eṭuttuk kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ.
Mr.Deval  avarkaḷ Mr.Clements avarkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyattai viḷakkik kāṭṭuvataṟkup pala pustakaṅkaḷum piṉ mutaliya vāttiyak karuvikaḷum koṇṭu vantu vācittuk kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ.
ivarkaḷukkup purōkirāmil kuṟitta nēram pōka maṟṟum mīṟṟiṅ naṭanta ovvoru nāḷ kālai mālaikaḷilum taṅkaḷ apippirāyattiṟku māṟupaṭṭu varumpōtellām pēcukiṟataṟku iṭam tārāḷamāyk koṭukkap paṭṭirukkiṟatu.
ivarkaḷ curutiyaip paṟṟic collum apippirāyaṅkaḷai Mr.Bhatkandi mutaliya cilar oppukkoḷḷāmaiyiṉāl nimiṣattiṟku nimiṣam āṭcē paṉaikaḷ tōṉṟik kēṭpavarkaḷukku iṉpamākac campāṣaṇai naṭantu vantatu. pantayattil ōṭum kutiraikaḷil etu jeyikkumeṉṟu pantaya vaṭṭattaic cuṟṟi anēkar āvalāy vēṭikkaip pārppatu pōlavē caṅkīta cāstirattil mukkiyamāṉa curutikaḷaip paṟṟi eppaṭi muṭivu aṭaiyu meṉṟu pala kaṉavāṉkaḷum caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷum āvalāyk kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. ippaṭippaṭṭa vātaṅkaḷuṇṭākāmaṟ pōṉāl cāstira viṣayamāka jaṉaṅkaḷ yāvarum potuvāy aṉupavikkakkūṭiya oru nalla muṭivu kiṭaikkamāṭṭā teṉṟu nām aṟivōm. kāṉpareṉs kūṭiya pala nāḷkaḷil pala camayaṅkaḷilum ivviṣayam aṭuttaṭuttup pēcappaṭṭatu.
itaittavira intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum curutikaḷaip paṟṟi eṉṉāl 22-m tēti muṟpakalil cumār 33/4 maṇi nēram varaikkum viyācam paṭittum aṉupava pūrvamāka vīṇaiyil vācittum vāyiṉāl pāṭiyum kāṭṭappaṭṭatu. mutalil caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟaippaṭic ceytirukki ṟōmeṉṟu coṉṉa palar avar colliya muṟaippaṭic ceyyāmal ca-pa 2/3,  ca-ma 3/4 eṉṟu paitākōras colliya piṉṉak kaṇakkiṉ muṟaippaṭic curuti kaṇṭu piṭippatu cariyāṉa muṟaiyalla veṉṟum caṅkīta ratṉākarar paratar ippaṭic collavillai eṉṟum caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟaippaṭi ca-pa 13, ca-ma 9 curutikaḷai yuṭaiyatāy varum poḻutu 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa aḷavuppaṭi varavillai eṉṟum kaṇakkukaḷum mēṟkōḷkaḷum collic caṅkīta ratṉākararuṭaiya tuvāvimcati curuti muṟaiyum 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa muṟaiyiṉpaṭi maṟṟavarkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkum curuti muṟaiyum caṅkīta cāstirattiṟkum nam aṉupōkattilirukkum vāyppāṭṭiṟkum orukkālum ottuvarāteṉṟu yāvarum aṟiyumpaṭi viyācam vācittu viḷakkappaṭṭatu.
iraṇṭāvatāka iṟṟaikku 1850 varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉ atāvatu mutal nūṟṟāṇṭilirunta iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ eḻutiya cilappatikārattiṉ utaviyaik koṇṭum iṟṟaikkuc cumār 8000 varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉ mutal ūḻiyiṉ kaṭaiciyil teṉ maturaiyil (aḻintu pōṉa lemūriyāvil) āṇṭu koṇṭirunta cayamākīrttiyaṉākiya nilantarutiruviṟ pāṇṭiyaṉ avai yattu ataṅkōṭṭācāṉ muṉṉilaiyil mutaṟ caṅkattiṉ kaṭaiciyil araṅkēṟṟappaṭṭa tolkāppiyattiṉ utaviyiṉālum pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ icaittamiḻp payiṟciyil avarkaḷ kaṇṭu amaittirunta ariya viṣayaṅkaḷ cila collappaṭṭaṉa. atil avarkaḷ oru stāyiyil ca-pa, ca-ma muṟaiyāy 12 curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭu piṭittu yāḻil amaittuk kāṉam ceytu vantārkaḷeṉṟum kiraka curam māṟṟum poḻutu vevvēṟu vitamāṉa 12000 irākaṅkaḷ uṇṭākki yiruntārkaḷeṉṟum collappaṭṭatu. iraṇṭāvatu paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷaiyum paṉṉiraṇṭāṉa irāci vaṭṭattil ca-pa muṟai yāy vala vōṭṭamāka ēḻāvatu ēḻāvatu irāciyākap paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷ porunti varum muṟaiyaiyum appaṭiyē iṭa vōṭṭāka aintāvatu aintāvatu irāciyāka 12 curaṅkaḷ porunti varum muṟaiyaiyum colli rukkiṟārkaḷ. ovvoru irāciyum iraṇṭu iraṇṭu alakākap pirikkappaṭṭu atil viḷari kaikkiḷaiyil ovvoru alaku kuṟaittu 22 curutiyil kāṉam ceytārkaḷ. iṉṉiṉṉa curaṅkaḷ kuṟaittuk kāṉam paṇṇappaṭuvatu eṉpataṟku nāṉkuvita yāḻ muṟaikaḷum avaikaḷ ovvoṉṟil nālu jāti vakaikaḷum coṉṉārkaḷ.
immuṟai vaḻakkattilillāmaṟ pōṉa kālattil 5-m nūṟṟāṇṭi lirunta paratarum 13-m nūṟṟāṇṭilirunta caṅkīta ratṉākararum caṅkīta nūlkaḷ eḻutiṉārkaḷ. oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu ivarkaḷ coṉṉatāṉatu mikavum mayaṅkak kūṭiya ōr iṭaṟu kallāyiṟṟu. itōṭu paitākōras ca-pa 2/3, ca-ma 3/4 eṉṟu coṉṉa aḷavum cērntu taṟkālattiluṇṭākum viparītattiṟkuk kāraṇamāyiṟṟu eṉṟu viḷakkic collappaṭṭatu. mūṉṟāvatu ovvoru alakaiyum 1/2 alakāyp pirittu tirikōṇappālai eṉṟum 1/2 alakaik kāl alakākap pirittuc caturap pālai eṉṟum nāl vita pālaikaḷil pūrva kālattu irākaṅkaḷ pāṭap paṭṭu vantaṉa eṉṉum viṣayam vivarittukkāṭṭappaṭṭatu. nālāvatu āyap pālai, vaṭṭappālai, tirikōṇappālai, caturappālai eṉṉum nālu pālai kaḷil pāṭappaṭṭu varum irākaṅkaḷil 67 irākaṅkaḷukku aṭṭavaṇaiyum curastāṉaṅkaḷum utāraṇamākak koṭukkappaṭṭaṉa. itōṭu 12 araic curaṅ kaḷukkum 24 āṉa kāl curaṅkaḷukkum 48 āṉa araikkāl curaṅkaḷukkum 96 āṉa vīcam curaṅkaḷukkum Geometrical Progression paṭi piṉṉa eṇkaḷum vaiparēṣaṉ kaṇakkum tantinīḷattiṉ kaṇakkum ceṇṭs kaṇakkum koṭukkappaṭṭu viḷakkik kāṭṭappaṭṭatu.
nālu vitamāṉa pālaikaḷil koṭukkappaṭṭa aṭṭavaṇaikaḷiluḷḷa irākaṅkaḷil capaiyōr virumpiya irākaṅkaḷ pāṭik kāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. aṅkē kūṭiyirunta karnāṭaka caṅkītattil pāṇṭittiyamuḷḷa vitvāṉkaḷum vaṭa nāṭṭil pala iṭaṅkaḷiliruntu vanta pala intustāṉi vitvāṉkaḷum mika amailatāy veku cantōṣattuṭaṉ kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. utayappūr caṅkīta vitvāṉāṉa cākruṭīṉ cāyap eṉpavar oru stāyiyil 24 curutikaḷai vīṇaiyil vācikkum poḻutu vīṇaiyōṭu kūṭavē tāṉum pāṭi mikunta piriyattuṭaṉ oppuk koṇṭār. vīṇaiyiṉ utavi yillāmal oru stāyiyil varum 24 curutikaḷaiyum eṉatu kumārattikaḷ marakatavalli ammāḷum (Mrs. Duraipandian) kaṉakavalli ammāḷum (Mrs. Navamoney) pāṭik kāṭṭiyapōtu caṅkītattiṟkē putiya ulakam tōṉṟi yirukkiṟateṉṟum, curutiyaip paṟṟi vicārikka vēṇṭiya kavalai iṉṟōṭu oḻintatu eṉṟum, iṉimēl curutikaḷaip paṟṟip pēcuvatu avaciyamillai eṉṟum, iṉṉiṉṉavarkaḷiṉ curutimuṟai iṉṟōṭu pātāḷattil taḷḷappaṭṭateṉṟum, ippaṭip palavitamāyk koṇṭāṭik kaikaḷaik koṭṭi āravārittārkaḷ. caṅkītattil atikat tērcciyum nuṭpa aṟivumuṭaiya Atiya Begam Fyzee Rahimin ammāḷum ivviṣayattai naṉṟāyk kavaṉikkumpaṭiyāka Mr. kiḷameṇṭsaiyum, Mr. paṭkaṇṭi avarkaḷaiyum vīṇaikkuc camīpattilirukkum paṭiyākac ceytārkaḷ. nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷil varum pala kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ pāṭi muṭintavuṭaṉ itil ētāvatu āṣcēpaṉai yirukkumāṉāl collak kūṭiyavarkaḷ colla vēṇṭu meṉṟu ellōrum aṟiyumpaṭik kēṭkappaṭṭatu. evarum evvitamāṉa āṣcē paṉaiyum collavillai. tuvāvimcati curutiyiṉ āṭcēpam itōṭu oḻintu viṭṭateṉṟum curutikaḷaip paṟṟi ivaikaḷ pōtu meṉṟum curutikaḷaip paṟṟi iṉimēl vicārikka vēṇṭiyatillai eṉṟum palar palamukamāyc collak kūṭṭam muṭintatu.
itaṉpiṉ 23-m tētiyil ivaikaḷ yāvum kēḷvippaṭṭa His Highness the Maharaja  avarkaḷ tirumpa ivaikaḷaip paṟṟit tāmum makārāṇi avarkaḷum kēṭkap piriyappaṭṭavarkaḷāy Mr.Clements, Mr.Bhatkandi, President Nawab Ali Khan, His Excellency V.P.Madhava Rao, Mr.Fyzee Rahimin, Mr. Sundra Pandiarn, Mrs. Atya Begum Fyzee Rahimin, Mrs. Abraham Pandither,  makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷ, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi N.P.cuppiramaṇiya aiyar avarkaḷ ākiya ivarkaḷ māttiram kūṭiya capaimuṉ eṉṉaiyum eṉ kuḻantaikaḷaiyum varavaḻaittu muntiṉa nāḷil naṭantavaikaḷaippaṟṟic curukkamākac colliyum pāṭiyum kāṭṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟu kēṭṭuk koṇṭārkaḷ.
appōtu pūrva tamiḻiṉ ciṟappum tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ caṅkītattiṉ uyarvum, avarkaḷ nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷil kāṉam ceytu vanta muṟaiyum, maṟaipaṭṭut tuvāvimcati curuti eṉṟa muṟaiyiṉālum 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa muṟai yiṉālum kalakkaṅkoṇṭa ikkālattil makā rājā avarkaḷ ēṟpaṭuttiya intak kāṉpareṉs mikunta pirayōjaṉattait tarum eṉṟum tolkāppiyamākiya pūrva tamiḻ nūlai iṅkilīṣil moḻi peyarkkac ceytirukkiṟa makā rājā avarkaḷ nīṭuḻi vāḻntirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟum pirārttikkappaṭṭatu.
2/3, 3/4 eṉṟu perukkip pōkum aḷavil varum curaṅkaḷum oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ eṉṟu collum curaṅkaḷum oru nāḷum nammuṭaiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki vantatillaiyeṉṟum iṉimēlum vaḻaṅki varakkūṭiyavaikaḷ allaveṉṟum pūrva tamiḻ nūl apippirāyap paṭiyum caṅkīta ratṉākarar apippirāyappaṭiyum Geometrical Progression eṉṟa vaḻiyāyk kaṇikkum kaṇakkē caṅkītattil varum curutikaḷaiyum kaṇakku kaḷaiyum kaṇṭupiṭippataṟku aṉukūlamāyirukkumeṉṟum curukkamākavum teḷivāyum pattu nimiṣattiṟkuḷḷākac collappaṭṭatu.
ataṉpiṉ karnāṭaka irākaṅkaḷil cila kīrttaṉaṅkaḷum oru stāyi yil varum 24 curutikaḷum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷumuḷḷa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷum cumār 3/4 maṇi nēram pāṭik kāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. makārājā avarkaḷum makārāṇi avarkaḷum mikunta cantōṣappaṭṭut taṅkaḷ naṉṟiyaṟitalaic coṉṉārkaḷ.
	itōṭu curam curutikaḷaip paṟṟi viyācam vācippōr aṉupavattil pāṭi rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟum appaṭi rucup paṭuttāta viyācaṅkaḷ pirayōjaṉa maṟṟavaiyākum eṉṟum kāṉpareṉs naṭappataṟku muṉṉālēyē Mr. V.N.Bhatkandi avarkaḷukkuk kaṭitam eḻuti yiruntēṉ. atil 22m tēti curutikaḷai rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭum poḻutu pāṭikkāṭṭāmal curutikaḷaip paṟṟic collum vārttaikaḷ pirayōjaṉa maṟṟavaiyākum iṉimēl curuti curaṅkaḷaip paṟṟic collum poḻutu pāṭi aṉupavattiṟkuk kāṭṭiṉāl capaiyōrukkup pirayōjaṉamāyirukkum eṉṟu colliyirukkiṟēṉ. itupōlavē 23m tēti piṟpakalil Mr.Clements curutikaḷaip paṟṟic collumpoḻutu caṅkīta ratṉākarar tuvāvimcati curuti muṟaippaṭic ceytu koṇṭu vanta ārmōṉiyattil varum curaṅkaḷ aṉupōkattil pāṭikkoṇṭirukkum curaṅkaḷukkuc cariyāyirukkiṉṟaṉavā eṉṟu ārāycci ceyyappaṭavēṇṭumeṉṟu kēṭṭukkoḷḷappaṭṭatu. utayappūr cākrūṭīṉ cāyapum maṟṟum camastāṉa vitvāṉkaḷum pāṭik kāṭṭiya karakarappiriyā allatu kāpi mutaliya irākaṅkaḷiṉ curaṅkaḷukku Mr. kiḷameṇṭs turaiyavarkaḷ koṇṭu vanta ārmōṉiyattiṉ curaṅkaḷ mikak kuṟaintirukkiṟatāka aṅku vantirunta Music Conference memparkaḷālum piraciṭeṇṭ Mr. Thakur Nawab Ali Khan avarkaḷālum tīrmāṉikkappaṭṭatu. itōṭu curutikaḷaip paṟṟic collum cūttiraṅkaḷiṉ arttaṅkaḷ cariyāyillai eṉṟu vātam naṭantu tērcci peṟṟa camaskiruta vitvāṉkaḷāl cariyāṉa arttam collappaṭṭuc cantēkamum tīrkkap paṭṭatu.
palamuṟai vācittuk kāṭṭiyum kaṭaiciyil tām koṇṭu vantirunta ārmōṉiyattiṉ curaṅkaḷ kuṟaintirukkiṟataik kaṇṭu Mr. Clements atai oppuk koṇṭār. atōṭu avaruṭaiya curuti ārmoṉiyattiṉ vivakāram oruvāṟu muṭintatu. itu kāṉpareṉs kūṭiya nāṭkaḷil atika nērattai yum anēkam peyaruṭaiya āṣcēpaṉai camātāṉaṅkaḷaiyu muṭaiyatā yiruntatiṉālum caṅkīta ratṉākarariṉ tuvāvimcati curuti muṟaippaṭic ceyyappaṭṭiruntatiṉālum itai āṣēpikkiṟavarkaḷ cilar iruntati ṉālum caṅkīta cāstirattai vicārikkum capaiyil itu mukkiyamāṉa teṉṟu nāṉ niṉaikkiṟēṉ. itai uḷḷatu uḷḷapaṭi kāṉpareṉsiṉ piraciṭeṇṭu Nawab Ali Khan avarkaḷum kāṉpareṉsiṉ ellāk kāriyaṅkaḷaiyum naṭatti vanta His Excellency V.P.Madhava Rao avarkaḷum maṟṟum Musical Conference memparkaḷ yāvarum aṟivārkaḷ. ivviṣayattaippaṟṟi          Mr. Clements colli yiruppārāṉāl mika naṉṟāyirukkum.

V.N.BHATKANDE Esq., B.A., L.L.B.,
Santaram House, Malabar Hil, Bombay.
MY DEAR RAO SAHIB PANDITHER,
It is a practically long time since we separated at Baroda and I think I ought to take up my correspondence with you once more in my own interest. I may sincerely tell you that your great labours and scholarship very nearly stunned me. I shall be always proud of having the privilege of calling you my friend. I may or may not agree with all your views but that will never prevent me from always bearing in mind the fact that you are a great Music scholar. I am so thankful to Dewan Saheb that he brought us together. I shall certainly not fail to derive considerable benefit from your labours. I have to thank you most sincerely for coming to my help in hitting that mischievous sruti harmonium movment on the head in time. It had very nearly turned the heads of several of our workers here. Mr. Deval had almost persuaded the educational authorities of this presidency to introduce the Harmonium as a compulsory accompaniment in our schools. But for you I should not have been able to make my poor voice heard. You disposed of Deval’s Sharangdev’s srutis like a miracle.
Your exposition has however brought to light one fact and that is likely to disappoint all the present music enthusiasts here. I am referring to that part of your book where you say or rather point out- that with the exception of the sa and its octave, none of the intermediate notes will exactly correspond with any of our modern notes. You go on to say again that all attempts at reviving Sarangadev’s music is bound to be a failure. This conclusion of yours seems to be of tremendous importance.
Yours Sincerely,
(Sd.) V.N.BHATKANDE.
eṉatu piriyamuḷḷa rāv cāhēp paṇṭitaravarkaḷukku,
nām parōṭāvil oruvarai yoruvar viṭṭuppirintu vekukālamāki viṭṭapaṭiyāl eṉṉuṭaiya cuyakāriyattiṟkākavē nāṉ tirumpa taṅkaḷukku eḻutuvatu avaciyamāyt tōṉṟukiṟatu. caṅkītattiṟkākat tāṅkaḷ ceyta vēlaiyum taṅkaḷ kalvit tiṟamaiyum eṉakku atipiramippai uṇṭu paṇṇiṉa. taṅkaḷai eppōtum eṉ cinēkitareṉṟu aḻaikkum cilākkiya māṉatu eṉakku atika perumai. caṅkīta viṣayamāyt tāṅkaḷ collum apippirāyaṅkaḷai nāṉ cariyeṉṟu oppuk koṇṭālum, oppuk koḷḷāviṭṭālum tāṅkaḷ caṅkītattil vitvāṉ eṉkiṟa caṅkatiyāṉatu eppōtu eṉ maṉatil irukkum. nammiruvaruṭaiya cinēkattiṟkum kāraṇarā yirunta Dewan Saheb avarkaḷukku vantaṉam collukiṟēṉ. taṅkaḷuṭaiya vēlaiyiṉ palaṉiliruntu nāṉ atika payaṉ aṭaivēṉ eṉpataṟkuc cantēkamillai. takka camayam pārttut tāṅkaḷ eṉakku utaviyāy vantu anēka keṭutikaḷ ceytu vanta curuti ārmōṉiyak koḷkaiyiṉ talaiyai uṭaittataṟkāka atika naṉṟiyaṟitaluḷḷavaṉāyirukkiṟēṉ. caṅkīta viṣayattil iṅku uḻaikkum anēkaruṭaiya irutayattai inta curuti ārmōṉiyam koḷḷai koṇṭu pōyviṭṭatu. Mr. tēvāl avarkaḷ inta rājatāṉiyiluḷḷa paḷḷikkūṭaṅkaḷil inta curuti ārmōṉiyattaik kaṭṭāyamāy upayōkappaṭuttumpaṭi kalācālai atipatikaḷai ēṟakkuṟaiya cammatikkap paṇṇiviṭṭārkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ eṉ utavikku varātiruntāl eṉṉuṭaiya cattam vaṉāntarattil taṉiyāyk kiṭantu kattukiṟavaṉuṭaiya cattam pōlāyirukkumē. Mr. tēvāl avarkaḷuṭaiya cāraṅkatēva curuti kaḷait tāṅkaḷ aṟputamāṉa vitamāy māyttu viṭṭīrkaḷ.
	āṉāl tāṅkaḷ collum apippirāyattil oru vicēṣa māṉatu iṅkirukkum caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷukku mikavum atairiyattai uṇṭākkukiṟatu. ateṉṉaveṉṟāl, cāraṅkatēvar muṟaippaṭi oru stāyiyil ṣaṭjamattaiyum atiṉ eṭṭāvatu curamākiya ṣaṭjamattaiyum tavira naṭuvil varum enta curamāvatu taṟkālattil vaḻaṅkum curaṅkaḷukku ottuvarātu eṉṟu colluvatutāṉ. cāraṅkatēvaruṭaiya caṅkītattait tirumpa eṭuttu niṟuttuvatu kūṭāta kāriyameṉṟum tāṅkaḷ collu kiṟīrkaḷ. inta muṭivāṉa vārttaiyāṉatu atika vicēṣamāṉa oru caṅkati.
taṅkaḷiṉ uṇmaiyuḷḷa,
(Sd.) V.N.BHATKANDE
15
LAKSHMIPURAM. 
Mysore, 10-8-1916

DEAR SIR,
In your Tamil letter of invitation, I was glad to find that you are going again to settle the question of Srutis. I heartily support your contention that Sharanga Dev was inaccurate in many respects, and that your exposition was most convincing. I appreciate only 3 or 4 papers that were presented in that Baroda Conference and yours was the most interesting to me of all. Those of Messrs. Clements and Deval were also learned, but the theories did not agree with their practical demonstrations.
I agree to your division of the octave into 24 srutis and their demonstration through the help of your accomplished daughters. I am sure that the different notes used for the Ragas as expounded by you are correct. Only I am not yet prepared to admit the accuracy of their number of Vibration. It is my desire to call in the aid of a practical scientist in physics and get the Vibrations of notes tested. I have expressed this idea before V.P.Madhava Rao Esq. who has approved of the proposal and if the Baroda Conference meets again I will induce the audience to have recourse to this arrangement. Can you not take up this suggestion?
If any thing was striking to me in the Baroda Conference, it was your paper and I have made a short reference to it in my book “The Psychology of Music” which will be out in a week or so.
Wishing success to your earnest attempts.
Yours truly,
(Sd.) H.P.KRISHNA RAO.
lakṣimi puram
maicūr, 10-8-1916.
piriyamuḷḷa aiyā,
tāṅkaḷ eṉṉaik kāṉpareṉsukku aḻaitta (tamiḻil eḻutap paṭṭirunta) kaṭitattil kaṇṭapirakāram curuti viṣayattaip paṟṟit tirumpa vicārikkappōkiṟōm eṉṟu eḻutiyiruntatu eṉakku metta cantōṣam. cāraṅkatēvar pala viṣayaṅkaḷil picakippōyirukkiṟār eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ colvatai nāṉ maṉappūrvamāy oppukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ. tāṅkaḷ caṅkīta viṣayattai vistarittatāṉatu ellāruṭaiya maṉatilum naṉṟāyppaṭṭatu. parōṭā kāṉpareṉcil vācikkappaṭṭa upanniyācaṅkaḷil mūṉṟu allatu nālu viyācaṅkaḷ tāṉ eṉakku atika vicēṣamāṉavaikaḷāka eṉ maṉatil paṭṭatu. avaikaḷil taṅkaḷuṭaiyatu tāṉ ellāvaṟṟilum mēlāka eṉakkut tiruptikarattai uṇṭākkukiṟatu. Mr.kiḷamaṇṭs, tēvāl mutaliya varkaḷuṭaiya upanniyācaṅkaḷ atikak kalvit tiṟamaiyaik kāṭṭiṉa pōtilum avarkaḷuṭaiya muṟaikaḷ vāttiyaṅkaḷiṉ rucuvōṭu ottirukka villai.
oru stāyiyai tāṅkaḷ 24 cama pākaṅkaḷākap piritta muṟai yaiyum taṅkaḷuṭaiya ciṟappu vāynta kalvit tiṟamaiyuḷḷa kumārattikaḷiṉ utavi yāl tāṅkaḷ atai rucuppaṭuttiyataiyum cariyeṉṟu oppuk koḷḷu kiṟēṉ. pala irākaṅkaḷil varuvatākat tāṅkaḷ kāṇpitta curaṅkaḷ cari yeṉpataṟkuc cantēkamillai. āṉāl antac curaṅkaḷiṉ ōcai alai kaḷaip paṟṟi māttiram eṉakkuk koñcam cantēkamuṇṭu. iyaṟkai cāstirattil tēṟiya oru nipuṇariṉ utaviyāl antac curaṅkaḷiṉ ōcai alaikaḷaic cōtittup pārkka vēṇṭumeṉṟa ācai eṉakkuṇṭu. nāṉ itu viṣayattaip paṟṟi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi ē.ña.mātavarāv avarkaḷiṭattil pirastāpittirukkiṟēṉ. avarkaḷ atai aṅkīkarittatumallāmal, iṉṉoru parōṭā kāṉpareṉs kūṭum paṭcattil intavita ārāycci ceyvataṟku vitvāṉkaḷuṭaṉ oḻuṅku ceyvatākavum vākkaḷittārkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ itu viṣayattaip paṟṟic ciramam eṭuttuk koḷḷakkūṭātā?
parōṭā kāṉpareṉsil eṉ maṉatil atikamāyp paṭṭatu taṅkaḷ upanniyācantāṉ. nāṉ eḻutiyirukkum “Psychology of Music” eṉṟa puttakattil itaippaṟṟi vicēṣamāyc colliyirukkiṟēṉ. intap pustakam oru vārattukkuḷ anēkamāy veḷiyākum.

itil teṉṉintiyāviṉ caṅkīta viṣayamāka itteṉṉāṭṭil viḷaṅkum cila paṇṭitarkaḷukku aṟivikkappaṭṭatu. atil tañcai nakara vāci yāṉa rāv cāhēp, K. āpirakām paṇṭitar avarkaḷukkum aṟivikkap paṭṭatu.
௸tañcai mānakaril cila varuṣakālamāy ēṟpaṭṭuḷḷa caṅkīta samājattai naṭatti atil cērnta talaivarkaḷilum oruvarāṉa srī paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kēṭṭuk koḷḷutaluk kicaintu oru kāṉpareṉsil piraciṭeṇṭu stāṉattai vahitta tivāṉ mātavarāyaravarkaḷ accamayam pēciyatil mahā rājākkaḷāl naṭattappaṭṭum naṭattakkūṭiyatumāṉa ip peruṅkāriyattai misṭar paṇṭitaravarkaḷ vahittuk koṇṭu naṭatti varuvataip paṟṟi nāṉ mikavum meccik koḷḷukiṟēṉeṉṟum ellā vittaikaḷukkum uṟaiviṭamāyirunta ittañcai camastāṉattil, caṅkīta vittaiyum kṣīṇittu viṭāmal ivvita caṅkamoṉṟai ēṟpaṭutti caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷai ātarikkiṟa avaruṭaiya ceyalāṉatu anta vittaiyait tirumpa uyirppikkum eṉpatil cantēkamillai yeṉṟum caṅkaṅkaḷ palar kūṭi ceyya vēṇṭiya vēlai eṉṟu teḷivāy viḷaṅkak kūṭiyateṉṟum caṅkītak kaḷañciyam eṉṟu pēr vāṅkiya ittañcai mānakaril stāpikkap paṭavum ataṉāl iccaṅkam nilaittiruntu nalla peyar vāṅkavum kaṭavuḷai nōkkip pirārttikkiṟēṉ eṉṟum nalla maṉatuṭaṉ collap paṭṭirukkiṟatu.
ākaiyāl ittañcai mānakaraiyum rāv cāhēp paṇṭitaravarkaḷai yum ñāpakattil vaittiruppavarātalāl taṉatu rājyattil naṭattappaṭum ellā intiya caṅkīta kāṉpareṉsukku namatu paṇṭitaravarkaḷum avaciyam varavēṇṭumeṉṟu karuti avarkaḷiṭamiruntu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi paṇṭitar avarkaḷukku aḻaippup pattiram aṉuppappaṭṭatu.

61/2 maṇi mutal 91/2 maṇi varaiyil ammāṇavarkaḷ iruvarum veku cuṟu cuṟuppāy naṭantu oru nimiṣamum iḷaippāṟāmal upacaritta ivarkaḷatu upakārattai niṉaikkum pōtu evvaḷavu jaṉmattilum maṟakka muṭiyāta viṣayam eṉṟu ivarkaḷaiyum, ivarkaḷai ēviya pātiriyār avarkaḷaiyum pativu ceyyappaṭṭatu. uṭaṉē vaṇṭiyum puṟappaṭṭatu.
cantirapakavāṉ nāṉ kāṭṭukiṟa kākṣiyaik kāṇak kaṇṇayara vēṇṭām eṉṟār. pakal kaṇṭataṟku itu kaṇkākṣi yeṉṟu niṉaittu viḻittiruntōm. rayil vaṇṭiyāṉatu oru iruṭṭaṟaiyil pukuntu veḷip paṭṭatu. aṅkup pārttāl oru pakkam malaiyiṉ uyarcciyum oru pakkam paḷḷattākkum iruppatum itaṉaṭuvē vaṇṭi pōvatum pārkka iccamayam mittiraṉ utaviyiruntāl, kaṇkākṣi vistāramāyirukkum. ākilum itu kaṇ paṭaittavarkaḷukku vittaitāṉ pōṉṟu kaḷiyuṟṟōm. ivvāṟu pala kukaikaḷil vaṇṭi piravēcittup pōkumpōtu karmapācattiṉāl iḻukkap paṭum jīvaṉ karppavācamum, veḷiyēṟuvatumāṉa ceykaipōl tōṟṟiyatu. piṟaku pampāy sṭēṣaṉaik kaṇṭōm. viyappuṟṟu tikaittōm. vikṭōriyā eṉṉum vaṇṭiyil koñca tūram māṭa māḷikaiyuḷḷa vītikaḷiṉ vaḻiyē ceṉṟu maṟṟōr sṭēṣaṉil parōṭāvukkuc cellum vaṇṭiyil amarntōm. kālai 7 maṇikku vaṇṭi puṟappaṭṭatu. 9 maṇi varaiyil pampāyp paṭṭaṇattait tāṇṭiyatākat teriyavillai. piṟaku oru sṭēṣaṉil varumpoḻutu nāṅkaḷ inta vaṇṭiyil puṟappaṭṭu varuvatai parōṭā tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātavarāyar avarkaḷukku oru tanti mūlamāyt terivittuk koḷḷappaṭṭatu. aṉṟu mālai aintu maṇi varaiyil mutal nāḷaippōl paḻam, pāltāṉ ākāram.
5 maṇikku parōṭā sṭēṣaṉ vantapōtu tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātavarāyar avarkaḷāl aṉuppappaṭṭa araṇmaṉai utyōkastarkaḷum pala vēlaikkārarkaḷumāṉa anēkar kūṭiyiruntārkaḷ. sapta curam pōluḷḷa vārattil ēḻāvatu vāramāṉa stira vārattil vikruti curam pōluḷḷa 5 maṇi vēḷaiyil pirakiruti vikruti pētaṅkaḷāl pala irākaṅkaḷ uṇṭākiṉṟaṉa eṉpataik kāṭṭuvatupōl anēka jaṉaṅkaḷ rāv cāhēp paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṭam anurākattōṭu ceṉṟu ātaravuṭaṉ iṉimaiyāy kai īntu upacarittu ūṭāṭi ellōrum ēṟṟamuṭaṉ aikkiya māy oṟṟumaippaṭṭu ōtiya seḷajaṉyam ataik kaṇṭu kaḷiyātāraik kāṇakkiṭaittōmillai.
uṭaṉē mōṭṭār kārilum iraṭṭaippuravi vaṇṭiyilum oṟṟaik kutirai pīṭṭaṉilumceṉṟu intiyaṉ kesṭu havus eṉṟa māṭakūṭam tōpput turavukaḷaṭaṅkiya ōr perutta viṭutiyil, caukariyamāy vācam ceyya iṭamaḷittu utaviṉārkaḷ.
vācastala vicēṭam.
oru pakkattil pirāmāṇarkaḷukkup pōjaṉam tayārākiṟatu. maṟṟōr pakkattil vennīr kāyntu koṇṭu cīkkiram snāṉam ceyyuṅkaḷ eṉṟu tūṇṭukiṟatu. maṟṟōr aṟaiyil paḻamum, pālum piskōttum nāṅkaḷ iṅku vacikkiṟōm nīṅkaḷ niṉaittapōtu utavuvōm eṉṟaṉa. miṉcāra viḷakkukaḷ iṭai iṭaiyē paḻaṅkaḷ pōl toṅki, nāṅkaḷ illāta iṭam irāveṉṟaṉa. kāṟṟillāviṭattil kāṟṟāṭi nāṉ upacarippēṉ eṉkiṟatu. ippaṭiyāka niṉaittatai aṉupavikkak koṭukkum navaniti pōlum āvalai aṭakkum tēvalōkampōlum viḷaṅki maṉa makiḻcciyaik koṭuttatāl snāṉam, tiyāṉam, pūjai, pōjaṉam ivaikaḷai vaḻuvaṟa naṭatti tūratēcap pirayāṇaciramattai iḷaippāṟi iruntu veṉṟōm.
maṟunāḷ ātivāram tōṉṟiyatu. aṉṟu kālai tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātava rāyar avarkaḷum maṟṟa upasātakarkaḷuṭaṉ tōṉṟi vēṇṭiya caukariyaṅkaḷaip paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṭam vicārittu iruppatupōka illātataṟku ēviṉārkaḷ.
maṟunāḷ mutal naṭakkappōkum kāṉpareṉsukku vanta pala tēcattavarkaḷum taṅkuvataṟku anēka jākaikaḷ amarttap paṭṭirunta pōtilum itutāṉ taṅkaḷukku caukariyamāyuḷḷatu eṉṟum aṟivittār.
kāṉpareṉs kāla aṭṭavaṇaiyil (programme) mutalāvatāṉa teyva vaṇakkattai rāv cāhēp paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ kumārikaḷāl stōt tirikkappaṭum eṉṟu eḻutappaṭṭiruntapaṭiyāl ataṟkuriya stōttirap pāṭalkaḷil etaippāṭalām eṉṟu yōcittu tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātavarāyar avarkaḷum makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pātkaṇṭē avarkaḷum, kāṉpareṉs piraciṭeṇṭ stāṉattai vakikka irukkum makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi navāp ālikkāṉ avarkaḷum, tiyākarājacuvāmi kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil mukkiyamā yuḷḷatum, urukkamāyuḷḷatum - kālattiṟkēṟṟatum hintustāṉ irākaṅkaḷil cērātatāyumuḷḷa aṭāṉā tēvakāntāri eṉṟu collap paṭum irākaṅkaḷiluḷḷa iraṇṭu kīrttaṉaikaḷaip pāṭat tīrmāṉittārkaḷ.
aṉṟu mālai tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātavarāyar avarkaḷ kirukattil ōr cap kamiṭṭi mīṟṟiṅ kūṭṭappaṭṭu ovvoru viyācattiṟkum kuṟippiṭṭirukkum kālattiṟku mēṟpaṭṭuk koñcam kāla aḷavait tara vēṇṭumeṉṟu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi harinākapūṣaṇamaiyar avarkaḷ mutalāṉa cilar vātāṭik kēṭṭuk koṇṭārkaḷ. kaṭaiciyāka srī āpirakām paṇṭitar avarkaḷāl ellā viyācaṅkaḷum purōkirāmil kaṇṭapaṭiyē kuṟitta kālattiṟkuḷ vācikkappaṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟum ataṟkēṟṟa vitamāy mukkiyamāṉa iṭaṅkaḷai māttiram vācittu muṭikka vēṇṭumeṉṟum nām nāḷaiya tiṉam naṭakka vēṇṭiya kāriyaṅkaḷai yōcikka vēṇṭumeṉṟum collappaṭṭu capaiyōr yāvarālum aṅkīkarikkappaṭṭatu.
uṭaṉē tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātavarāyaravarkaḷāl paṇṭitar avarkaḷōṭu paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ kuḻantaikaḷ evvitamāṉa caukariyat tōṭu uṭkārntu pāṭavēṇṭumō avvitam amaiyap peṟumpaṭi kāṉpareṉs hālil cīrtiruttam ceyyappaṭṭatu. atupōla maṟu nāḷ cōmavārattaṉṟu kāṉpareṉsukku vantirukkum vitvāṉkaḷum viyācakarkaḷum, pōṣakarkaḷum, ātarippōrkaḷumāṉa makājaṉaṅkaḷ kālai 5 maṇi mutalākavē snāṉa pāṉātikaḷaic ceytu koṇṭu avaravarkaḷ antastukkuriya iṭaṅkaḷil amarntārkaḷ. kaṭaiciyāka tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātavarāyar avarkaḷum capaiyirukka vēṇṭiya amaippu cariyā yuḷḷatā eṉṟu nitāṉittu viṭṭu carvamakājaṉaṅkaḷuṭaṉ makārājā avarkaḷiṉ varaviṟku etirpārttuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. koñca nāḻikaik kellām makārājā avarkaḷ varukiṟārkaḷeṉṟa aṟikuṟi kāṇappaṭṭatu.
carva jaṉaṅkaḷum āvaluṭaṉ kavaṉitta camayattil makārāṇi camētarāy makārājā avarkaḷ pracaṉṉamāṉataik kaṇṭa carva jaṉaṅkaḷum eḻuntu niṉṟu mariyātai ceyya makārājā avarkaḷum ellōraiyum kavaṉittu taṉatu stāṉattai vahittār. accamayam ōr nimiṣam varaiyil niccaptamum atiliruntu ōr piraṇava nātamum atait toṭarntu teyva vaṇakkamum paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ kuḻantaikaḷāl pāṭappaṭṭa poḻutu carva jaṉaṅkaḷiṉ maṉatum acaivaṟṟu āṉantattiṉāl muḻukap paṭṭu viṭṭatu. uṭaṉē rāja kītamum pāṭappaṭṭatu. piṟaku capai naṭuvil tivāṉ mātavarāyaravarkaḷ eḻuntu kāṉpareṉsiṉ ārampa piracaṅkam ceytu kāṉpareṉsai etōktamākat tuvakka makārājā avarkaḷiṉ anumatiyaip pirārttittārkaḷ. uṭaṉē carva jaṉaṅkaḷil karakōṣa mattiyil makārājā avarkaḷ eḻuntu niṉṟu carva vittaikaḷilum ciṟantatāṉa iccaṅkīta vittaiyai paḷḷiyil paṭikkum āṇkaḷ, peṇkaḷ mutalāy ellōrum eḷitil aṟintu pāṭumpaṭi noṭṭēṣaṉ mūlamāka oḻuṅkupaṭutti veḷippaṭuttuvataṟku ippoḻutu kūṭṭappaṭṭa iccaṅka māṉatu mikunta ātaravaḷikkum eṉṟu nampukiṟēṉ eṉṟu collik kāṉpareṉsait tiṟantu vaittār.
uṭaṉē navāp ālikkāṉ avarkaḷaip piraciṭeṇṭ stāṉattai vahikkumpaṭi ellōrum kōri āmōtikkappaṭṭu avarum anta stāṉattai vahittār. caṅkīta cāstirattai ārāycci ceytu ataṉ rakaciyaṅkaḷai nūṉmukamāy ēṟkaṉavē veḷippaṭuttiyirukkiṉṟa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pātkaṇṭē avarkaḷ caṅkīta cāstirattil vaṭamoḻiyiṉāl kūṟappaṭum kirantaṅkaḷiṉ ātāraṅkaḷaik koṇṭu tvāvimcati curutiyiṉ rakaciyattai oruvāṟu veḷiyiṭṭup pēciṉār. ippaṭiyāka avaravarkaḷ taṅkaḷ taṅkaḷ viyācaṅkaḷaik kāla aṭṭavaṇaiyiṉ pirakāram paṭittu vantārkaḷ.
௸ kāṉpareṉs ārampattil rāv cāhēp paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ puttirikaḷ caupākkiyavati marakatavalliyammāḷum, caupākkiyavati kaṉakavalli ammāḷum teyva vaṇakkamāka mutalāvatu pāṭappeṟṟatu nammellōrum cantōṣikkappaṭum viṣayam. mēlum avvitamākavē capai ārampikkum ovvoru tiṉattilum ivarkaḷaiyē pāṭac ceyya ellōruṭaiya kōrikkaiyum uṇṭāki atupōl naṭantēṟiyatum itteṉṉāṭṭuc caṅkītattiṟkum perumaiyāṉatāl ituvum mikunta cantōṣattiṟkuk kāraṇam.
kāṉpareṉsil naṭanta viṣayaṅkaḷ iṅkilīṣ pāṣaiyil naṭantatāl viparamāka aṟintu koḷḷa muṭiyavillai. ākilum ac capaiyiṉ kuṟippukaḷāl oruvāṟu aṟintu koḷḷakkūṭiyatāka iruntatu. accapaiyil mikunta celvākkai aṭaintirunta ōr makamatiya turaicāṇi Atiya Begum Fyzee Rahimin avarkaḷmaṟṟoruvaruṭaṉ pēcikkoṇṭiruntatil collappaṭṭatai pakkattilirunta eṉṉāl kēṭkappaṭṭapōtu caṅkīta viṣayam vātippatilum caṇṭaiyiṭuvatilum eṉṉa pirayōjaṉam. paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ kumarikaḷaik koñcam pāṭac coṉṉālum cukamākak kēṭkalām. poḻutō virutāvākap pōkiṟatu. us eṉṟu peru mūccu viṭṭu oruvariṭam coṉṉatai nāṉ kēṭṭēṉ. tavira potu jaṉaṅkaḷ aṭaintirunta uṟcākak kuṟaivaik koṇṭum stūlamāka kāṉpa reṉsil vācikkappaṭum viyācaṅkaḷ ivarkaḷukku sāramāka irukka villaiyō eṉṟu nāṉ niṉaikka nērntatu. ippaṭiyāka iraṇṭu nāḷ mīṭṭiṅ naṭantēṟiyatu. piṟaku mūṉṟāvatu nāḷil paṇṭitar avarkaḷālum viyācam vācikkappaṭṭatu. inta viyācattiṟku 3 maṇi nēram varaiyil kāla varaiyiruntatāl maṟṟavarkaḷaik kāṭṭilum nīṇṭakāla aḷavaip peṟṟirunta inta viyācattiṟku ēṟkaṉavē vācikkappaṭṭa viyācaṅkaḷiṉ kālattiṉ aḷavai viyācaṅkaḷukkut takkapaṭi kuṟippiṭṭirunta kālatti liruntu 5 nimiṣam 10 nimiṣam kuṟaittu muṭikkumpaṭi tūṇṭik koṇṭu vanta piraciṭeṇṭ navāp ālikkāṉ avarkaḷ 3 maṇi nērattaip peṟṟirukkum namatu paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ viyācattaiyum avvāṟu kuṟaikkac ceyvārō eṉṟa kavalai mēlāṭik koṇṭiruntatu. āṉāl piraciṭeṇṭ stāṉattai vahittuḷḷa navāp ālikkāṉ avarkaḷiṉ tiṟamaiyai yōjikkumpōtu ³yār caṅkīta viṟpaṉṉar, ārmōṉiyam vācippatil oru kaiyiṉāl tāḷam pōṭṭuk koṇṭu maṟṟoru kaiyiṉāl vācikkiṟa paḻakkattai iraṇṭu kaikaḷukkum paḻakki vaittiruppavar, susvaramāyp pāṭakkūṭiya caktiyuḷḷavar, perutta jamīṉtār, nalla kuṇamuḷḷavar eṉṟu viḷaṅkiyataik koṇṭu arai maṇi nēram atikamāka naṭantiruppataikkūṭa maṟantu viṣayattiṉ cārattil kavaṉam celuttiyirukkiṟār eṉṟu teriya vantatu.
rāvcāhēp paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ viyācattai avaratu marumakaṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟituraippāṇṭi avarkaḷālum makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi N.P.cuppiramaṇiya aiyar avarkaḷālum vācikkappaṭṭa uṭaṉē maṟṟa viṣayaṅkaḷaiyum capaiyōrukku eṭuttuc colla paṇṭitar avarkaḷ eḻuntu tāṉ pēcuvatu tamiḻppāṣaiyāṉatāl carvajaṉaṅkaḷum terintu koḷḷa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi N.P. cuppiramaṇiya aiyar avarkaḷum piṟaku ceṉṉai vāciyāṉa C.R.cīṉivāsa aiyaṅkār avarkaḷum tivipāṣikaḷā yiruntu iṅkilīṣil moḻi peyarttut terivittārkaḷ. itil paṇṭitar avarkaḷ tamiḻp pāṣaiyiluḷḷa kirantaṅkaḷil nūlmuṟaiyuṭaṉ colli yirukkiṟa muṟaippaṭi āyappālai, vaṭṭappālai, tirikōṇappālai, caturap pālai eṉṟa pirivil 12, 24, 48, 96 vakaikaḷākap pāṭappaṭṭum avvāṟē vīṇaiyiṉ stāṉaṅkaḷ pirikkappaṭṭu ippōtuḷḷa 12 iṭaṅkaḷiṉiṉṟum oru oru iṭaiveḷikaḷilum araiyākavum, kālākavum, araikkālākavum, vīcamākavum itu aṉupavattiliruppatākavum terivittār. piṟaku “mukkiyamā yuḷḷa 24 stāṉaṅkaḷai ivvita rakaciyattaic cilar uṇarāmalum uṇarntavarkaḷiṟ cilar viḷakkic collat teriyāmal mayaṅki 22 stāṉattuṭaṉ niṉṟuviṭṭārkaḷ. ivaikaḷaippaṟṟi nāṉ pēcum poḻu tellām eṉṉaiccilar caṅkītattiṉ nuṭpattai nāṉaṟiyavillai eṉṟum eṉṉaip paittiyakkāraṉeṉṟum collat talaippaṭṭārkaḷ. āṉālum eṉatu peṇṇāṉa marakatavalli ammāḷiṉ utaviyaik koṇṭu kāṉattil viḷaṅkum ovvoru curuti stāṉaṅkaḷaiyum yāṉ kavaṉittu aṉupava kītattiṟkum tamiḻ nūl ātāraṅkaḷukkum ottumaiyāyuḷḷa inta irakaciyattai eṉṉāl aṭakki viṭa muṭiyātu. itaṟkāka eṉṉāl ōr nūleḻuti vantu koṇṭirukkiṟatu. inta irakaciya muṟaikaḷai eṉ piḷḷaikaḷukkup paṭittuk koṭukkum upāttiyāyarāy ippoḻutu piṭil vācitta makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatarāṉa ivarukkum nāṉ collavillai. avarum 22 curutiyaiyē nampikkoṇṭiruppavar. uṅkaḷōṭu avarum oruvarāy ippoḻututāṉ terintu koḷḷap pōkiṟār.” eṉkiṟavaraiyil coṉṉārkaḷ. intac camayam capaiyiluḷḷa ellōrum eṉṉai orē kālattil pārkkum pākkiyattai aṭaintēṉ. āṉāl nāṉ veṭkattai aṭaiyavēṇṭiyatirukkumeṉṟu cilar niṉaikka nērntālum nāṉ makiḻcciyuḷḷavaṉākavē iruntēṉ. ēṉeṉṟāl caṅkītam, camuttira rūpamāyuḷḷapōtu, oruvaṉ collakkūṭiya svalpamākat tāṉ irukkum; itaṉāl “kaṟṟatu kaimmaṇṇaḷavu, kallātatulakaḷavu” eṉṟa vākkiyattaiyē niṉaippil vaittirukkiṟa eṉakku veṭkattait taravillai. tavira namatu māṇākkarkaḷukkāvatu inta irakaciyam terintirukkiṟatallavā eṉṟa makiḻcciyum tantatu.
itaṉ piṟaku paṇṭitaravarkaḷ tāṉ kuṟippiṭṭu vaittirukkiṟa curuti stāṉaṅkaḷil cilavaṟṟai inta irākaṅkaḷil inta curuti stāṉaṅkaḷ vantu koṇṭirukkiṉṟaṉa eṉpatai eṉṉāl colli vaittirukkiṟa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ mūlamāy taṉatu peṇkaḷaik koṇṭu pāṭacceytu kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. itil (rāma pāṇatrāṉa) eṉkiṟa sāvēri, irākattil uḷḷa srī tiyākarāja cuvāmikaḷiṉ kīrttaṉattil (rā) eṉkiṟa akṣarattai iḻuttu (ma) eṉkiṟa akṣarattaic colluvataṟku muṉṉuḷḷa cutta riṣapa stāṉattil niṟkumpōtu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi harinākapūṣaṇamaiyar eṉṟa caṅkīta vitvāṉ anta iṭattai iṉṉum kuṟaittup piṭikka vēṇṭu meṉṟu tāṉ pāṭikkāṭṭumpōtu ṣaṭja curattiṉāl iḻukkappaṭṭu viṭṭār. ivaratu vātattai makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi ciṭṭipāpu nāyuṭu eṉpavar camātāṉañ ceytār. itaṉ piṟaku vīṇaiyiluḷḷa 24 stāṉaṅkaḷaiyum paṭittu varicaik kiramamāyum pāṭikkāṭṭappaṭṭatu. itai iraṇṭu taṭavai maṟupaṭi tirumpic coṉṉapōtum tanti nātattiṟkum cārīrattiṟkum oṟṟumaiyā yiruntatōṭu koñcamēṉum vittiyācamillāmal iruntatai ellōrum kaṇṭu āccariyappaṭṭārkaḷ.
inta camayattil intustāṉ caṅkītam pāṭuvatil kiyāti peṟṟavarum turupat vitvāṉum utayappūr sākruṭīṉ eṉpavar inta curuti varicaikaḷait tāṉum camīpattil uṭkārntu vīṇaiyuṭaṉ pāṭippārttār. āṉāl mēru mutal aḷavāyuḷḷa 24vatu meṭṭil varavum ṣaṭjastāṉam kiṭaittu viṭṭatāka niṉaittu niṉṟuviṭṭār. ākilum curuti ñāṉattil tērntavareṉpatil taṭaiyillai. ippaṭiyāka varicaikkiramamāy intac curuti stāṉaṅkaḷaip paṭittuk kāṭṭum poḻutu peṇpiḷḷaikaḷā yiruntapōtilum tairiyattuṭaṉum uṟcākattuṭaṉum collappaṭṭu oṟṟumaiyāyiruntatai niṉaittāl vāstavamāy paṇṭitar avarkaḷukku īcaṉuṭaiya aruḷ utaviyum cērntirukkiṟatākat tīrmāṉittēṉ. ippaṭiyāka curuti stāṉaṅkaḷaic capaimattiyil nirūpittu vāttiyattuṭaṉ taṉittaṉiyākavum toṭarcciyāyum aṉupavattiluḷḷatāyum eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyavar namatu paṇṭitaravarkaḷtāṉ; maṟṟavarkaḷ ippaṭi rūpittukkāṭṭa muṉvaravillai. itaṉ pēril kaṉam paṇṭitar avarkaḷ muṭivāka oru viññāpaṉamum ceytu koṇṭārkaḷ. atāvatu “ippōtu nāṉ eṭuttuk kāṭṭiya muṟaiyai āṣēpikka iṣṭamuḷḷavarkaḷ kēṭṭāl nāṉ camātāṉam collat tayārāyirukkiṟēṉ” eṉṟum kēṭṭuk koṇṭārkaḷ. appōtu āṣēpikka oruvarum muṉvaravillai. makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tivāṉ mātavarāv avarkaḷum parama cantōṣattai aṭaintiruntārkaḷ. itaṉāl maṟunāḷ hishaiṉas makārājā avarkaḷ tamatu camūkattil naṭatta ēṟpāṭu ceytiruntārkaḷ. antappaṭi mukkiyamāṉa cilaruṭaṉ vīṇaiyil mikunta pāṇṭittiyamuḷḷa tamatu makārāṇi avarkaḷuṭaṉ taṉimaiyāka iruntu kuḻantaikaḷiṉ kāṉattaik kēṭṭatuṭaṉ rāvcāhēp paṇṭitaravarkaḷ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi N.P.cuppiramaṇiya aiyar avarkaḷ mūlamāka iṅkilīṣil terivikkumpaṭi ceytu caṅkīta cāstirattiṉ perumaiyaiyum, teṉṉintiyāvil purātaṉamāy cīrtiruttattuṭaṉ naṭaipeṟṟu varuvataiyum atil tamiḻ nūlil collappaṭṭirukkiṟa pālai viparaṅkaḷaiyum ataṉāl curuti stāṉaṅkaḷ teḷivāy nirṇayamākiṟa teṉṟum ataṟku utaviyāka vīṇaiyum iṉṉa ilakṣaṇattuṭaṉ amaikkappaṭa vēṇṭumeṉpataiyum vicitamāyum- curukkamāyum terivittārkaḷ. makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātavarāyar avarkaḷum paṇṭitar avarkaḷaippaṟṟi ovvoru viṣayattilum nuṭpamāṉa ārāycci ceyyumpōtu evvaḷavu pirayācai yiruntālum piṉvāṅkupavar alla eṉṟum collumpōtu makārājā avarkaḷ vekuvāka cantōṣit tārkaḷ. piṟaku kāṉpareṉsil naṭantatupōl curuti stāṉa viparaṅkaḷum kāṇpikkappaṭṭaṉa. appōtu makārājā avarkaḷ cantōṣittu paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ ārāyccikku meccikkoṇṭu pukaḻntārkaḷ.
itil kāṉpareṉs naṭanta kālattil kuḻantaikaḷāl paṭikkappaṭṭa kakaṉakutūkalam eṉṟa irākattiluḷḷa rakuvamca ca&tāmaputicantara eṉṟa kīrttaṉattaik kēṭṭa pyāṇṭ māsṭar Mr.kucanaṉaṭaḷai veku cantōṣap paṭṭu itai noṭṭēṣaṉil kuṟittuk koṭukkumpaṭi kēṭṭār. atu pōlavē caupākkiyavati marakatavalli ammāḷāl aṭaiyāḷattuṭaṉ kuṟittuk koṭukkappaṭṭatu. atai pyāṇṭ māsṭar taṉatu pḷūṭ eṉṟa vāttiyattil ūti makiḻntu koṇṭu evvaḷavu kīrttaṉaiyāṉālum tēvaiyirukkumeṉṟu kēṭṭuk koṇṭār.
maṟṟōr nāḷ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tivāṉ mātavarāyar avarkaḷ paṅkaḷāvil oru mīṭṭiṅ kūṭiyapōtu kuḻantaikaḷiṉ kāṉam naṭantatu. aṉṟu atika nēram kiṭaittirunta paṭiyāl arumaiyāṉa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ pāṭappaṭṭapōtu ellōrum vicēṣa cantōṣattai aṭaintārkaḷ. mēṟ colliya pyāṇṭmāsṭarum cantōṣappaṭṭār. aṉṟaiya tiṉattilum kāṉpareṉsil naṭantapaṭi 24 curuti stāṉaṅkaḷaiyum pāṭik kāṇpikka nērntapōtu mēṟpaṭi piyāṇṭ māsṭar turaiyavarkaḷ vīṇaiyiṉ mēl niṣātastāṉam kuṟaivāyiruppatupōl niṉaittu āṭcēpittār. maṟṟavarkaḷ cariyāyiruppatāy vātittārkaḷ. paṇṭitar avarkaḷum cariyā yuḷḷa teṉṟu terivittārkaḷ. appōtu turaiyavarkaḷ palastāyikaḷil cañcāram ceyyum anēka vāttiyaṅkaḷ vācikkappaṭum kālattil ētāvatu oṉṟu ēṟṟattāḻvaṭaintāl ataik kaṇṭupiṭikkum tīraṉ nāṉ eṉpatai nīṅkaḷ nampa vēṇṭumeṉṟu āṅkilattil coṉṉa avvārttaiyai makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tivāṉ avarkaḷ tamiḻil eṭutturaittārkaḷ. ataikkēṭṭa paṇṭitaravarkaḷ vāyiṉāl 12 curuti ūtappaṭukiṟa perutta nātattaik kaṇṭupiṭikkum tiṟamai vāyntavarkaḷukku intiya caṅkītattil varum nuṭpa curaṅkaḷaik kaṇṭupiṭikka muṭiyātu eṉṟu viṭaiyaḷittārkaḷ. piṟaku vijaya nakaram vīṇai vitvāṉ vēṅkaṭaramaṇatās avarkaḷiṉ vīṇaiyaiyum cērttuppārtta kālattil turaiyavarkaḷukkum oppuk koṇṭuviṭa nērntu viṭṭatu.
piṟaku tañcai caṅkīta samājattil pirati kāṉpareṉsukku vantirunta varum, lakṣaṇalakṣiya vitvāṉum pūvaṉūrvāciyumāṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi piratāpa rāmacāmi pākavatar avarkaḷum ceṉṉai ṭākṭar nañcuṇṭarāv avarkaḷ mūlamāy aḻaippup pattiram peṟṟu parōṭā kāṉpareṉsukku ōr memparāyum tākkal ceytu koṇṭa ³ pākavatar accamayam iruntavarātalāl avaratu apippirāyam ētāvatu pētamaṭaintirukkiṟatā veṉṟu terintu koḷḷa paṇṭitar avarkaḷ pākavatar avarkaḷaip pārttu “vīṇaiyiṉ curutikaḷaik kavaṉittīrkaḷā” eṉṟār. pākavatar vīṇai naṉṟā yirukkiṟatākac coṉṉār. “curuti viṣayattait terintu koṇṭīrkaḷā” eṉṟu paṇṭitar avarkaḷāl kēṭkappaṭṭatu. ataṟkup pākavatar avarkaḷ “ūrppōyp pēcikkoḷvōm” eṉṟār. appōtu tivāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi mātavarāyar avarkaḷ ētāvatu carccai ceyvatāṉāl ippoḻutē ceyyalām eṉṟārkaḷ. ataṟkuḷ pākavatar 24 curutikku ātāram kiṭaikka villai eṉṟār. paṇṭitar avarkaḷ tamiḻ nūlil collappaṭṭirukkiṟa teṉṟārkaḷ.
piṟaku pākavatar tamiḻ nūlil caṅkītattaip paṟṟi virivākac colli yirukkiṟa cilappatikārattil ivviṣayam kāṇappaṭavillai eṉṟārkaḷ. paṇṭitar avarkaḷ nūl maṟaippai vilakki āḻntu kavaṉittāl aṟiyak kūṭum eṉṟārkaḷ. iṉṉum koñcam campāṣaṇai naṭantatu. piṟaku pākavatar mauṉattai vakittār.
itaṉ piṟaku ellōriṭamum uttiravu peṟṟuk koṇṭu parōṭāvai viṭṭup puṟappaṭṭu pampāy vantu cērnta aṉṟu oru lekcar hālil paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ upanniyācam eṉ.pi.cuppiramaṇiya aiyar iṅkilīṣ moḻi peyarppuṭaṉ naṭantatu. paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ puttirikaḷ kāṉamum naṭantu vantirunta kiṟistuva matappaṟṟuḷḷa ellōrum cantōṣa maṭaintārkaḷ. piṟaku aṅkiruntu puṟappaṭṭu ceṉṉaikku vantu cēra tivāṉ pakatūr makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi parāṅkuca nāyuṭukāru avarkaḷ paṅkaḷāvil upacarikkappaṭṭu mūṉṟu nāḷ taṅka nērntatu. anēka vitvāṉkaḷum tamiḻp paṇṭitarkaḷum paṇṭitar avarkaḷaik kaṇṭu kaḷittu parōṭā vijaya vartta māṉaṅkaḷai aṟintapōtu ellōrum koṇṭāṭiṉārkaḷ.
tamiḻc caṅkītam eṉṟu ēṟpaṭṭu toṉṟutoṭṭu nīṇṭa kālamāka aṟiyappaṭṭu aṉupavattiluḷḷa caṅkīta irakaciyattiṉ uṇmaiyai anēkar aṟiyāmaliruppatai muṉṉittu tamiḻ nāṭṭiṉ caṅkītam pirakācamaṭaiya nūl mukamāy karuṇāmirta cākaram eṉṟa peyaruṭaṉ veḷivara iruppataiyum ataṉ curukkam nāṉku pālaikaḷākap pirikkappaṭṭiruppataiyum veḷi yiṭṭuc cellum poḻutu itaikkēṭṭa tamiḻ apimāṉiyāyuḷḷa makā vitvāṉ makāmakō pāttiyāyar paṭṭam peṟṟavarāṉa srī cāminātaiyar avarkaḷ, caṅkīta vitvāṉ capēcaiyar avarkaḷ mutalāṉa anēkar tamiḻp pāṣaikkuḷḷa ēṟṟattaiyum, ataṉ viṣayamāyp paṇṭitar avarkaḷiṉ pirayācaiyaiyum eṇṇi mikunta tiruptiyaṭaintārkaḷ.
ceṉṉai vāciyāṉa caṅkīta vitvāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tiruvāti capēcaiyar avarkaḷ 24 curutikaḷiṉ viparattai aṟintu paṇṭitaravarkaḷiṉ ciramattaiyum tairiyattaiyum kuṟippiṭṭu mikavum meccik koṇṭārkaḷ. 1916m varuṣam ēppiral mātam 5-m tētiyaṉṟu cukamākat tañcai vantu cērntu avaravarkaḷ cantōṣamaṭaintārkaḷ.

Miraj,
8th August 1916
DEAR RAO SAHIB PANDITHER,
I am in receipt of your so-called ‘refutation.’
I made no reply to criticisms appearing in the Madras Mail as the question between us is not one in which the public is sufficiently well-informed for discussion in such a paper to be profitable.
1. In the pamphlet you have now printed you do not quote the remarks which you criticize. Most readers will be in the dark as to what the discussion is about.
2. Your method of replying to my criticism is to restate your own case and to call for a test.
3. You cannot seriously entertain the belief that any test of any value whatever was made at Baroda.
4. I took notes then of the dicta of Jakroddin Khan. On my return to Dharwar, I will hunt them up and let you see what absurdities they lead to. As far as the Indian Harmonium was concerned the test was a farce.
5. The remarks you quote from the Bombay Chronicle favour your view of the matter much less than they do mine. They amount to this that the Kafi scale is as follows :
	Sa 	Ri 	Ga 	Ma 	Pa 	Dha 	Ni 	Sa.
	9/8 	16/15 	10/9 	9/8 	9/8 	16/15 	10/9
According to you it should be :-
	Sa 	Ri 	Ga 	Ma 	Pa 	Dha 	Ni 	Sa.
	21/6 	21/12 	21/6 	21/6 	21/6 	21/12 	21/6
According to my experience it is
	Sa 	Ri 	Ga 	Ma 	Pa 	Dha 	Ni 	Sa.
	10/9 	16/15 	9/8 	9/8 	10/9 	16/15 	9/8
6. Kindly ask yourself how many of the ‘experts’ who attended the Conference had undergone the preliminary training with the help of a specially tuned instrument necessary to enable their ears to recognize the difference between the tempered tone, the major tone, the minor tone and other simple harmonic intervals. Several members of the Conference spoke in familiar terms of intervals represented by simple ratios such as 9/8, 10/9, 5/4, 6/5. How many of them could recognize these intervals with certainty if they heard them or could claim to be able to distinguish any of them from intervals tempered or otherwise which approximate to them?
7. To come to the singing of your daughters which seems to you a vindication of your theories.
8. I would like to ask why you discard the drone which I have always found associated with Indian music? Let them sing to a drone of two tamburas. You will find in Raga Kedargavla and in Shankarabharanam they will sing not your ga but the ga which is 5/4 of shadj. In Raga Hanumantodi they will sing the dha which is 8/5 of Shadj; in raga Natabhairavi, they will sing the ga which is 6/5 of shadj. To put the matter more briefly they will sing real music.
9. Artificial music is an abomination.
10. I venture to prophesy that it will be discarded in Europe before many centuries have passed. In Europe many factors combined to reconcile musicians to its obvious faults and deficiencies. I have endeavoured to treat the subjects in an article in the September to November 1915 numbers of Indian Education (Longmans Green and Co., Hornby Road, Bombay.) That article might prove of interest to you.
11. To resume, if you make inquiries you will find that an unaccompanied singer or violinist has great difficulty in rendering artificial intervals correctly, your daughters are no exception.
12. When they sing to your special bina they sing the harsh tones of temperament.
13. When they sing with the violin both they and the violinist insensibly drift away into other scales.
14. The scale they tend most towards is the ditonal scale, generally described as the scale of Pythagoras.
Some day I shall write an article on this scale. Books like Blaserna’s ‘Theory of Sound’ have completely misled the ordinary reader as to the part it has played in the history of music. The view I hold is that it never formed the basis of musical art until temperament led to its use. In ancient Greece it was what we might term the Shuddh scale in one method of tuning the Kithara; on account of its convenience for the purpose it became the nucleus of the instrumental notation. The Kithara was furnished with a device for tightening the strings by any interval up to a semitone whatever scale was required was obtained by means of this device, just as the binkar gets any intervals not given by the frets by pressing heavily on the wire or pulling it to one side and so increasing the tension. As far as one can tell, the ditonal scale was never used in any old Greek music; that is to say there was no Raga founded on the Shuddh notes of Pythagorean tuning. In the time of the Byzantine Empire theorists who did not know what they were talking about, added the Pythagorean ratios to scale which were not Pythagorean, just as pandits of modern India who have not practical knowledge of just intervals talk glibly of the 3033/4 ga and 405 dha and so on.
15. I am of opinion that your daughters’ singing, although much admired and commended by Jakroddin and others, is not a test in any sense of the word.
I would like to make clear my position with regard to your equal division of the octave.
16. Indian music, in my opinion, is now, in its best form, and ever was real music.
17. Any system of musical art founded on the use of a drone must be built up from true concord.
18. True concord to the primitive philosopher is a knot impossible to unravel. It is not until the philosopher begins to experiment with string-lengths that he has any notion of the way to set to work.
19. This however, does not daunt him. We find him in ancient India and in ancient Greece, (probably he was busy weaving phantasies of the same kind in Egypt, Assyria, and China), building up a theory of sound, worthless because it was not submitted to any scientific test, which explained all scales on the basis of an equal division of the octave. All the philosophers attacked the problem in the same way. They thought there must be some unit interval just as one uses the span or cubit as a unit of length. The only unit which suggested itself was the smallest perceptible difference of pitch. Having arrived so far, they proceed to estimate, with all the introspective mental ingenuity of which they were capable, the number of units contained in the various intervals used by musicians of their time.
20. The circumstance which sets Bharata and his follower Sarangdev on a pedestal above Aristoxenus and the rest of them, including your Tamil philosophers, is that one can trace a connection between the intervals of 13 srutis, 9 srutis, 4.3, 2 srutis and one sruti with which they deal and the harmonic intervals 3/2, 4/3, 9/8, 10/9, 16/15, 81/80.
21. In short my position is that, until modern times, artificial music only existed in the brains of primitive philosophers.
Yours faithfully,
(Sd.) E.CLEMENTS.
APPENDIX
NOTE I
Note on the so-called test of the Indian harmonium.
22. Jakroddin appeared to be influenced by the generally sceptical and disapproving attitude of the audience towards the instrument.
He reluctantly admitted that pa which was exactly 3/2 of sa wass correct. He found ma komal which was exactly 4/3 too low. He found ga komal, an exact minor third above sa (6/5) too low for Bhairavi. He found ni tivra which was a just semitone (16/15) below sa too flat for Yaman.
23. He wouldn’t agree that I had the Kafi notes on the instrument at all as far as I remember, but I have not detailed note of this.
I remember his Kafi took the major tone to start with and not the minor tone. I gave a note to the President giving all details, but I cannot find a copy of it. All I have is a brief notice from which and from memory I give the above statement.
24. It appeared to me that Jakroddin is not gifted with a phenomenally accurate ear.
19-8-16. 	(Sd.) E.C.
NOTE II
I have recently tested the notes given by the frets of two binas made by Hussenkhan the renowned Sitar-maker of Miraj.
They both gave the following scals.
Tivra notes :-
	Sa 	re 	ga 	ma 	pa 	dha 	ni 	sa.
	9/8 	10/9 	16/15 	9/8 	10/8 	9/8 	16/15
To dha is the low or madhya tivra note.
Komal notes :-
	Sa 	re 	ga 	ma 	pa 	dha 	ni 	sa.
	16/15 	10/9 	9/8 	9/8 	16/15 	10/9 	9/8
The ga and ni are the low ones which I have always found associated with Kafi. Bhimpalas, Miyaki Malhar, Sindhada etc.
The ga and ni of Bhairavi, Jivanpuri etc. are obtained by pressing hard on the fret or pulling the wire to one side and so increasing the tension. Tivra dha is got in the same way.
(Sd.) E.C.

8. intiya caṅkītam eppōtum oru curattaiyum - ataṉ pañcamattai yum captittuk koṇṭu (tampurāvai mīṭṭuvatupōl) pāṭukiṟa vaḻakkamā yiṟṟē. uṅkaḷ kuḻantaikaḷ appaṭiyēṉ collavillai. avarkaḷ eppōtum iraṇṭu tampurākkaḷai mīṭṭikkoṇṭē pāṭaṭṭum. appaṭip pāṭuvārkaḷāṉāl kētāri, kauḷam, caṅkarāparaṇam mutaliya irākaṅkaḷil uṅkaḷuṭaiya kāntārattai yalla caṭjattukku 11/4 āy irukkappaṭṭa kāntārattaip pāṭuvārkaḷ. aṉumattōṭiyil caṭjamattukku 13/5 āy uḷḷa taivatattaiyum naṭapairaviyil caṭjamattukku 11/5 āy uḷḷa kāntārattaiyum paṭippārkaḷ. tokaiyāyc colla vēṇṭumāṉāl appōtutāṉ cariyāṉa caṅkītam paṭippārkaḷ.

14. avarkaḷ mukkiyamāy māṟippōkiṟa Scale kku Ditonal scale eṉṟu peyar. itaittāṉ Pythagoras uṭaiya skēl eṉṟu cātāraṇa māyc colluvārkaḷ.
itaip paṟṟi nāṉ oru article cīkkiram eḻutuvēṉ. Blaserna eṉpavaruṭaiya ‘Theory of sounds’ eṉṟa nūlaip pōṉṟa maṟṟa nūlkaḷāl tāṉ Pythagoras uṭaiya scale caṅkīta carittira viṣayattil eṉṉa vēlai ceytirukkiṟateṉpataip paṟṟic cāmāṉya jaṉaṅkaḷ tappāṉa apippirāyam koḷvataṟku iṭamāyirukkiṟatu. eṉṉuṭaiya apippirāyameṉṉa veṉṟāl temperament vanta piṟakutāṉ atu caṅkītattiṟku oru mukkiya ātāramāka eṇṇappaṭṭatē yoḻiya ataṟku muntiyalla. ātikirēkkarukkuḷ kittāriyaic curuti cērppatil upayōkappaṭuttappaṭṭa cutta skēl muṟaikaḷil itu oṉṟāyiruntatu. itu veku caukariyamāyirunta paṭiyāl inta skēlai ātāramākak koṇṭē vāttiyaṅkaḷukku notation  eḻuta ārampittārkaḷ. antak kittāriyiṉ tantikaḷai muṟukkiṉāl araic curam varaikkum uyarttakkūṭiya vitamāy atu amaikkappaṭṭataṉāl enta skēl avaciyamō atai vācikkumpaṭiyāyc caukariyam ēṟpaṭṭatu. taṟkāla piṅkār allatu vīṇaiyil meṭṭukaḷil illāta curaṅkaḷai eppaṭit tantiyai iḻuppataṉāl kamakamāy vācikkiṟōmō appaṭittāṉ. inta ditonal scale āṉatu terinta varaiyil kirēkka caṅkītattil upayōkap paṭuttappaṭavillai. atāvatu oru irākamāvatu Pythagoras muṟaiyāyc curuti cērnta cutta curaṅkaḷāl uṇṭāṉatalla. Byzantine Empire (makamatiya rājāṅka) kālattil caṅkītamē teriyāta cilar Pythagoras uṭaiya kaṇakkai oṭṭiviṭṭārkaḷ. taṟkālam Just intervals eṉṟāl eṉṉa veṉṟu teriyāta paṇṭitarkaḷ 3033/4 uḷḷa kāntāram 405 uḷ taivatameṉṟu taṇṇīrpaṭṭa pāṭamāy eppaṭic collukiṟārkaḷō appaṭittāṉ atuvum.

19. āṉāl ippaṭic curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭu piṭippatu kaṣṭameṉṟu terintum anta cāstiri etukkum payantāṉō? illai, pōy viḻuntu cāṭi oru muṟaiyaik kaṇṭupiṭittāṉ. appērppaṭṭa cāstirikaḷ intiyāvilum kirēkka tēcattilum oruvēḷai ekiptu, ācīriyā, cīṉā tēcaṅkaḷilum kiḷampi cāstirōktamillāta oru caṅkīta muṟaiyai ēṟpaṭutti ellā skēlkaḷum stāyiyai camapākaṅkaḷākap pirippatiṉāl ēṟpaṭukiṟavaikaḷ eṉṟu collic cātittārkaḷ. ellā cāstirikaḷum ivvita muṟai yaiyē uṇṭākkiṉārkaḷ. oru cāṇ allatu oru muḻattaik koṭukkap paṭṭa aḷavāka niṉaippatu pōl ellā iṭaiveḷikaḷukkum potuvāṉa oru cama aḷavu irukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu niṉaittārkaḷ. intappotuvāṉa cama aḷavu curaṅkaḷukku ati nuṭpamāṉa ciṟu vittiyācantāṉ. itai ātāramāka vaittukkoṇṭu taṅkaḷ kālattiluḷḷa vitvāṉkaḷāl upayōkikkappaṭṭa iṭaiveḷikaḷukku veku vicittiramāṉa vitamāyum, veku cāmarttiyamāṉa vitamāyum appaṭi ettaṉai nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷ irukkum eṉṟu kaṇṭu piṭittārkaḷ.

RESPECTED AND DEAR SIR,
ākasṭu mātam 8m tētiyil mirāj eṉṟa ūrilintu tāṅkaḷ eḻutiya kaṭitam eṉakkuk kiṭaittatu. tāṅkaḷ atil eḻutiya pala kuṟippukaḷukku ēṟṟa camātāṉam colla vēṇṭiyiruntataṉāl uṭaṉē patil eḻutakkūṭavillai.
atōṭu parōṭāviliruntu vantapiṉ curuti viṣayamāy nāṉ eḻutik koṇṭu varum puttakattil pākkiyāyirunta cila viṣayaṅkaḷai muṭikkavum, ivviṭattil vaḻakkamāka naṭantu varum caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattiṉ ēḻāvatu kāṉpareṉs kūṭṭavum, atil karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum nuṭpamāṉa curam curutikaḷ iṉṉavaiyeṉṟu niccayap paṭuttavum vēṇṭiya vēlaikaḷil atikam muyaṟcikka vēṇṭiyatā yiruntatu.
parōṭāvil eṉṉuṭaiya curutiyaip paṟṟi viyācam 31/2 maṇi nēram naṭanta pōtilum eṉṉuṭaiya mukkiyamāṉa kaṇitapākam colla nēram illāmaiyāl viṭṭuviṭappaṭṭatu. piṟaku atai tantiyiṉ aḷaviṟku vīṇaiyiṉ aḷavu ottirukkiṟateṉṟum, avvaḷavil kiṭaikkakkūṭiya curaṅkaḷ aṉupōkattilirukkum curaṅkaḷukkuc cariyāyirukkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum teḷivākac cantēkamaṟa vāttiyattiṉālum, vāyppāṭṭiṉālum, kaṇakkiṉā lum, vīṇaiyiṉ aḷaviṉālum iraṇṭu maṇi nēraṅkaḷukkumēl viḷakkik kāṭṭiṉēṉ. antac camayattil tāṅkaḷum iṉṉum iraṇṭu mūṉṟu peyarkaḷum māttiram varavillai. Mr. Fredlis, Band Master, niṣātam koñcam kuṟaikiṟateṉṟu vātāṭiṉār. vijayanakaram vēṅkaṭa ramaṇatās avarkaḷ vīṇaiyaik koṇṭum maṟṟum irākaṅkaḷil vaḻaṅki varum ārōkaṇa avarōkaṇaṅkaḷaik koṇṭum paricōtittapōtu curaṅkaḷ yāvum cariyāṉa ōcaiyuṭaiyavakaḷāyirukkiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu President  Nawab Ali khan avarkaḷ, tivāṉ cākip V.P.mātavarāv avarkaḷ, ciṭṭi pāpu nāyuṭu avarkaḷ, cākkuruṭīṉcāyap avarkaḷ iṉṉum maṟṟum intustāṉ caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷ, karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷ palarum evvita āṣēpaṉaiyumiṉṟi oppukkoṇṭu cantōṣamaṭaintārkaḷ. ivai mārccu mātam 25m tēti caṉikkiḻamai mālaiyil aintu maṇi mutal 71/2 maṇi varaiyum naṭantaṉa.
tāṅkaḷ antac camayam illātiruntālum taṅkaḷaippōla 22 curutikkākap pōrāṭum piratāpa rāmacāmi pākavatar aṅkē vantiruntār. kūṭṭam muṭinta camayattil vīṇaiyiṉ curaṅkaḷaip paṟṟik kēṭkum poḻutu tuvāvimcati curutiyilēyē oṭṭik koṇṭiruntatāka veḷip paṭṭatu. tuvāvimcati curutiyiṉpaṭi oru tukkaṭā, allatu oru kīrttaṉam pāṭikkāṭṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟu kēṭṭapoḻutu iṉṉum iraṇṭu mātattil pāṭikkāṭṭukiṟēṉ eṉṟu coṉṉār. appaṭic coṉṉavar iṅkē (tañcaiyil) ākasṭu mātam naṭanta kāṉpareṉcilum palavita kuḻappaṅkaḷ ceyyavum 22 curutiyaiyē cātikkavum vēṇṭumeṉṟu cila peyaraik kaṭci cērttup pūṇūlaip piṭittuc cattiyam ceytu koṇṭu vantiruntār. āṉālum avarkaḷ pēciya kaṭci oṉṟāvatu capai muṉ niṟkavillai. avaravarkaḷukku ēṟṟa camātāṉamum - patilum - vāymoḻiyiṉālum - pāṭṭiṉālum- vīṇaiyiṉālum kāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa.
pūrva tamiḻ nūlkaḷil caṅkītattaippaṟṟic collum apippirāyaṅ kaḷaip paricōtikkavum oru stāyiyil varum aḷavaic collum kaṇakkaip paricōtikkavum, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 curaṅkaḷ varum 67 irākaṅ kaḷaṭaṅkiya nālu aṭṭavaṇaikaḷiluḷḷavaikaḷaip pāṭi avaikaḷ caritāṉā eṉṟu ārāycci ceyyavum vēṇṭi mūṉṟu viṣayaṅkaḷilum terintavar kaḷaṭaṅkiya mūṉṟu pañcāyattu ēṟpaṭutti avarkaḷāl itu tīrmāṉikka vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu.
immūṉṟu pañcāyattārum viṣayaṅkaḷai aṟintu koḷvataṟkup pōtumāṉapaṭi viḷakkik kāṭṭappaṭṭatu. kāṉpareṉsiṉ mutal nāḷ muḻu nēramum aṭutta nāḷ pāti nēramum karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṉ curuti viṣaya meṉṟa orē kāriyam eṉṉāl māttiram pēcappaṭṭu muṭivukku varavēṇṭi yatiruntatu. appaṭiyē pūraṇamāka paricōtikkappaṭṭu eṉṉuṭaiya muṟai cariyāṉateṉṟu palarālum oppuk koḷḷappaṭṭatōṭu pañcāyattārāl rippōrṭṭum aṉuppappaṭṭirukkiṟatu. rippōrṭ accāki muṭintavuṭaṉ taṅkaḷukku aṉuppuvēṉ.
parōṭāvukku nāṉ vantirukkum poḻutu kāṉpareṉs naṭanta iraṇṭām nāḷ mālaiyil tivāṉ cākip makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv C.I.E. avarkaḷum Baroda High Court Judge, makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi K.R.cāraṅkapāṇi rāv B.A.,B.L., avarkaḷum eṉṉaik kūppiṭṭut tāṅkaḷ oṉṟum pēcātirukkiṟīr kaḷē, maṟṟavarkaḷ tīrmāṉam ceytu vaikkiṟārkaḷē eṉṟu kēṭṭapoḻutu “maṟṟavarkaḷ kāriyattil talaiyiṭuvatu eṉakkup piriyamillai. eṉṉuṭaiya muṟai varumpoḻutum eṉ kāriyattai nāṉ colla vēṇṭum. allatu eṉ kāriyattil vēṟu yārāvatu talaiyiṭuvār kaḷāṉāl appoḻutu eṉ niyāyattaic collik koḷḷa vēṇṭum. vantirukkiṟavarkaḷ yāvarum intustāṉi caṅkītattaip paṟṟiyē pēcukiṟārkaḷ. karnāṭaka caṅkītattaip paṟṟi iṉṉum oruvarum pēcavillai. karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷirukkum nāṭṭilēyē karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṉ curutikaḷ iṉṉavaiyeṉṟu tīrmāṉikkappaṭa vēṇṭum. nāḷai, eṉ muṟaiyil colla vēṇṭiyavaikaḷaic colli aṉupōka pūrva māy rucuppaṭutta vēṇṭiyatu eṉṉuṭaiya kaṭamai” eṉṟu coṉṉēṉ.
appaṭiyē aṭutta nāḷ ceytum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. ataṉ payaṉākat tuvāvimcati curutiyeṉṟa oru kuḻappam nīṅkip paṉṉiraṇṭu curattil Staff Notation kuṟikkappaṭṭup paṭittuk koṭukkalām eṉṟu Mr.V.N.Bhatkandi B.A., B.L. avarkaḷāl pirarēpikkappaṭṭu appaṭic ceyvatu takutiyeṉṟu pala niyāyaṅkaḷ colli eṉṉāl āmōtikkappaṭṭatu.
aṉpuḷḷa aiyā! vaṭanāṭṭil 12 curaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiyirukkum āṣē paṉaiyaip pārkkilum tamiḻnāṭṭil nūṟu maṭaṅku atikamirukkiṟateṉṟu nāṉ aṟivēṉ. avaikaḷ yāvum ātāramaṟṟa vivātaṅkaḷē, mēlum caṅkīta ratṉākararuṭaiya cila cūttiraṅkaḷaip pāṭam ceytavarkaḷ, jīraṇam paṇṇa muṭiyāmalum vānti paṇṇiviṭa muṭiyāmalum vayiṟu uppip pōyp puraṇṭu koṇṭirukkum malaippāmpu pōlirukkiṟārkaḷ.
aṉupōkattiṟku varāta cāstiraṅkaḷaik kuṭṭip pāṭam paṇṇik kuruṭṭāṭṭamāyc cātikkiṟavarḷaip pārkkap paritāpamāyirukkiṟatu. avarkaḷ caṅkīta viṣayamāy atikam terintavarkaḷ eṉṟu maṟṟavarkaḷ eṇṇumpaṭi cila cūttiraṅkaḷaic colli taṅkaḷai ellām terintavar kaḷākak kāṭṭik koḷvatu vaḻakkam. ākaiyiṉāl vaṭanāṭṭaip pārkkilum teṉṉāṭṭil 12 curaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiyum 12 curaṅkaḷil uṇṭākkappaṭṭa 72 mēḷak karttāvaip paṟṟiyum āṣēpaṉaikaḷ uṇL. itōṭu oru stāyiyai 96 pākaṅkaḷ vaittu vaḻaṅki varum nuṭpa curutikaḷ tēvāram, tiruvācakam, tiruvāymoḻi, ṣēttiriñar pataṅkaḷ, tiyākarāja aiyar kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ākiya ivaikaḷil vaḻaṅki varuvatiṉāl curaṅkaḷ iṉṉavaiyeṉṟu nitāṉippatu kūṭāta kāriyamāy ituvaraiyum iruntatu.
oru stāyiyil vaḻaṅki varum curaṅkaḷ ca-pa muṟaiyāyp paṉṉiraṇṭē, ca-pa muṟaiyil kiṭaikkum 12 curaṅkaḷil ca-pa pōṉṟa iraṇṭu curaṅkaḷil pāti pāti kuṟaittuk kamakamāy vācittu vantirukkiṟārkaḷ. atāvatu oru stāyiyaip paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷākap pirittu ovvoru curattiṟkum iraṇṭu alakukaḷ vaittu mottattil 24 alakākki atil ri-ta, ta-ka, ka-ni pōṉṟa curaṅkaḷil ovvoru alaku kuṟaittuk kāṉam ceytu vantirukkiṟārkaḷ. iṉṉiṉṉa curaṅkaḷil kuṟaikka vēṇṭum eṉpatai aṟiya mummūṉṟu alakāka varum curaṅkaḷ kuṟaittuc collappaṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu vaṭṭappālai muṟai coṉṉārkaḷ.
vaṭṭappālaiyiṉ alaku 22 āka varuvatiṉāl oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu nām niṉaikkakkūṭātu. oru stāyiyil 24 curutikaḷē. caṅkīta ratṉākararum avarukku muṟpaṭṭa paratarum 22 eṉṟu collukiṟa maṟṟa evarum ivviṣayattil tavaṟip pōṉārkaḷ eṉṟē niṉaik vēṇṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. tamiḻ nūliṉ karuttu iṉṉateṉṟu terintu koḷḷāmal ippaṭic ceytatē yoḻiya vēṟillai. eṉṟālum avarkaḷ eḻutiya virivāṉa muṟaiyiṉāl mayaṅkumpaṭi nēriṭṭatu. avar eḻutiya muṟaippaṭit taṟkālam oruvarum paṭikka muṭiyāmal aṉu pōkattuk killāmal veṟum nūl māttira mirukkiṟatē pōtumāṉa cāṭciyākum.
tāṅkaḷ intiya caṅkīta viṣayamāyc cila nuṭpaṅkaḷai ārāyntu atilum curutiyai ārāyntu colla vantatai niṉaittu nāṉ mikavum cantōṣappaṭukiṟēṉ. 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa piṉṉa eṇkaḷiṉāl kiṭaitta curaṅkaḷōṭu cāraṅkatēvar, paratar eḻutiya muṟaippaṭik kiraka māṟṟukaiyil mūṉṟu curutikaḷ putitāyk kaṇṭu āka oru stāyiyil 25 curutikaḷ eṉṟu niccayittu ataṟkēṟṟa vitamāy ārmōṉiyam tayār ceytu kāṉpareṉs muṉ tāṅkaḷ koṇṭu vantatai niṉaikka niṉaikka eṉakku mikavum āccariyamāyirukkiṟatu.
itaip pārkkilum vicēṣamāka, kāṉpareṉs naṭanta mūṉṟu nāṭkaḷil tāṅkaḷ viyācam paṭittum, pala tarkkaṅkaḷ ceytum, kaṇakkukaḷ kāṭṭiyum, ārmōṉiyam vācittum kāṭṭiṉīrkaḷ. nāṉ tuvāvimcati curuti, aṉupōkattiṟku varāta oṉṟeṉṟum caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟaippaṭi curuti cērkkap pañcamam kūṭa ca vōṭu poruntāteṉṟum pala niyāyaṅkaḷ colli pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta 7, 12, 24, 48, 96 curaṅkaḷ, curutikaḷ tāṉ taṟkālam vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum nūl vaḻiyākavum aṉupōka mūlamākavum piracaṅka mūlamākavum maṟuppu mūlamākavum teḷivākac coṉṉēṉ. kaṭaiciyil intiyaṉ ārmōṉiyam aṉupōkattilirukkum curaṅkaḷukku ottuvaravillai eṉṟu kūṭi irunta capaiyār ellārālum taḷḷappaṭṭatu. parōṭāvil vācitta viyācaṅkaḷiṉ mūṉṟu pākamum nāṉ taṅkaḷukkuk koṭuttiruntum taṅkaḷ kaṭciyai stāpippataṟkeṉṟu iṉṉum oru kaṭitam eḻuti atai acciṭṭu eṉakku aṉuppiya taṅkaḷ vīrac ceyalai nāṉ eṉṉeṉṟu colvēṉ?
taṅkaḷaip pōl cōrvaṭaiyāmal viṭāpiṭiyāyc cātippavarkaḷ kiṭaippatu aritu. tāṅkaḷ teṉṉintiyāvil uttiyōkatti lirukkumpaṭi nērntiruntāl eṉ apippirāyattai aṉucarikkavum koṇṭāṭavum kūṭiyavarkaḷāyiruppīrkaḷ. pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ caṅkītap payiṟciyilirukkum nuṭpaṅkaḷ yāvaiyum aṉupōka mūlamākavē aṟintu koḷvīrkaḷ. Mr.tēvāluṭaiya curuti muṟaiyiliruntu vēṟu cila curutikaḷ kaṇṭupiṭittu oru stāyiyil 25 curutikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu coṉṉatupōla oru stāyi yil 96 nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu ārmōṉiyam mutaliyavaikaḷ ceytu eṉ muṟaiyai ulakattār yāvarum aṉucarikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu piracuram ceytiruppīrkaḷ. pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta muṟai mika uttamamāṉateṉṟum, mikunta tērcci peṟṟiruntateṉṟum atai aṟintu koḷḷāmal ituvaraiyum 22 curutiyil tiṇṭāṭiṉōm eṉṟum ellārukkum eṭuttukkāṭṭiyiruppīrkaḷ. tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ kāṉattil vaḻaṅki varum curaṅkaḷaiyum, curutikaḷaiyum nāṉ aṉupōka muṟaiyāyp pāṭikkāṭṭukaiyil camīpattiliruntum tāṅkaḷ māttiram avaikaḷai oppukkoḷḷa maṉatillāmal oru stāyiyil 25 curuti yirukka vēṇṭu meṉṟu tirumpavum colvatāṉatu eṉakku mikunta āccariyattaik koṭukkiṟatu.
appaṭiyiruntālum eṉṉuṭaiya niyāyattai aṉupōkattiṉāl aṟintukoḷḷak kūṭāta intustāṉi pāṭalkaḷ pāṭum nāṭṭil irukkiṟīrkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ līvu nāṭkaḷil cila maṇi nēram tañcaiyilirukkak kūṭumāṉāl eṉṉuṭaiya apippirāyattaip paḻamaiyāṉa tamiḻ nūlkaḷ mūlamākavum aṉupōka mūlamākavum rucuppaṭuttit taṅkaḷai ēṟṟuk koḷḷumpaṭi nāṉ ceyvēṉ. teyvamum ataṟku aṉukūlamāyirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu pirārttikkiṟēṉ.
tāṅkaḷ eḻutiya kaṭitattil cila kuṟippukaḷukku nāṉ patileḻutāmal irukkalāmeṉṟē niṉaittēṉ. maṉanērmaiyum cattiyamum viṭāmuyaṟci yumuḷḷa taṅkaḷaiyotta oru turaikkup patil eḻutāmaliruppatu niyāya mākat tōṟṟavillai. uṇmaiyaik kaṇṭa oruvar collum uṇmaiyai māṟṟi vēṟu vitamāyc coṉṉa turaikaḷaiyum ituvaraiyum nāṉ pārttatillai. ākaiyāl taṅkaḷukkup piṉvarum cila kuṟippu kaḷukkup patil eḻutat tuṇintēṉ. niyāyaṅkaḷai eṭuttuc collum poḻutu cilarukku maṉavaruttam uṇṭākalām. appaṭi uṇṭākātirukkum paṭit taṅkaḷai mikavum kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ.
1. “ippōtu tāṅkaḷ acciṭṭirukkum pattirikaiyil nāṉ coṉṉa enta viṣayaṅkaḷaip paṟṟit tāṅkaḷ vittiyācamāṉa apippirāyappaṭukiṟa tākac collavillai. etaip paṟṟip pēcappaṭukiṟateṉṟu anēkarukkut teriyavarātu.”
‘nāṉ coṉṉa enta viṣayaṅkaḷaip paṟṟit tāṅkaḷ vittiyācamāṉa apippirāyappaṭukiṟatākac collavillai. parōṭā kāṉpareṉsil, paṇṭitar caṅkīta ratṉākararuṭaiya tuvāvimcati curutiyait taḷḷi viṭukiṟār. Equal Temperament muṟaikku iḻukkiṟār’ eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ coṉṉīrkaḷ. ataṟku vēṇṭiya niyāyaṅkaḷ cumār 3/4 maṇi nēram colli, ‘itaṟku āṣēpaṉai ētāvatu irukkumāṉāl colla vēṇṭu’meṉṟu nāṉ kēṭṭapoḻutu patil collāmal etaṟkāka mauṉam cātittīrkaḷō ataiyē meyil pēpparukku mārccu mātam 30-m tēti Indian Music eṉṟa talaippuḷḷa viyācattiṉ 2-vatu kalattil, 2-vatu pārāvil, eḻutiyiruntīrkaḷ.
ivviraṇṭu kuṟippil kāṉpareṉsil tāṅkaḷ coṉṉa viṣayam nāṉ eḻutiya maṟuppil nālāvatu pakkam iraṇṭāvatu pārāvil collappaṭukiṟatu. iraṇṭāvatu kuṟippu aintāvatu pakkam iraṇṭāvatu pārāvil teḷivākak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. ivviyācciyattiṟku mūla puruṣarā yirunta taṅkaḷ maṉatiṟku atu naṉṟākat teriyum. āṉāl ivvaḷavu kālattiṟkup piṉ nāṉ eḻutiṉa iraṇṭu viṣayattaiyum illāmaṟ ceytuviṭat tāṅkaḷ eṇṇaṅ koṇṭatākat taṅkaḷ kaṭitattāl viḷaṅkukiṟatu. aṉṟiyum ivviṭaṅkaḷai naṉṟāyp pārkkavillai eṉṟu niṉaikkavum iṭamirukkiṟatu. mutalukkē mōcamāṉāl vaṭṭikku vaḻakkāṭu kiṟatuṇṭā? taṅkaḷaip pōṉṟa aṟivāḷikaḷukku nāṉ eḻutavēṇṭiyatu eṉṉa irukkiṟatu?
aṉpuḷḷa aiyā! curuti vicāraṇaiyil tāṅkaḷ neṭunāḷ uḻaittavarkaḷ eṉpataiyum Mr.tēvāl taṅkaḷukkut tuṇaivar eṉpataiyum nāṉ aṟivēṉ. taṅkaḷuṭaiya Introduction to the Study of Indian music  eṉṟa pustakattaiyum tēvāl avarkaḷuṭaiya The Hindu Musical scale and the 22 Srutis eṉṟa puttakattaiyum pārttirukkiṟēṉ. tāṅkaḷ kāṉpareṉsukku varukiṟatākak kēḷvippaṭṭut taṅkaḷiruvaraiyum Rao Sahib, R .paṇṭārkkār B.A.,L.M.S.avarkaḷaiyum pārkka vēṇṭumeṉṟu viruppaṅkoṇṭē nāṉum aṅkē vantēṉ. taṅkaḷuṭaiya kaṇakku viṣayamākavum 22 curutikku mēl kirakam māṟṟumpoḻutu mūṉṟu curutikaḷ kiṭaittaṉa eṉṟu colvatiṉ viṣayamākavum Mr.tēvāl avarkaḷ 2/3 āy perukkik koṇṭu pōkum poḻutu nālāvatu paṭiyil atāvatu kāntārattil tirittiripammā (maṟaippu 33/4, 55/8) ceyvataiyum appaṭiyē tamakku vēṇṭiya vēṟu iṭaṅkaḷiṟ ceyvataiyum kavaṉitta nāṉ ivviṣayaṅkaḷaip paṟṟip pūraṇamākap pēca vēṇṭumeṉṟu tayārāka vantiruntēṉ.
atōṭu 22 curutiyuṇṭeṉṟu pōrāṭum karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷil iraṇṭoruvar aṅku vantiruntataṉāl avarkaḷ muṟaiyaiyum ataic cērnta Mr.cakasraputti, Mr.mōkaṉa cantiratākōr, Dr.paṇṭārkkār, Mr. Mr. Barve, caṅkīta ratṉākarar, pārijātakkārar ākiya ivarkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyaṅkaḷ Diatonic Scale mutaliya irupatukku mēṟpaṭṭa apippirāyaṅkaḷaiyum nāṉ ārāycci ceytu, yār etaik kēṭṭālum ataṟkut takunta patil colvataṟkeṉṟu mikavum tayārāy vantēṉ.
tāṅkaḷum Mr.V.N.Bhatkandi avarkaḷum taṅkaḷaic cērntavarkaḷum muntiṉa iraṇṭu nāḷ kāṉpareṉsilum mukam karukap pēcik koṇṭatupōla nāṉ ceyya virumpavillai. kaṟuppup palakaiyil caṅkīta ratṉākarariṉ curutik kaṇakkait tāṅkaḷ eḻutiṉapoḻutu atil tavaṟuta lirukkiṟateṉṟu eṉ pakkattiliruntavarkaḷukku eṭuttukkāṭṭiṉēṉ. taṅkaḷuṭaiya kaṇakkait tavaṟutaleṉṟu capaiyil colla nāṉ virumpa villai. āṉāl veṟum vārttai pēcuvataip pārkkilum rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭuvataiyē peritāka niṉaittēṉ.
nāṉ mūṉṟāvatu nāḷil rucappaṭuttik kāṭṭiṉa piṉ, tāṅkaḷ ivaikaḷ ellāvaṟṟaiyum illāmaṟ ceykiṟateṉṟa nōkkattuṭaṉ metuvāka ‘paṇṭitar caṅkīta ratṉākararuṭaiya apippirāyattait taḷḷi viṭukiṟār, Equal Temperamentkku iḻukkiṟār’ eṉṟu ēḷaṉam ceytīrkaḷ. ac camayattil caṅkīta ratṉākararuṭaiya muṟai muṟṟilum tavaṟutalāṉa muṟai yeṉṟum 2/3, 3/4 aip perukkik koṇṭu pōkum muṟai yāvum muṟṟilum picakeṉṟum Geometrical Progression paṭiyē curaṅkaḷirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟum vēṇṭiya niyāyaṅkaḷ colli muṭivil āṣēpaṉaiyiruntāl colla vēṇṭumeṉṟu kēṭṭēṉ. tāṅkaḷ ā eṉṟāvatu, ū eṉṟāvatu vāyait tiṟantiruppīrkaḷāṉāl, appōtu eṉ patilai naṉṟāy aṟintiruppīrkaḷ. eṉakku ēṟṟa camayam kiṭaikkavillaiyē eṉṟu varuttappaṭṭēṉ. appaṭi varuttappaṭṭuk koṇṭirukkiṟa camayattil tāṅkaḷ intak kaṭitam eḻutiṉataṟkāka mikavum cantōṣappaṭukiṟēṉ.
2. “eṉṉuṭaiya koḷkaiyait tāṅkaḷ eppaṭik kaṇṭirukkiṟīrka ḷeṉṟāl, uṅkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyattaiyē colli yāvarum ataic cōtittup pārkka vēṇṭumeṉpatutāṉ”
mēṟkaṇṭa vacaṉattil taṅkaḷ muṟaiyai nāṉ tavaṟutaleṉṟu aṟintu koḷḷumpaṭi colvatōṭu kūṭa eṉṉuṭaiya apippirāyattai maṟṟavar cōtittup pārkkumpaṭi colvatu tappitamā? vāti, pirativātikaḷiṉ karuttut teriyāmal eppaṭi muṭivu kāṇakkūṭum? ākaiyiṉāl taṅkaḷuṭaiya karuttaiyum - eṉ karuttaiyum maṟṟavar cōtittup pārkka vēṇṭumeṉṟu nāṉ ceytatu evvitattilum tavaṟutalāka māṭṭātu. eṉṉuṭaiya karuttu iṉṉateṉṟu maṟṟavarkaḷukku vīṇaiyiṉālum - vāyppāṭṭiṉālum cātittuk kāṭṭiṉēṉ. appaṭic ceytu kāṭṭa capaiyārāl kēṭkappaṭṭut tāṅkaḷ ceytu kāṭṭiyapoḻutu capaiyār yāvarālum taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyam tavaṟutaleṉṟu taḷḷappaṭṭatē. itu pōtātā? itaiyē eḻutiyiruntēṉ.
3. “parōṭāvil enta vitamāṉa rucuvum carivara naṭattappaṭṭateṉṟu tāṅkaḷ yatārttamāy nampiviṭak kūṭātu.”
ivvākkiyattaip pārkkumpoḻutu parōṭāvil evvitamāṉa rucuvum carivara naṭattappaṭavillai eṉṟa taṅkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyattaiyē collukiṟīrkaḷ. ‘eṅkaḷ appaṉ kutirukkuḷ illai’ eṉṟu coṉṉatu pōla ituvum irukkiṟatēyoḻiya vēṟillai. tāṅkaḷ eṇṇiyatu pōla nāṉ eṇṇavillai. carivara naṭattāmalā paḻakkattilirukkum curaṅ kaḷukkut taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattil varum curaṅkaḷ cariyāka varavillai eṉṟu taḷḷiṉārkaḷ? appōtu intiyāviṉ pala iṭaṅkaḷiliruntu vantirunta caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷ carivara naṭantu koḷḷa villaiyā? ivarḷai naṭattiṉa piraciṭeṉṭ avarkaḷ kūṭṭattaic cariyāy naṭatta villaiyā? 22 curuti muṟaippaṭit tāṅkaḷ ceytu vanta ārmōṉiyam taḷḷappaṭṭatu cariyāy naṭanta teṉpatai rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭavillaiyā? appōtu tāṅkaḷ capaimuṉ oppuk koḷḷa illaiyā? curaṅkaḷ kuṟaivutāṉ eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ capai muṉ collātiruntāl nāṉ taṅkaḷukku rucuppaṭuttat tayārāyiruntēṉ. tāṅkaḷ oppukkoṇṭapiṉ maṟupaṭi nāṉ uṅkaḷaik kēṭpatu mariyātaiyākumā? intiya caṅkītattaik keṭuttukkoṇṭirukkum ettaṉaiyō puṇṇiyavāṉkaḷirukka tāṅkaḷ ivvaḷavu tūram ciramam eṭuttukkoṇṭataṟku naṉṟi pārāṭṭavēṇṭāmā?
aṉpuḷḷa turaiyē! intiya caṅkītattil mikunta cāstira muṟaiyai yuṭaiteṉṟu yāvarum koṇṭāṭum teṉṉintiya caṅkītam pallāyira varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉiruntē nāḷatu varaiyum tamiḻ makkaḷāl pāṭik koṇṭu varappaṭukiṟatu. aṉupōkattiṟku vantapiṉ cāstiraṅkaḷ maṟantu pōvatum nūlkaḷaip pēṇāmal viṭuvatum kāla iyalputāṉē? ippaṭit tamiḻ makkaḷ kavaṉikkāmal pōṉapiṉ camīpakālattil atāvatu 5m nūṟṟāṇṭilirunta paratarum 13m nūṟṟāṇṭilirunta caṅkīta ratṉākararum, tamiḻ muṟaiyil oru stāyiyil 24 curutikaḷ collappaṭṭu atil iraṇṭu alaku kuṟaittu 22 alakil kāṉam ceyyappaṭuvatai aṟintu koḷḷāmal 22 eṉṟu eḻuti vaittārkaḷ. avarkaḷ collukiṟa cila irākaṅkaḷ taṟkālattilum pāṭappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa. āṉāl avarkaḷ collum nūlmuṟaippaṭi avaikaḷ aṉupōkattiṟku varakkūṭiyavaikaḷā yillai. ippaṭi aṉupōkattiṟku varāta 22ai - vaittuk koṇṭu intiya caṅkītattil varum curaṅkaḷaiyum curutikaḷaiyum pariṭcai paṇṇuvatu muṟṟilum kūṭāta kāriyam eṉṟu nāṉ niccayamāyc colluvēṉ.
paṉṉiraṇṭu piratāṉamāṉa curaṅkaḷōṭu cērntu varum curaṅkaḷai niccayam ceyvatu kūṭāta kāriyamā yiruntataṉāl pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta āyappālaiyiṉ paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷukkē tuvāvimcati curutiyiṉ mayakkam uṇṭākiviṭṭatu. vaṭanāṭṭaip pārkkilum teṉṉāṭṭil caṅkīta ratṉākararuṭaiya cūttiraṅkaḷai maṉappāṭam ceytu koṇṭu tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ kāṉam muḻuvataiyum irupattiraṇṭiṟkuḷ māṟṟi viṭap pārkkum caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷ palaruṇL. āṉāl aṉu pōkat tiṟkuk koṇṭuvara muṭiyāmal veṟum pōrāṭṭattōṭu niṉṟu viṭṭārkaḷ.
Harmonic Ratio viṉpaṭi camamillāta iṭaiveḷikaḷaiyum, vaiparēṣaṉḷaiyum collik koṇṭiruntālum teṉṉāṭṭilum, vaṭa nāṭṭilum vaḻaṅki varum caṅkītattil paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷ vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu kaṇṭu 12 cura muṟaippaṭi nammuṭaiya kāṉattai Staff Notation l kuṟikka vēṇṭu meṉṟu vaṭanāṭṭil intustāṉ caṅkītattil tērntavarum pala puttakam eḻutiyavarumāṉa Mr.V.N.Bhatkandi B.A., B.L. avarkaḷ pirērapikka, avar colliya paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷē āyappālaiyāy pūrvam toṭṭu karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum, ippōtu taṅkaḷ muṉ irukkum vīṇaiyiṟ kāṇum curaṅkaḷē avaikaḷ eṉṟum, avaikaḷē ca-pa, ca-ma muṟaiyāy oru stāyiyil amaikiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum, ippaṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷē intustāṉi caṅkītattilum vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum, Equal Temperament eṉṟu mēṟṟicaiyār piyāṉā, ārmōṉiyaṅkaḷil vaḻaṅki varukiṟa curaṅkaḷ ivaikaḷē eṉṟum, ivaikaḷai nām mutal pāṭamāka aṉuṭṭikkak kūṭiyateṉṟum nāṉ āmōtikkaiyil, capaiyōr yāvarum oppukkoṇṭārkaḷē. appōtu tāṅkaḷ eṅkē pōṉīrkaḷ? taṅkaḷ cinēkitar Mr.tēvāl eṅkē pōṉār? itaṉāl tuvāvimcati curutiyiṉ pōrāṭṭam muṭiyavillaiyā? taṅkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyam taḷḷap peṟṟateṉṟu tirumpavum colla vēṇṭumā?
parōṭā makārājā avarkaḷ celavu ceyta paṉṉīrāyira rūpāykku itu miñciṉa palaṉeṉṟu nāṉ niṉaikkiṟēṉ. Pythagoras pōṉṟa tattuva ñāṉikaḷ 2500 varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉ tavaṟippōṉa ivviṣayam parōṭāvil eṉṉāl tiruttappaṭṭataṟku ettaṉai kōṭi rūpāy celaviṭṭālum atuvum ciṟitē. 2500 varuṭaṅkaḷāka uṇṭāṉa pala āpattukkaḷ nīṅkip paḻaiyapaṭi caṅkītam naṉṉilaikku varum eṉṟa kuṟi 12 curattiṉāl tōṉṟavillaiyā? atai uḷḷapaṭi kaṇṭu cantōṣikkum vivēkikaḷ caṅkītattiṟkup putiya ulakam tōṉṟiyirukkiṟateṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. cīva kōṭikaḷ yāvum kaṇṭu cantōṣikkumpaṭiyāṉa cūriya utayattaic cīvarkaḷai aṭittut tiṉṟu kālam kaḻikkum koṭiya mirukaṅkaḷum paṭcikaḷum aruvaruttu ōṭi oḷittuk koḷḷukiṉṟaṉavē. atupōl oru stāyiyil varum 12 curattai aṟiyātavarkaḷ colvārkaḷ. intap paṉṉiraṇṭu curattiliruntu kamakamāy vācikkappaṭum 24, 48, 96 pōṉṟa nuṭpa curaṅkaḷai aṟintukoḷvatu veku culapamāyirukkum. astipāram pōṭṭapiṉ vīṭu kaṭṭuvatu periya kāriyamā? caṅkītattiṟku aṭippaṭaiyāṉa ippaṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷum tavaṟutaleṉṟu collum taṅkaḷaiyotta yāvarum aṉupōkamāyp pāṭikkoṇṭirukkum curaṅkaḷ iṉṉavaiyeṉṟu aṟiyātavarkaḷ eṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ.
evvitamāṉa rucuvum carivara naṭattappaṭavillai eṉṟa vārttai eṉ maṉatiṟku mikavum varuttamāyirukkiṟatu. carivara rucuppaṭutta vēṇṭu meṉṟē aṅku vantēṉ. carivara rucuppaṭuttiyum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. taṅkaḷ apippirāyattaiyum avvāṟē kaṇṭittēṉ. āṭcēpaṉai irukkumāṉāl collavēṇṭumeṉṟu palataṭavai kēṭṭēṉ. tāṅkaḷ mauṉam cātittīrkaḷ. aṉu pōkattilirukkum curaṅkaḷukkut taṅkaḷ ārmōṉi yattiṉ curattai ottuppārkkumpoḻutu ārmōṉiyamum piṉ vāṅkik koṇṭatu. ataṟku muṉpē Mr.tēvāl maṟaintupōṉār. tāṅkaḷum atu kuṟaintatutāṉ eṉṟu oppukkoṇṭīrkaḷ. capaiyōr yāvarum paṉṉiraṇṭu curattiṉpaṭi Staff Notation kuṟikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu tīrmāṉittārkaḷ. appoḻutum taṅkaḷ cattattai aṅku kāṇōm. his haiṉas makārājā - makārāṇi avarkaḷ muṉṉilaiyil lakṣmivilācattil nāṉ capaiyil coṉṉapaṭiyē colli 2/3, 3/4 aip perukkic cellum muṟaiyum 22 curutimuṟaiyum muṟṟilum caṅkītattiṟkup poruntāteṉṟum pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ 7, 12, 24, 48, 96 āka oru stāyiyaip pirittu vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟārkaḷ eṉṟum pōtumāṉapaṭi colli rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭiyapoḻutu tivāṉ cākip V.P.mātavarāv C.I.E avarkaḷum piraciṭeṉṭ navāp ālikkāṉ cāyap avarkaḷum Mr.V.N.Bhatkandi avarkaḷum Mrs.Atiya Begum Fyzee Rahimin avarkaḷum Fine Arts palavaṟṟilum mikattērnta Mr.Samuel avarkaḷum vantiruntārkaḷ. tāṅkaḷum avarkaḷuṭaṉ vantiruntīrkaḷ. aṅkum tāṅkaḷ evvitamāṉa āṣēpaṉaiyum collavillai.
his haiṉas makārājā avarkaḷiṉ piṟanta nāḷ aṉṟu naṭanta vicēṭamāṉa Garden Partykku nāṉum aḻaikkappaṭṭiruntēṉ. accamayattil makārājā avarkaḷ eṉṉaikkaṇṭu cukam vicārittu, “tāṅkaḷ caṅkīta viṣayamāy neṭunāḷāka atika vēlai ceytu koṇṭiruppatākak kēḷvip paṭukiṟēṉ. atil tāṅkaḷ iḷakkarittup pōkāmal vēlai ceyya vēṇṭum. pūrva nūlkaḷaiyum- intiya cāstiraṅkaḷaiyum nām pēṇi muṉṉukkuk koṇṭu vara vēṇṭum” eṉṟu collip pala pēr muṉṉilai yil eṉṉai uṟcākappaṭuttiṉārkaḷ. ippaṭiyellām irukka enta vitamāṉa rucuvum parōṭā miyūcik kāṉpareṉcil carivara naṭattappaṭa villai eṉṟu nāṉ apippirāyappaṭuvēṉā? evvitamāṉa rucuvum carivaṭa naṭattap paṭṭateṉṟu tāṅkaḷ nampiviṭak kūṭāteṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷē! eṉ puttiyai ippaṭittāṉā māṟṟa vēṇṭum. eṉ apippirāyattai nērē kēṭkāmal ippaṭippaṭṭa oru periya capaiyai avatūṟu collā tirukkumpaṭi mikavum kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ.
4. “Jakruddin Khan uṭaiya apippirāyaṅkaḷai yellām nāṉ kuṟittu vaittiruntēṉ. nāṉ Dharwar kkut tirumpippōṉa piṟaku avaikaḷait tēṭi eṭuttu aṉuppuvēṉ. appōtu anta vitvāṉ coṉṉavaikaḷ evvaḷavu kūṭāta kāriyaṅkaḷ evvaḷavu tappitaṅkaḷukkuk koṇṭu vantu viṭupavaikaḷ eṉṟu veḷippaṭum. intiya ārmōṉiyattaip paṟṟi naṭanta parīṣaiyāṉatu parikācak kūttā (Farce) yiruntatu. (eṉakkuc cirippai yuṇṭākkukiṟatu atuvum oru parīṣaiyākumā?”)
‘intiya ārmōṉiyattaip paṟṟi naṭanta pariṣaiyāṉatu parikācak kūttāyirukkiṟatu’ eṉṟu nīṅkaḷ colvataik kēṭka viyappaṭaikiṟēṉ. āl intiyā miyūcik kāṉpareṉs muṉṉāl tāṅkaḷ 22 curuti ārmōṉiyattaik koṇṭu vantu ataiyē intiyā muḻuvatum parappiviṭuvataṟku vēṇṭiya pirayatṉam ceytīrkaḷē. tāṅkaḷum taṅkaḷaic cērnta cilarum Mr.Mr.Bhatkandi  avarkaḷum avarkaḷaic cērntavarkaḷum viyācam vācittum oruvarukkoruvar virōtamāy vātāṭiyum iraṇṭu mūṉṟu nāḷ mikap pirayācappaṭṭīrkaḷē. appaṭippaṭṭa ūkkam cāstira vicāraṇaiyil irukka vēṇṭiyatu mika avaciyantāṉ. intiyāviluḷḷa ettaṉaiyō peyar taṅkaḷ paḻamaiyaik kavaṉiyātirukkumpoḻutu mēṟṟicaiyiliruntu vanta tāṅkaḷ atil oruvarāka ēṟpaṭṭataik kuṟittu mikavum cantōṣamaṭaintēṉ.
taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyam aṉupōkattiṟku ottirukkiṟatā eṉṟu pariṭcai pārkkappaṭukiṟa varaiyum ivaiyellām eppaṭi muṭiyumō eṉṟu kavaṉittuk koṇṭiruntēṉ. oḻuṅkāṉa muṭivukku varāteṉṟu nāṉaṟin tiruntēṉ. āṉāl capaiyār aṉupōkattiṟkum - ārmōṉiyattiṟkum ottuvaravillai eṉṟu colliyapoḻutu tāṅkaḷ kuṟaikiṟateṉṟu oppuk koṇṭataik kēṭṭa māttirattil taṅkaḷ maṉa nērmaiyaiyum – muka vāṭṭattaiyum kaṇṭu uṇmaiyāka nāṉ mikavum varuttamaṭaintēṉ. eṉṟālum cāstira viṣayamāṉa vivakārattil ippaṭiyellām varuvatum atiṉāl oru naṉmaiyuṇṭāvatum ulakan tōṉṟiyatu mutal aṉu pōkattiliruppatāl eṉ varuttattai maṟantēṉ. tāṅkaḷum avvarutta mellām maṟantu paḻaiyapaṭiyum atil uṇmai yirukkiṟateṉṟu niṉaittu eṉakku eḻutiṉatu mikavum cantōṣattait tarattakkatē. iṉṉum oru kāṉpareṉsukkuḷ taṟkālam aṉupōkattilirukkiṟa curaṅkaḷukkēṟṟa vitamāy eṉ kaṇakkiṉpaṭi ārmōṉiyam amaittukkoṇṭu varuvīr kaḷāṉāl ellōrukkum upayōkamāyirukkum. appōtu eṉ koḷkai yum karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṉ muṟaiyum teḷivāka yāvarukkum viḷaṅkum.
itu oru parikācak kūttu eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ alaṭciyam ceykiṟatākak tōṉṟukiṟatu. appaṭi alaṭciyamāy niṉaikkātirukkumpaṭi taṅkaḷai mikavum vaṇakkamāyk kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ. mūṉṟu nāḷ viyācam mūlamākavum - vātāṭṭattiṉ mūlamākavum kaṟuppup palakaiyil eḻutap paṭṭa kaṇakkiṉ mūlamākavum - ārmōṉiyattil pāṭiṉatu mūlamākavum uṅkaḷ karuttu yāvum capaiyārukkut terivikkappaṭṭatē. Mr.tēvāl pustaka mūṭṭaikaḷaik koṇṭu vantu toppeṉṟu pōṭuvatum, piṉ vāttiyattai muṉ koṇṭu vantu vācippatākap pāvaṉai ceyvatum, piṉ oru pustakattait tiṟantu vēṟoṉṟaip pēcuvatum, pustakattait top peṉṟu kīḻēpōṭṭu viṭṭu camaskiru cūttiram colvatum, tāṅkaḷ kaṇakkuc colvatum, kaṟuppup palakaikku ōṭik kaṇakku eḻutuvatum, ārmōṉiyattait tiṟantu cila apa curaṅkaḷ vācippatum, vēṟu cilar āṣēpippatum, ‘nāṉ ippaṭic collukiṟēṉ’ eṉpatum - ‘appaṭittāṉ niṉaikkiṟēṉ’ eṉpatum, pōṉṟa viṣayaṅkaḷ pala naṭantaṉa. uyarnta pīṭamum, iṭamakaṉṟa kūṭamum, aṟivāḷikaḷ niṟainta capai eṉakku tēva capaiyākavum, irāja capaiyākavum, niyāya capaiyākavum, ārāycci capai yākavum tōṉṟiṟṟu. āṉāl taṅkaḷukkup parikācak kūttāṭumiṭamāyp paṭuvatu niyāyantāṉē? intiya caṅkītattukku virōtamāy tāṅkaḷ stāpikkavanta curuti muṟaiyum ārmōṉiyamum tavaṟutaleṉṟu capaiyār taḷḷiṉatiṉāl tāṅkaḷ itu oru parikācak kūttu eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. kūttukkum kuṟaivāṉatā? kūttup pōṭṭavarkaḷ kūttaik kuṟai collalāmā? kūttup pārkka vanta capaiyār muṉpāka ēṉ avvaḷavu tūram eṭuttuc coṉṉīrkaḷ? taṅkaḷaip pariṭcikkat takutiyaṟṟavarkaḷ muṉ avvaḷavu colvatu nallatalla eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ ēṉ muṉṉamē aṟintu koḷḷavillai? cumār iraṇṭu maṇi nēramāka kāpi, pelavāl, yamaṉ, kamās, pairavi mutaliya irākaṅkaḷ aṉupōkattiṟkum- ārmōṉiyat tiṟkum ottuvarukiṟatāveṉṟu pāṭikkāṭṭappaṭṭatē. tāṅkaḷ uṇṭākkiṉa ārmōṉiyattil tāṅkaḷē vācittup pārttuc curam vāyppāṭṭiṟkuk kuṟaivāyirukkiṟateṉṟu oppukkoṇṭīrkaḷē. itu pariṭcai allāmaṟ pōṉāl ārāycciyākum. takunta curañāṉamuḷḷa intustāṉ kavāy kaḷum karnāṭaka caṅkīta muṟaippaṭi 1/16 pōṉṟa nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷaip pāṭavum kēṭkavum terinta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷum vantiruntārkaḷ. nāṉum mikavum kavaṉamāyk kēṭṭukkoṇṭiruntēṉ. nāṉum cila kēṭka niṉaittēṉ. āṉāl tāṅkaḷ uṇmaiyāka oppukkoṇṭa piṟpāṭu oṉṟum kēṭkat tuṇiyavillai. antac camayattil ‘itu eṉṉa pariṭcai, itu oru pariṭcai yākumā eṉṉaip parikācamā ceykiṟīrkaḷ? itu perum parikācak kūttāyirukkiṟatē’ eṉṟu collic cirittiruntīrkaḷāṉāl ataṟkut takunta patil colliyiruppēṉ. iruntālum camayam tavaṟip pōkavillai. iṉṉum oru kāṉpareṉs kūṭukiṟa camayattil parikācak kūttu (Farce) eṉṟu colvataik kēṭka mika āvalāyirukkiṟēṉ.
caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟaippaṭi oru stāyiyil 22 allatu 25 eṉṟu collum curuti muṟai ulakam muṭiyum varai enta nāḷilāvatu pāṭappaṭa māṭṭātu eṉṟu niccayam colvēṉ. caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟaippaṭi tāṅkaḷ curuti ceyyavillai eṉpatai tāṅkaḷ eḻutiya Introduction to the study of  Indian Music eṉṟa puttakattiṉāl aṟikiṟēṉ. avaikaḷai itaṉ piṉ varum kuṟippukaḷil pārppōm.
