taṅkaḷ kaṭcikku cātakamāka vācitta viyācaṅkaḷum – viyākki yāṉaṅkaḷum - kaṇakkukaḷum taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattil aṭaṅkiyiruk kiṉṟaṉa. tāṅkaḷ mūṉṟu nāḷ paṭṭa pirayācai yāvum iraṇṭu maṇi nērap pariṭcaikku niṟkāmal taḷḷappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟu kirāṇikkiḷ pēppar collukiṟatu. “After about two hours trial and discussion the conference came to the conclusion that the scales laid down on the above mentioned Ragas by Mr.Clements did not tally with those of practical artistes” eṉṟu pampāy kirāṇikkiḷ mārccu mātam 23ām tēti pēpparil 5-āvatu pakkattil collukiṟatu. taṅkaḷuṭaiya neṭunāḷ pirayāca mum oruṅkē aḻintu viṭṭateṉṟu terikiṟatē. taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattil taṅkaḷ kaṇakkiṉpaṭi curaṅkaḷ ceyyappaṭṭiruntaṉa. appaṭic ceyyappaṭṭa oṉṟu capaiyārāl taḷḷap paṭṭatu. ataiyē pēpparil eḻutiyiruntārkaḷ. uḷḷapaṭi itu uṅkaḷ kaṭcikku cātakak kuṟaivutāṉ. kirāṇikkiḷ pēpparil eṉṉaippaṟṟiyum cila kuṟippukaḷ eḻutiyiruntārkaḷ. ataip pārkkaiyil kāṉpareṉcil naṭantavaikaḷil uṇmaiyum cāramumāṉavaikaḷaiyē colliyiruntārkaḷ.
The Bombay Chronicle, March, 24th 1916.
“The All-India Music Conference met again this morning. Thakur Nawab Ali Khan of Akbarpur presiding. The work of the day commenced with the reading of the paper entitled “An article on Shrutis” by Rao Sahib M. Abraham Pandither. It was a learned disquisition on the much disputed question of the Shrutis or quarter-tones, which are used in the singing of Indian Ragas, embodying the resuslts of researches that the octave should be divided into twenty-four sub-divisions instead of twenty-two as prescribed by the ancient Sanskrit texts. The lecture was highly technical in character, and full of mathematical calculations and logarithms, but they were enlivened by the excellent discourisve style in which the lecture was delivered and by the interludes of songs of prayer sung in the very finely cultivated and musical voices of the two daughters of Mr. Pandither, who it is understood, are proficient in Indian as well as European music. The most interesting portion of the lecture was the demonstration given by the daughters of Mr. Pandither of the micro-tones used in certain of the South Indian Ragas, by sining to the accompaniment of the Veena. The ordinary frets of the Veena were supplemented by movable ivory frets placed on the board of the Veena at different places in order to produce the micro-tones exhibited, and in this way Mr.Pandither explained what notes were now in use in some of the Southern Ragas. The correctness of the notes sung with those produced on the instrument was vouched for by so distinguished a musician as Mr.Zakr-ud-Din of Udeypore. The paper of Mr. Pandither was the only item arranged for the morning.
pampāy kirāṇikkiḷ : 24, mārccu 1916.
intiyā muḻuvatilum iruntu vantu kūṭiya kāṉpareṉs iṉṟu kālai maṟupaṭiyum kūṭiṉatu. Thakur Nawab Ali Khan avarkaḷ akkirācaṉam vakittārkaḷ. iṉṟu kālai mutal mutal curutikaḷiṉpēril rāvcāyap              M. āpirakām paṇṭitar avarkaḷ oru upanniyācam vācittārkaḷ. intiya rākaṅkaḷil varum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ allatu kāl curaṅkaḷaip paṟṟit taṉ caṅkītak kalvit tiṟamaiyaik kāṭṭumpaṭiyāṉa vitamāy paṇṭitaravar kaḷ coṉṉārkaḷ. curutikaḷ pala apippirāyam ēṟkakkūṭiyavaiyeṉpatu yāvarumaṟinta viṣayamē. paṇṭitaravarkaḷ anēka varuṣaṅkaḷāy itu viṣayattil pala ārāyccikaḷ ceytatiṉ palaṉāy oru stāyiyāṉatu camaskiruta nūlkaḷil collappaṭṭa pirakāram 22 curutikaḷ eṉṟirāmal 24 cama curutikaḷākap pirikkappaṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṇpittārkaḷ. inta viyācamāṉatu caṅkīta cāstira viṣayamāṉa ati nuṭpamāṉa viṣayaṅ kaḷaiyum, kaṇakkukaḷaiyum, turuva eṇkaḷaiyum paṟṟic coṉṉatiṉāl karukalāyiruntapōtilum atu collappaṭṭa pōṅkāṉatu oruvariṭam pēcuvatu pōlat teḷivuḷḷatāyiruntatiṉālum, airōppiya caṅkītattilum, intiya caṅkītattilum mikat tērccipeṟṟa avarkaḷuṭaiya iraṇṭu kumārattikaḷum taṅkaḷuṭaiya mika iṉimaiyāṉa cārīrattōṭu iṭaik kiṭaiyē paktirasamāṉa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷaip pāṭiyatālum nēram pōṉatu oruvarukkum teriyavillai. inta viyācattil veku mukkiyamāk kavaṉikkappaṭattakka viṣayam yāteṉṟāl, teṉṉintiya irākaṅkaḷil cilavaṟṟil vaḻaṅkum ati nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷai paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ yāvarukkum viḷaṅkumpaṭiyāy vīṇaiyuṭaṉ pāṭik kāṭṭiyatutāṉ. vīṇaiyil cātāraṇamāyuḷḷa meṭṭukaḷai yallāmal aṅkumiṅkum camayattiṟkēṟṟa vitamāyt taḷḷi vaikkakkūṭiya tanta meṭṭukaḷai vaittu ati nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷaip pāṭikkāṭṭi ivvita māyt teṉṉintiyā irākaṅkaḷil vaḻaṅkum curaṅkaḷai paṇṭitaravarkaḷ eṭuttuk kāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. pāṭiya curaṅkaḷum vīṇaiyil vācitta curaṅkaḷum oṟṟumaiyuḷḷavaitāṉ eṉṟu mikap pirapala vittuvāṉākiya utaiyappūr cākruṭīṉ cāyap avarkaḷāl naṟcāṭci peṟṟārkaḷ. kālaiyil vācikkappaṭumpaṭi kuṟikkappaṭṭatu inta orē viṣayamāy iruntatu.
mēṟkaṇṭa cila varikaḷai nām pārkkaiyil uṇmaiyuḷḷa oruvarukku eṉṉa apippirāyam uṇṭākumeṉṟu nāṉ collat tēvai yillai. itu eṉ kaṭcikku cātakak kuṟaiveṉṟu taṅkaḷait tavira maṟṟa evarum eṇṇamāṭṭārkaḷ. kiruṣṇa paramātmā turiyōtaṉaṉaiyum tarumaraiyum kūppiṭṭu, ‘ulakattil nallavarkaḷ yār keṭṭavarkaḷ yār pārttu vāruṅkaḷ’ eṉṟu coṉṉār. appōtu tīmaiyē uruvāka avataritta turiyōtaṉaṉ ‘cuvāmi! taṅkaḷ coṟpaṭit tēṭi vantēṉ. eṉṉait tavira nallavar vēṟu oruvarum illai. maṟṟavarkaḷ yāvarum pollātavarkaḷāyirukkiṟārkaḷ’ eṉṟu coṉṉāṉ. tarumar vantu ‘cuvāmi! ulakattiluḷḷa yāvarum nallavarkaḷā yirukkiṟārkaḷ. nāṉ oruvaṉ tāṉ mikap pāviyāyirukkiṟēṉ’ eṉṟu vaṇaṅkiṉār. itupōlavē tāṅkaḷ collukiṟatum irukkiṟatu. uṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyam ottuvaravillai eṉṟu coṉṉatupōla eṉ kaṇakkāvatu - vīṇaiyiṉ curaṅkaḷāvatu – vāyp pāṭṭāvatu ottuvaravillai eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷā? taṅkaḷ kaṭcikku virōtamāṉa apippirāyam capaiyār coṉṉataiyē avarkaḷ kirāṇikkiḷ pēpparil eḻutiyiruntārkaḷ. āṉāl capaiyār eṉ viṣayattil enta nalla apippirāyappaṭṭārkaḷō ataiyē kirāṇikkiḷ pēpparil eḻuti yiruntārkaḷ. eṉ kaṭcikku cātakak kuṟaivāṉa oru vārttaiyum avarkaḷ collavillaiyē. piṉ ēṉ tāṅkaḷ ippaṭic colla vēṇṭum? itaip pārkkum maṟṟavar taṅkaḷai uṇmaiyuḷḷavarkaḷeṉṟu niṉaippārkaḷā?
ellārum atikamākap piriyappaṭuvatāṉa kāpi taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyat til kuṟaintataṉāl ellōrukkum talaivali yuṇṭāyiṟṟu. avai cariyāṉa curaṅkaḷāyirukkumāṉāl accuraṅkaḷaik kiraka māṟṟum poḻutu karakarappiriyā, aṉumattōṭi (pairavi), mēcakalyāṇi (yamaṉ kalyāṇi), arikāmpōti (kāmpōti), naṭapairavi (tōṭi), cutta tōṭi (cutta pairavi), caṅkarāparaṇam (pelavāl) mutaliya tāy irākaṅkaḷ āṟum uṇṭāka vēṇṭum. itaic caṅkīta aṉupōkamuḷḷa yāvarum aṟivārkaḷ. ic curaṅkaḷukkup piṉṉa eṇkaḷaip pōṭṭup piṉṉap paṭuttuvatu paritāpamā yirukkiṟatu. ip paritāpattiṟku iṉṉiṉṉa iṭaiveḷikaḷ varavēṇṭu meṉṟu eṉ apippirāyattai iraṇṭāvatu variyil eḻutukiṟīrkaḷ. atu appaṭiyalla. āṉāl avaikaḷ nāṉ parōṭā kāṉpareṉsil vācitta iraṇṭāvatu viyācattil āyappālai aṭṭavaṇaiyil kāṭṭiyapaṭi irukka vēṇṭum. nīṅkaḷ camīpattil illaiyē eṉṟu mikavum varuttappaṭukiṟēṉ. ippaṭippaṭṭa kaṇakkukaḷukkup patil eḻutuvatu yāṉai kaṇṭa kuruṭar pēcik koḷvatu pōlirukkum. oruvaṉ yāṉai ulakkaipōlirukkiṟa teṉṟum, maṟṟoruvaṉ ural pōl irukkiṟateṉṟum, vēṟoruvaṉ viḷakkumāṟu pōl irukkiṟateṉṟum colluvāṉ. yāṉaiyaik kaṇṭavaṉ ataik kēṭṭu nakaittāl “nāṉ eṉ kaiyiṉāl taṭavip pārttēṉ. uṉakkuk kaṇṇiruntum karuttu illāmaṟ pōy viṭṭatē” eṉṟu parikācam ceyvāṉ. ivvāṟē uḷḷatai illātatākavum illātatai uḷḷa tākavum cātippatu ulaka vaḻakkam.
6. “vantirunta ‘vitvāṉkaḷil’ ettaṉaipēr curaṅkaḷaip pakuttaṟiyum viṣayattil vāttiyaṅkaḷiṉ utaviyiṉāl paḻakiyiruntavarkaḷ? avarkaḷil ettaṉai pērukku Tempered tone, Major Tone, Minor tone, cātāraṇa ārmāṉik iṭaiveḷikaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ nuṭpa vittiyācam teriyum? anēka memparkaḷ taṅkaḷ viyācaṅkaḷil 9/8, 10/9, 5/4, 6/5 eṉṟa iṭaiveḷikaḷaip paṟṟit taṇṇīrpaṭṭa pāṭamāyp pēciṉārkaḷē, avarkaḷil ettaṉai pērukku inta nuṭpa veḷikaḷiṉ vittiyācaṅkaḷ terintirukkum?”
vantirunta vitvāṉkaḷiṉ vitvattiṟamaiyaip paṟṟit tāṅkaḷ cila vārttaikaḷ colvatai muṟṟilum āṣēpikkiṟēṉ. toṭṭaviṭa mellām uṅkaḷaik kuṟaicolvatu eṉ maṉatiṟkut tiruptiyāyillai. tāṅkaḷ kaṭitam eḻutāmaliruntāl taṅkaḷ nērmaikkākap pukaḻntu koṇṭēyiruppēṉ. curañāṉam mika arumaiyāṉatutāṉ. Major tone, Minor tone, iṉṉateṉṟu teriyātirukkalām. āṉāl avarkaḷ aṉupōkattil ennēramum avaikaḷaiyē pāṭikkoṇṭirukkiṟārkaḷ eṉṟu taṅkaḷukkut teriyavillai.
caṅkītattiṟkuriya nuṭpa vitikaḷaiyum peyarkaḷaiyum caṅkītam kaṟṟuk koḷḷukiṟavarkaḷukku mēl nāṭṭil colli vaippatupōl intiyāvil ceyyāmal mikac ciṟu pirāyattilēyē aṉupōkat tiṟku varumpaṭi pāṭam ceytu vaikkappaṭukiṟatu. pala varuṭaṅkaḷ maṉappāṭam paṇṇiṉapiṉ vicārikkum vivēkikaḷukkup pala irakaciyaṅkaḷ veḷiyākum. maṟṟavarkaḷ, kēṭṭataiyē collum kiḷippiḷḷaipōlat tāṅkaḷ paṭittavaikaḷai māttiram collik koṇṭu niṟpārkaḷ. ippaṭippaṭṭa kiḷippiḷḷaikaḷ intiyāvil ērāḷam. Diatonic Scale, Tempered Scale eṉṟāl teriyātu. āṉāl pūrvamāy ulaka carittiram uṇṭāvataṟku muṉṉālēyē atāvatu Haeckele eṉṉum tattuvacāstiri ‘cumār 20,000 varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉālēyē lemūriyā nāṭṭiluḷḷōr cakala kalaikaḷilum tērntiruntārkaḷ’ eṉpataṟ kiṇaṅka tamiḻmakkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta curamum curutiyum cama iṭaiveḷi kaḷuṭaiyavaikaḷāyirukkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum cama iṭaiveḷikaḷuṭaiya muṟaippaṭiyē nāḷatu varaiyum karnāṭaka caṅkītam pāṭappaṭṭu varukiṟa teṉṟum ataṉ citaivāka maṟṟum pala tēcattil ac curaṅkaḷaiyē pāṭik koṇṭirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟum nāṉ aṟikiṟēṉ.
intiyāviluḷḷa caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷ paḷḷikkūṭattilallāmal paramparaiyāyk kēṭṭup paṭippatē vaḻakkamāyiruppatiṉāl taṅkaḷaip pōṉṟavarkaḷ nūlaṟivaik kēṭkumpoḻutu patil collat teriyātavar kaḷāyiruntālum tāṅkaḷ kēṭkum ivvaṟpa kēḷvikku mēṟpaṭṭa aṉupōka muṭaiyavarkaḷā yirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟu nāṉ tuṇintu colvēṉ. carkkarai, carkkarai eṉṟu ōyāmal collik koṇṭiruppatāl nāvu tittikkumā? oruvaṉ nūl aṟivu peritu eṉpāṉ. maṟṟoruvaṉ aṉupōkam peritu eṉpāṉ. ivviraṇṭu muṭaimaiyē ciṟantatu.
aṉupōkattil tērntavarkaḷākiya pala kavāykaḷum, karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷum vantiruntārkaḷ. taṅkaḷaippōl Major tone, Minor tone, Tempered Scale, Diatonic scale eṉṟu collat terintavarkaḷum palar vantiruntārkaḷ. taṅkaḷaippōl 2/3, 3/4 aip perukki ataṉ mūlamāyk kiṭaikkum piṉṉa eṇkaḷai ‘ippaṭittāṉ varavēṇṭu’ meṉṟu collum kaṇitavallōrum vantiruntārkaḷ. appaṭik kūṭiyirukkum camayattil ‘uṅkaḷil ettaṉai peyarukkuc curaṅkaḷaip pakuttaṟiyum cakti uṇL. uṅkaḷil yār yārukku Major tone, Minor tone teriyum. terintavarkaḷ irukkalām maṟṟavarkaḷ pōyviṭalām’ eṉṟu colliyiruppīrkaḷāṉāl 8/9, 9/10, 4/5, 5/6 pōṉṟa nuṭpa iṭaiveḷikaḷai aṟintavarkaḷ iṉṉāreṉṟu teḷivākat terintu koḷḷalāmē.
capaiyil vantirunta aṟivāḷikaḷaip pārttu ippaṭic colvatai nāṉ mikavum aṉpōṭu āṣēpikkiṟēṉ. maṟṟavarkaḷai aṟpamāy eṇṇum inta vārttaikaḷ taṅkaḷukkē tirumpa varumē eṉṟu mikavum vicaṉappaṭukiṟēṉ. aṅku vantirunta capaiyil nāṉ oruvaṉāka eṇṇap paṭuvataṟkut takutiyuḷḷavaṉō eṉṟu kavalaippaṭukiṟēṉ. takutiyuḷḷavaṉāka tāṅkaḷ niṉaippīrkaḷāṉāl nāṉ eḻuti vanta mūṉṟu viyācaṅkaḷil tavaṟutal eṭuttukkāṭṭa vēṇṭum. illaiyāṉāl tāṅkaḷ coṉṉa vārttaikku nāṉ cammatikkavillai. ippaṭiyē vantirunta palar mikunta curañāṉamum aṉupōkamum uṭaiyavarkaḷ. eṉṉai eppaṭic coṉṉālum paravāyillai. maṟṟavarkaḷaippaṟṟi nīṅkaḷ colluvatai nāṉ virumpa villai. ippaṭit teriyātavarkaḷ muṉ taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattai araṅ kēṟṟa eppaṭit tuṇintīrkaḷ? taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyam kuṟaikiṟateṉṟu tāṅkaḷē oppuk koḷumpaṭic ceytavarkaḷ curañāṉamuḷḷavarkaḷ allavō? ivviṣayattil nāṉ atikam colla virumpavillai. ippaṭic capaiyiluḷḷa yāvarum kūṭit taḷḷumpaṭiyāṉa apippihyattaik koṇṭu vanta tāṅkaḷ ataṟku nēr virōtamāyc collukiṟatu ‘tirāṭcap paḻam puḷikkum’ eṉṟa nariyiṉ kataipōlirukkiṟatu. tāṅkaḷum ammuṟai pōl naṭantu koṇṭīrkaḷēyoḻiya vēṟillai.
7. “taṅkaḷuṭaiya kuḻantaikaḷiṉ kāṉattaippaṟṟi iraṇṭoru vārttaikaḷ. avarkaḷ pāṭiyatu uṅkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyattai nilai niṟuttiṉatāka niṉaikkiṟīrkaḷ.”
‘taṅkaḷ kuḻantaikaḷ pāṭiyatu taṅkaḷ apippirāyattai nilai niṟuttiṉatāka niṉaikkiṟīrkaḷ’ eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ eḻutukiṟīrkaḷ. ‘nīṅkaḷ niṉaikkiṟīrkaḷ’ eṉpatai nāṉ pārkkumpoḻutu maṉitarkaḷuṭaiya uḷḷaṅkaḷiṟ pukuntu avarkaḷ apippirāyattaik kaṇṭukoḷḷat tiṟamai yuṭaiyavarkaḷākak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. ippaṭippaṭṭa taṅkaḷukku parōṭāvil vācitta iraṇṭāvatu viyācattil pūrva tamiḻmakkaḷ pāṭi vanta muṟaip paṭiyē taṟkālamum pāṭi varum karnāṭaka caṅkītam irukkiṟateṉṟum atil 7, 12, 24, 48, 96 pōṉṟa curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷum vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum colli utāraṇamāka 67 irākaṅkaḷ kuṟittuk koṭuttiruntēṉ. avaikaḷil capaiyār virumpiyavaṟṟaip pāṭiyum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. avaikaḷukku ēṟpaṭṭa kaṇakkiṉpaṭi vīṇait tantiyiṉ cariyāṉa aḷavil varum curaṅkaḷ iṉṉavai yeṉṟum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. karnāṭaka caṅkītam terinta yāvarum mikap piriyamāyk kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. kaṇakkiṟkaṇṭa aḷaviṉpaṭiyē vīṇaiyiṉ cura stāṉaṅkaḷ amaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. taṟ kālattiṟ pāṭappaṭṭu varum muṟaippaṭiyē yāvarukkum paḻakkamāṉa kīrttaṉaikaḷai atil vācittu vāyiṉālpāṭi nuṭpa curaṅkaḷaik kuṟippiṭṭuk kāṭṭi eṉ apippirāyattaiyē pūrva tamiḻmakkaḷ vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟu coṉṉēṉ. itaiyē pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟu pala ātāramum eṭuttukkāṭṭiṉēṉ. eṉ vākku oṉṟāyum maṉatu vēṟākavumirukkavillai eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ ēṉ kavaṉittup pārkkāmal pōṉīrkaḷ. eṉ maṉa viruppattiṉpaṭi karnāṭaka caṅkītattil etu uṇmaiyāyirukkiṟatō ataiyē capaiyār muṉ vīṇaiyil kāṭṭiṉēṉ. karnāṭaka caṅkītam oṉṟākavum vīṇai vēṟākavumirukkavillai. vīṇai oṉṟākavum kuḻantaikaḷ pāṭiṉa kītam maṟṟoṉṟākavum iruntatillai. nāṅkaḷ pāṭiṉa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷai aṅku vantirunta karnāṭaka vitvacirō maṇikaḷ aṟivārkaḷ. aṇuppicakumāṉāl atai oppukkoḷḷukiṟataṟku avarkaḷ tayārāyiruntatillai. tavaṟiṉāl cummā viṭṭirukkavu māṭṭārkaḷ. cāvēri irākattil varum riṣapattiṉ mutal curuti iṉṉum kuṟaintu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu cariyāyirunta oṉṟai Mr.arināka pūṣaṇamaiyar B.A.,B.L., āṣēpaṉai ceytataiyum atai oppuk koḷḷāmal Mr.ciṭṭi pāppu nāyuṭu avarkaḷum, Mr.cīṉivāca aiyaṅkār B.A.,L.T., avarkaḷum capaiyiluḷḷa maṟṟum cilarum taṭuttataiyum tāṅkaḷ aṟivīrkaḷē.
tuvāvimcati curuti yeṉṟē cātikkavēṇṭumeṉṟu kaṅkaṇaṅkaṭṭik koṇṭu eṉ apippirāyaṅkaḷukku nēr etirttu niṉṟa (eṉ piḷḷaikaḷiṉ upāttiyāyarāṉa) makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷ nāṉ capai muṉ vāy tiṟakkum varaiyum nāṅkaḷ ceyyappōkiṟatu iṉṉa teṉṟu aṟiyātiruntārkaḷ. avar ōyāmaṟ kutarkkam ceyvatai aṟinta cilar parōṭāvukku avaraik kūṭṭik koṇṭu pōkavēṇṭāmeṉṟu eṉṉait taṭuttārkaḷ. āṉāl nāṉum piḷḷaikaḷum ceytu kāṭṭukiṟa curuti muṟaiyai avar kēṭṭuc cariyeṉṟu colvatai nāṉ peritāka niṉaittēṉ. ēṉeṉṟāl ‘parōṭāvil kāṉpareṉs naṭakkiṟatu. tivāṉ cākip makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavāv avarkaḷ varumpaṭi eḻuti yirukkiṟārkaḷ. kaṭṭāyam nām pōkavēṇṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu’ eṉṟu nāṉ collumpoḻutu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷ ‘ām, ām, karnāṭaka caṅkītam teriyāta vaṭanāṭṭil rāja capaiyil taṅkaḷ apip pirāyattai araṅkēṟṟiviṭṭāl ataikkoṇṭu ivviṭattuk kāṉpa reṉsilum cātittu viṭalām’ eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. nāṉ ceyyappōkiṟatu iṉṉateṉṟu aṟiyātataṉāl ippaṭic coṉṉārkaḷ. eppaṭiyiruntālum avarkaḷaiyē cāṭciyāka vaittuk koṇṭu eṉ apippirāyaṅkaḷai capai muṉ terivikkat tīrmāṉittēṉ.
avarkaḷ eṉ piḷḷaikaḷ paṭippataiyum - eṉ apippirāyattaiyum mikak kavaṉamāyk kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. kūṭṭam muṭintavuṭaṉ taṅkaḷ apippirāyam eppaṭi? uṅkaḷ maṉattiṟku tiruptiyāyiruntatā? eṉṟu nāṉ kēṭṭapoḻutu ‘nāṉ aḻutukoṇṭu irukka vēṇṭiyavaṉ, capai muṉ eṉṉait tairiyap paṭuttik koṇṭiruntēṉ. eṉakku vēṟoṉṟum tōṉṟavillai. eḻuntiruntu kuḻantaikaḷai namaskāram ceyyavēṇṭu meṉṟu eṉakkut tōṉṟiṟṟu’ eṉṟu uḷḷam niṟainta aṉpuṭaṉ collip piḷḷaikaḷai ācīrvatittārkaḷ. appōtu “ellām taṅkaḷuṭaiya kirupaitāṉ ellām tāṅkaḷ collikkoṭutta kīrttaṉaṅkaḷiliruntē pāṭikkāṭṭiṉōm” eṉṟu colli cantōṣamaṭaintōm.
iṉṉicaiyaik kēṭṭirunta kallum karaiyumē? taṅkaḷ maṉatiṟku māttiram vittiyācamāṉa apippirāyam tōṉṟuvatai niṉaikka niṉaikka nāṉ mikavum āccariyappaṭukiṟēṉ. vīṇaiyiṉ iṉiya ōcaiyaik kēṭṭuk kēṭṭu maṉatum iḷaki allatu kāruṇyamuṭaiyatāki vīṇai vācippōr vāyc collum mika mirutuvāki viṭukiṟateṉṟu pūrvama tamiḻmakkaḷ colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ. atai,
		“cevinērpu vaitta ceyvuṟu tivaviṉ
		nalliyāḻ naviṉṟa nayaṉuṭaiya neñciṉ
		meṉmoḻi mēvalar iṉṉaram puḷara.”
eṉṉum aṭikaḷāl aṟiyalām.
caṅkītattiṉ curuti viṣayamāka ārāycci ceytu varum tāṅkaḷ ippaṭi māṟutalāṉa apippirāyap paṭuvāṉēṉ. eṉ apippirāyam vēṟu kuḻantaikaḷiṉ vāyppāṭṭu vēṟā yirukkiṟateṉṟu nāṉ aṟintēṉāṉāl capaimuṉ vantirukkamāṭṭēṉ. vīṇaiyiṉ nātam vēṟu taṟkāla aṉupōkam vēṟāyirukkiṟateṉṟu nāṉ aṟivēṉāṉāl taṅkaḷaip pōl tuṇikaramāy capaimuṉ vantirukka māṭṭēṉ. ārmōṉiyam kuṟaikiṟa teṉṟu tōlviyuṭaṉ pōyirukkavu māṭṭēṉ. apippirāyam vēṟu, ārmōṉiyattiṉ curaṅkaḷ vēṟu, taṟkāla aṉupōkam vēṟāyirunta taṅkaḷ aṉu pōkattiṉpaṭiyē eṉṉaiyum niṉaittu viṭṭīrkaḷ. aṉupōkam vēṟu eṇṇam vēṟāyirukkum enta muṟaiyum ulakattil muṉṉukku varamāṭṭā teṉṟu nāṉ aṟivēṉ.
karnāṭaka caṅkītattil etu aṉupōkattilirukkiṟatō, ataiyē vīṇaiyil aḷantu kāṭṭiṉēṉ. vīṇaiyiṟ kaṇṭa ōcaiyiṉpaṭiyē piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭiṉārkaḷ. eṉ karuttu iṉṉateṉṟu eṉ piḷḷaikaḷ aṟivārkaḷ. nāṉ koṇṭu vantirunta vīṇaiyum aṟiyum. appōtu kūṭa irunta kuḻantaikaḷiṉ upāttiyāyarāṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷum cila karnāṭaka vitvacirōmaṇikaḷum, Mrs. Atya Begum Fyzee Rahiminavarkaḷum, cākruṭīṉ cāyapum maṟṟum aṅku vantirunta vaṭatēcattuk kaṉavāṉkaḷil mikutiyāṉavarkaḷum aṟivārkaḷ. taṅkaḷukkut teriyāmal pōṉataippaṟṟi nāṉ āccariyappaṭavillai. ēṉeṉṟāl intustāṉ irākaṅkaḷait tavira karnāṭaka caṅkītattaik kaṉavilum tāṅkaḷ kēṭṭirukka māṭṭīrkaḷ. āṉāl intustāṉ caṅkītattai eṭuttu niṟutta nīṅkaḷ ceytu koṇṭu vanta ārmōṉiyattiṉ curaṅkaḷ taṟkālam aṉu pōkattilirukkum intustāṉ irākaṅkaḷiṉ curaṅkaḷukku ottirukka villai eṉṟu capaiyōrāl tīrmāṉikkappaṭṭatu.
āṉāl ākasṭumātam 19m tēti naṭanta tañcai caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattil karnāṭaka vitva cirōmaṇikaḷ muṉṉilaiyilum kaṇitam tērnta Professor kaḷ muṉṉilaiyilum tamiḻmoḻi valla pulavarkaḷ muṉṉilaiyilum piraciṭeṉṭ V.P.mātavarāv avarkaḷ muṉṉi laiyilum colli pūrva tamiḻ nūlkaḷiṉ ātāramum kāṭṭik kaṇakkiṉ paṭiyē vīṇaiyiṉ aḷavum kāṭṭi vīṇaiyil varum nātattiṉpaṭiyē pāṭiyum kāṭṭiya eṉ apippirāyam palarālum oppukkoḷḷappaṭṭirukkiṟatu. oru stāyiyil 2/3, 2/3 ākavum, 3/4, 3/4 ākavum pōvatil kiṭaikkum curaṅkaḷ cariyāṉavaikaḷ alla eṉṟum oru stāyiyil 22 alla irupattu nāṉkākavē varavēṇṭumeṉṟum eṉ apippirāyattaic cātittuk kāṭṭiṉēṉ. piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭikkāṭṭiyatum eṉ apippirāyamum oṉṟē yoḻiya vēṟillai. pūraṇa curañāṉamuḷḷa vitvacirōmaṇikaḷē itai aṟivārkaḷ. maṟṟavar aṟiyamāṭṭār.
8. “intiya caṅkītam eppōtum oru curattaiyum ataṉ pañcamattaiyum captittukkoṇṭu (tampurāvai mīṭṭuvatupōl) pāṭukiṟa vaḻakkamāyiṟṟē. uṅkaḷ kuḻantaikaḷ appaṭiyēṉ collavillai. avarkaḷ eppōtum iraṇṭu tampurākkaḷai mīṭṭikkoṇṭē pāṭaṭṭum. appaṭip pāṭuvār kaḷāṉāl kētāra kauḷam caṅkarāparaṇam mutaliya irākaṅkaḷil uṅkaḷuṭaiya kāntārattai yalla caṭjattukku 11/4 āy irukkappaṭṭa kāntārattaip pāṭuvārkaḷ. aṉumattōṭiyil caṭjamattukku 13/5 āy uḷḷa taivatattaiyum naṭapairaviyil caṭjamattukku 11/5 āy uḷḷa kāntārattaiyum paṭippārkaḷ. tokaiyāyc colla vēṇṭumāṉāl appōtutāṉ cariyāṉa caṅkītam paṭippārkaḷ.”
intiya caṅkītattil tampurāvai vaittup pāṭukiṟatu pōl uṅkaḷ kuḻantaikaḷ pāṭavillai eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. atāvatu taṅkaḷ carīrattiṟ kēṟṟa vitamāy caṭcamamum ataṉ piṉ ataṟkup pañcamamum mēl caṭcamamum cērttukkoṇṭu ataṟkēṟṟa vitamāy ēṉ pāṭavillai eṉṟu kēṭkiṟīrkaḷ. appōtutāṉ cariyāṉa caṅkītam paṭippārkaḷ eṉṟum collukiṟīrkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ niṉaikkiṟapaṭiyē nāṅkaḷ paḻakiyirukkiṟōm. ammuṟaippaṭitāṉē capai muṉpāṭik kāṭṭiṉōm. atai aṟintu koḷḷa muṭiyāmal pāṭiyatu vēṟu eṉṟu kuṟṟam collukiṟīrkaḷ.  vīṇaiyiṉ nālu tantikaḷilum ca-pa muṟaiyāy curaṅkaḷ niṟkavillaiyā? vīṇaiyiṉ pakkattil curutikkāka irukkum mūṉṟu tantikaḷil ca-pa-ca vāka curuti cērkkappaṭukiṟatē. pāṭum kīrttaṉaṅkaḷukkēṟṟa tāḷaṅkaḷil ca-pa-ca eṉṟu pakkattu tantikaḷ mīṭṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉavē. vīṇaiyiṉ pakkattut tantikaḷ curuti mīṭṭum tampurāvākavum tāḷam mīṭṭum tantikaḷākavum amaikkap peṟṟirukkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu tāṅkaḷ aṟiyāmal pōṉīrkaḷē! pāṭukiṟa oruvaṉ tāṉ pāṭum poḻutum vīṇaiyiṉ curastāṉaṅkaḷ pēcum poḻutum apacuramuṇṭākāmal tiruttik koḷvataṟku avai utaviyā yirukkiṉṟaṉavē. immuṟaiyaiyē piḷḷaikaḷ curutiyōṭu pāṭiṉārkaḷ. itaip pakkattiliruntu kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntum aṟiyāmal eṅkēyō veku tūram kāṭṭil alaintu inta yuktiyaip piṭittuk koṇṭuvantu viṭṭīrkaḷ. ivvaḷavu yukti collum taṅkaḷukku nāṉ eṉṉa colliyum pirayōcaṉappaṭumō eṉṟu cantēkappaṭukiṟēṉ. nāṅkaḷ paṭittatu cariyāṉa caṅkītamtāṉ. tāṅkaḷ ēṟpaṭuttik koṇṭu vanta intiya ārmōṉiyattiṉ paṭi apacuraṅkaḷil pāṭappaṭumāṉāl atu inta caṅkītattaik keṭukkavanta oru kōṭari eṉṟu niccayamākac colluvēṉ. appaṭiyē āl intiya miyūcik kāṉpareṉs capaiyārum aruvaruttup payantu taḷḷiṉārkaḷ. ataippārttirunta nāṉum tirumpac colla vēṇṭiyatillai eṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ.
9. “nāmāyk kūṭak kuṟaiya vaittuk koḷḷum curaṅkaḷālāṉa caṅkītam aruvaruppāṉatu.”
nāmāyk kūṭak kuṟaittu vaittukkoḷḷum curaṅkaḷālāṉa caṅkītam aruvaruppāṉatu eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ eḻutukiṟīrkaḷ. uḷḷapaṭiyē atu aruvaruppilum makā aruvaruppāṉatu eṉṟu nāṉum oppukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ. tāṅkaḷ tāṉē appaṭic ceykiṟīrkaḷ. 20, 22, 27, 63, 71, 84, 90, 92 ceṉṭskaḷ iṭaiveḷiyākac curaṅkaḷ varavēṇṭumeṉṟu taṅkaḷ kaṇakkiṉāl terikiṟatu. ivaikaḷ paṭippaṭiyāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu tīviramāy naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākāmal oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ varum eṉṟu coṉṉa caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟaikku ottirukkiṟatā? muṉṉōruṭaiya apippirāyaṅkaḷai muṟṟilum māṟṟi ataṟku virōtamākat tāṅkaḷ kūṭṭik kuṟaittu vaittuk koḷḷum curaṅkaḷē aruvaruppāṉavai. tāṅkaḷ eḻutiya Introduction to the study of  Indian Music eṉṟa puttakattil Srutis of modern Hindustani Music eṉṟa talaippiṉ kīḻ ēḻāvatu, eṭṭāvatu pakkaṅkaḷil curutikaḷukkuc colliya vaiparēṣaṉ kaṇakkiṉāl avaikaḷ teḷivākat terikiṉṟaṉa. 320, 324, 3371/2, 3411/3, 360, 378, 384, 400, 405, 420, 4262/3 eṉṟa vaiparēṣaṉkaḷukku eṉṉa oṟṟumaiyirukkiṟatu? caṅkīta ratṉākarar apip pirāyamā? allatu ataṟku muntiya paratariṉ apippirāyamā? caṅkīta ratṉākarariṉ apippirāyattai aṟinta tāṅkaḷ ippaṭic ceytāl maṟṟavar eṉṉa ceyyamāṭṭār? caṅkīta ratṉākarar curuti cērkkum viṣayamāy taṅkaḷ pustakattil eṉṉa collukiṟīrkaḷeṉṟu aṭiyil varum cila varikaḷiṟ pārppōm.

THE SANGIT RATNAKAR
(ANANDASHRAMA SERIES POONA)
SVARADHYAYA (PRAKARAN 3)
“Verses 3 to 11 are taken up with an attempt to explain the phenomena of sound.
Verse 12 : - Take two Vinas with 22 wires each and tune as follows. Let the first wire give the lowest possible note, the next a note a little higher and so on, so that between the notes given by two adjacent wires a third note is impossible.
Verses 13 to 16 :- These successive notes are the srutis. Sa will stand on the fourth wire being a svara of four srutis; Ri will be on the third wire counting from the fifth; Ga which has only two srutis, will fall on the second counting from the eighth; Ma being of four srutis, on the fourth, counting from the tenth; Pa on the fourth, counting from the fourteenth; Dha on the hird after Pa; Ni on the second after Dha; so Ni will fall on the twenty-second sruti.
caṅkīta ratṉākaram
pūṉā āṉantāsrama cīris
cuvara attiyāyam (pirakaraṉ 3)
“3 mutal 11 aṭikaḷ varai :- captam eṉpatiṉ tōṟṟattaip paṟṟic colliyatu”
12-vatu aṭi : - ovvoṉṟum 22 tantikaḷuḷḷa iraṇṭu vīṇaikaḷai eṭuttukkoḷ. mutal tantiyil kūṭiyavaraiyil ārampamāka uḷḷa svarattai vaittukkoḷ. aṭutta tantiyil aṭutta svaram pēcaṭṭum. ippaṭi mēlē cel. enta iraṇṭu tantikaḷai eṭuttukkoṇṭālum avaikaḷ iraṇṭiṟkum naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākātapaṭi avaikaḷai amaittukkoḷ.
13-16 aṭikaḷ :- ippaṭi oṉṟaṉ piṉ oṉṟāy olikkum nātaṅkaḷ tāṉ curutikaḷ. caṭjam nālu curuti koṇṭatāl nālāvatu tantiyil atu pēcum. aintāvatiliruntu kaṇakkiṭṭāl mūṉṟāvatu tantiyil riṣapam pēcum. kāntāram iraṇṭu curutiyāṉatāl eṭṭāvatiliruntu iraṇṭāvatu tantiyil atu pēcum. mattimam 4 curutiyāṉatāl pattāvatiliruntu nālāvatu tantiyil atu pēcum. appaṭiyē pañcamam patiṉālāvatiliruntu nālāvatu tantiyil pēcum. taivatam pañcamattiṟku mēl mūṉṟāvatu tantiyilum niṣātam taivatattiliruntu iraṇṭāvatu tantiyilum pēcum. appaṭiyāṉāl niṣātam 22āvatu curutiyākap pēcum.”
itaṉāl oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum avaikaḷ ārampa curattiliruntu paṭippaṭiyāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu tīviramāy naṭuvil vēṟu nātamuṇṭākāmal ōcaiyil cama aḷavāyirukka vēṇṭu meṉṟum teḷivākak kāṇkiṟōm.
Introduction to the study of Indian music Page 22.
“The ancient theorists of India had no knowledge of harmonic ratios; to them to interval termed a sruti appeared to be the smallest interval which the human voice was capable of singing; consequently, they assumed roughly that their 22 srutis divided the octave into equal parts.”
“intiyāviṉ pūrva caṅkīta nūlāciriyarkaḷukku Harmonic ratios eṉṟāl iṉṉa teṉṟē teriyātu. maṉita cārīrattāl pāṭakkūṭiya nuṭpamāṉa iṭai veḷi etuvō ataiyē curuti iṭaiveḷiyeṉṟu niṉaittārkaḷ. ākai yāl avarkaḷ oru stāyiyāṉatu ēṟakkuṟaiya 22 cama pākaṅkaḷuḷḷa curuti kaḷākap pirikkappaṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟu amaittuk koṇṭārkaḷ.”
itaṉāl oru stāyiyai camapākaṅkaḷuḷḷa curutikaḷāka atāvatu cama ōcaiyuḷḷatāka 22 curutikaḷ varavēṇṭumeṉṟu amaittukkoṇṭārkaḷ eṉṟum 2/3, 3/4 āl kiṭaikkum Harmonic ratios avarkaḷukkut teriyā teṉṟum veḷiyākiṟatu. atu uṇmaiyē. ñalavāyapaḻcayaḷa pōṉṟavar kaḷukkup piṉṉāl ip puraḷiyuṇṭāyiṟṟu. itu cuttamāṉa caṅkītattiṟkuc caṉiyaṉāka vantirukkiṟatu. itu illāmaṟ pōṉāl uṅkaḷukkum eṉakkum ittaṉai nēramum kaṭutāciyum celavāyirukkātu.

“According to Sarangdev’s theory of the equality of the srutis.”
“curutikaḷ camapākaṅkaḷuḷḷavaiyā yirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu collukiṟa cāraṅkatēvar muṟaippaṭi”
curutikaḷ camapākaṅkaḷuḷḷavaiyāyirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu tāṅkaḷum oppukkoḷḷukiṟīrkaḷeṉṟu teḷivākat terikiṟatu.
The Hindu Musical scale and the twenty two Srutis.
“Now as observed by Professor Pietro Blaserna, of the Royal university of Rome, in his valuable treatise on the “Theory of sound in its relation to Music,” by a musical scale is meant “the collection of all the notes comprised between the fundamental note and its octave which succeed each other and are intended to succeed each other with a certain pre-established regularity.”
“Theory of sound in its relation to musiceṉṟa nūlai eḻutiya Professor Blaserna of the royal university of Rome  collukiṟateṉṉaveṉṟāl, caṅkīta skēlāvatu ātāracurattiṟkum ataṉ ākṭēvukkum iṭaiyiluḷḷa curattoṭarcci. itil curaṅkaḷ eppaṭi oṉṟaṉpiṉ oṉṟāy varavēṇṭumeṉṟāl avaikaḷ ovvoṉṟiṟkum iṭaiyil muṉ nirṇayikkappaṭṭa oruvita oḻuṅku irukka vēṇṭum.”
itil curutikaḷ oṉṟaṉpiṉ oṉṟāy oḻuṅkāṉa iṭaiveḷikaḷōṭu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu teḷivāyt terikiṟatu.
Introduction to the study of Indian music Page 21.
“To avoid misapprehension, it will be advisable to premise that a scale is a collection of notes ranging from a given note to the note an octave above and resembling a ladder in this respect, that array (“that”) of notes must afford a practical means of ascent and descent.
“piṉṉālē nāṉ colluvataic cariyāyk kirakikkāmal tappip pōkātapaṭikku, nāṉ muṉṉatākavē colli vaikkiṟateṉṉaveṉṟāl, oru skēlāṉatu eṭuttukkoṇṭa oru curattiṉiṉṟu ataṉmēl ākṭēl varaikku uḷḷa pala cura aṭukkukaḷālāṉatu. intac cura aṭukkukaḷ oru ēṇiyaip pōṉṟavai. atiluḷḷa curaṅkaḷ lēcāy ēṟuvataṟkum iṟaṅkuvataṟkumāṉa vakaiyāy amaikkappaṭṭirukka vēṇṭum.”
itil taṅkaḷ pustakattai vācikkiṟavarkaḷukkut tavaṟutalāṉa apip pirāyam uṇṭākātirukkumpaṭi tāṅkaḷ ecrittuc collukiṟatu eṉṉa veṉṟāl ‘oru stāyiyil varum cura aṭukkukaḷāṉavai culapamāka ēṟuvataṟkum iṟaṅkuvataṟkum kūṭiyatāy oru ēṇiyaip pōlirukka vēṇṭum’ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ koṭuttirukkum cura aḷavukaḷ oru ēṇippaḻuvukku ottirukkiṉṟaṉavā? ēṇiyiṉ kiramattai aṟiyāta varkaḷ illai. oru ēṇiyaic ceyyum oru paṭṭikkāṭṭu ācāri mutal mutal ēṇikkuriya iraṇṭu maraṅkaḷait terintu koṇṭu ovvoru paṭiyum oṉpatu aṅkulamāy, allatu pattu aṅkulamāy allatu patiṉoṉṟu paṉṉiraṇṭu aṅkulamāy varavēṇṭumeṉṟum ataṟkut tuḷai ataṉmēl oru aṅkulam allatu 11/2 aṅkulam varavēṇṭumeṉṟum orē kucciyil kuṟittukkoṇṭu (9+11/2) atupōl periya mūṅkilil kuṟittukkoṇṭē pōkiṟāṉ. mutaṟ paḻuviṟkum kaṭaici paḻuviṟkum muṉṉum piṉṉum 3/4 aṭikkuk kuṟaiyāmal viṭṭut tuṇṭu paṇṇukiṟāṉ. ataṉpiṉ tāṉ kuṟittapaṭi 9 aṅkulam iṭaiveḷiyākavum 11/2 aṅkulam tuḷaiyākavum vaittut tuḷaiyaṭitta piṉ maṟṟoru mūṅkilait tuḷaiyaṭittatiṉ pakkattil vaittu mūlaimaṭṭap palakai yiṉāl ataṟkuc camamāka aṭaiyāḷam ceytu koñcamāvatu kūṭutal kuṟaital illāmal tuḷaiyaṭittup paḻumāṭṭukiṟāṉ. ēṉeṉṟāl avaikaḷ muṉ piṉṉāka irukkumāṉāl ēṟuvatum iṟaṅkuvatum kaṣṭa mākum. ēṇiyum cīkkiram keṭṭup pōkum. ēṟukiṟavarkaḷ vaḻukki viḻuvārkaḷ.
iv vuvamāṉam coṉṉa tāṅkaḷ, taṅkaḷ curuti muṟaikkuk koṭukkum vaiparēṣaṉiṉ kaṇakkai camamāyirukkiṟatā eṉṟu ottup pārkkavillai eṉṟu terikiṟatu. taṅkaḷ puttakam 8vatu pakkattil patiṉmūṉṟāvatu curutiyiliruntu irupattiraṇṭu varaiyilum patiṉoru curutikaḷ collappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivaikaḷil tāṅkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭitta nūtaṉamāṉa iraṇṭu curutikaḷum 324, 420 eṉṟa vaiparēṣaṉōṭu varukiṉṟaṉa. ivai tāṅkaḷ terintu koḷḷum aintu mattimaṅkaḷil mūṉṟāvatākavum tāṅkaḷ vaittuk koḷḷum aintu niṣātaṅkaḷil mutal niṣātamākavum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivaikaḷiṉ ōcaiyiṉ alaikaḷiṉ kaṇakkai nām kavaṉippōmāṉāl 320 kkum 324 kkum pētam 4 ōcaiyiṉ alaikaḷum 324 kkum 3371/2 kkum pētam 13.5 ōcaiyiṉ alaikaḷum ippaṭiyē 5. 9, 18, 6, 16, 5, 15, 6.67, 5.31, 18.4, pōṉṟa varicaikaḷum kiṭaikkiṉṟaṉa. ivvaḷavu pētamāṉa ōcaikaḷum ēṇip paḻukkaḷum varumāṉāl ēṟi iṟaṅka mikac culapamākumā? mēṟ kaṇṭa oḻuṅkīṉamāṉa aḷaviṉpaṭi oru ācāri ēṇi ceytu koṇṭu vantu koṭuttāl nīṅkaḷ cummā viṭuvīrkaḷā? eṉṉa pāṭu paṭuttuvīrkaḷ? ēṇi ceyta ācārikku oru niyāyamum oḻuṅkīṉamāṉa curutikaḷaic collum taṅkaḷukku oru niyāyamumā? caṟṟu nitāṉittup pāruṅkaḷ.
ivaikaḷ nāṉ parōṭāvil vācitta iraṇṭāvatu puttakattil 37, 38m pakkaṅkaḷiluḷḷa aṭṭavaṇaiyil 7āvatu kalattil pattāvatu variyiliruntu kavaṉippīrkaḷāṉāl teḷivākat teriyum. curutikaḷ mēl pōkap pōka Geometrical Progression paṭi koñcam koñcam kūṭutal aṭaiyum eṉpatait tāṅkaḷ aṟivīrkaḷ. atikam terinta tāṅkaḷ aṭṭavaṇaiyil teḷivākak kaṇṭu koḷḷalām. ௸ aṭṭavaṇaiyil kaṇṭa kaṇitamuṟaippaṭiyē vīṇaiyil aḷantu curastāṉaṅkaḷ kuṟittu capai muṉ pāṭiṉēṉ. avai karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷumākavē yiruntaṉa. aṅku vantirunta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷil oruvarāvatu pāṭal tavaṟutalāyirukkiṟateṉṟāvatu vīṇaiyiṉ ōcai tavaṟutalāyirukkiṟa teṉṟāvatu piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭiya kīrttaṉam tavaṟutalāyirukkiṟa teṉṟāvatu collavillai. taṅkaḷait tavira capaiyār yāvarum āṉantittārkaḷ. taṅkaḷ kātukkuḷ aruvarukkappaṭṭa ārmōṉiyattiṉ apacuramiruntapaṭiyāl taṅkaḷ kātiṟku māttiram atu aruvaruppāyiruntatu.
Equal Temperament muṟai iṉṉateṉṟum atu 120, 150 varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉāl Mozart, Beethoven eṉpavarkaḷāl kaṇṭu piṭikkappaṭṭateṉṟum atu maṟṟavarkaḷāl ēḷaṉam ceyyappaṭukiṟa teṉṟum perumpālum aṉēka vitvāṉkaḷukkut teriyātu. itaṉāl eṉṉa tōṣam? āṉāl pallāyira varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉ pāṭi vanta irākaṅkaḷil vaḻaṅkum curaṅkaḷaiyum, curutikaḷaiyum aṇuppiramāṇamum tavaṟāmal kēṭṭup pāṭam paṇṇip paṭikkakkūṭiyavarkaḷ eṉpatil yātoru āṣēpaṉaiyumillai. āṉāl nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷil pala curaṅkaḷōṭu cērntu varum poḻutu avaikaḷai iṉṉateṉṟu colla muṭiyāmal pōṉatiṉāl kuṟai collukiṟīrkaḷ. karnāṭaka caṅkītattaip paṟṟit taṅkaḷukkut teriyātataṉāl ippaṭic collukiṟīrkaḷ. intustāṉ caṅkītattaic colla vanta tāṅkaḷ karnāṭaka caṅkītattaik kuṟai collāmaliruntāl taṅkaḷai intustāṉ caṅkītattilāvatu tērntavarkaḷeṉṟu niṉaikka iṭamuṇL.
tāṅkaḷ koṇṭu vanta ārmōṉiyam intustāṉ curattiṟkum ataippōluḷḷa karnāṭaka curattiṟkum ottuvarāmal pōṉapiṉ atai intiya ārmōṉiyam eṉṟu collalāmā? apacuram niṟainta taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattil vācittup paḻakiya nimittam iṉimaiyuḷḷateṉṟu yāvarālum koṇṭāṭappaṭṭa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ taṅkaḷukku aruvaruppāyt tōṉṟiṉa.
taṅkaḷ curaṅkaḷ cama aḷavuṭaiyavaikaḷāyt tāṅkaḷ collukiṟapaṭi oru ēṇiyaippō lirukkumāṉāl appōtu oru stāyiyil Geometrical Progression paṭi 24 curutikaḷē kiṭaikkum eṉṟum atil ca-pa muṟaippaṭiyum, ca-ma muṟaippaṭiyum paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷ 24 curutikaḷ, maṟṟum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷum amaiyum eṉṟum tiṭṭamāyk kāṇpīrkaḷ. iṉṉum oru taṭavai kāṉpareṉsukku varumpoḻutu eṇkaṇakkiṉpaṭiyē taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattait tiruttik koṇṭu varumpaṭiyākak kēṭṭuk koḷḷu kiṟēṉ. appōtu eṉ muṟai cariyeṉṟu oppuk koḷvīrkaḷ. nāṉākak kūṭak kuṟaittu vaittuk koḷḷavillai. tamiḻ kkaḷ pāṭi vanta caṅkītattil varum ōcaikaḷum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷum varum iṭaṅkaḷai pala varuṭaṅkaḷāka vicārittu ataṉ piṉ ataṟkuk kaṇakku ēṟpaṭuttiṉēṉ.
10. “iṉṉum cila nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷukkuḷ airōppāvil atu muṟṟilum illāmaṟ pōkumeṉṟu nāṉ niccayamāyt tīrkkataricaṉamāy uraippēṉ. atil kuṟaikaḷum tappukaḷum atikam iruntapōtilum anēka kāriyaṅkaḷ oṉṟu cērnta airōppāvil atu stāpakamāṉatu. Indian Education eṉṟa pattirikaiyil Sep-to Nov.1915 namparkaḷil itu viṣayattaip paṟṟip pēci yirukkiṟēṉ. atai vācippīrkaḷāṉāl nalamāyirukkum. nāṉ collivanta kāriyattaip paṟṟit tirumpac collukiṟēṉ. nīṅkaḷ naṉṟāy vicārittāl teriyum.”
iṉṉum cila nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷukkuḷ Equal Temperament muṟaiyillāmal pōkum eṉṟu tīrkka taricaṉam collukiṟīrkaḷ. inta tīrkkataricaṉam orupōtum niṟaivēṟātu. mēṟṟicaiyil ca-pa muṟaiyāy ārmōṉiyam, piyāṉā mutaliyavaikaḷil curuti cērkkum poḻutu oru stāyiyil 12 curaṅkaḷ kiṭaikkiṉṟaṉa. ivaikaḷai Equal Temperament muṟaiyeṉṟu collukiṟārkaḷ. tantiyil 2/3 āka vaikkumpoḻutu kiṭaikkum ōcaikaḷukku Harmonic series  eṉṟu peyar vaittārkaḷ. uḷḷapaṭi ḻayacaaṭilē uṭaiyatai Equal Temperament eṉṟu ēḷaṉam ceytārkaḷ. Harmonic series  paṭi cellum poḻutu oru stāyi carivara muṭivaṭaiyāmal ovvoru curattilum koñcam koñcam kūṭutal aṭaintu ōnāy ūḷaiyiṭukiṟatupōl aruvaruppuṇṭākiṟateṉṟu caṭcamam pañcamam poruntum muṟaiyil 12 curaṅkaḷai stāpittārkaḷ. pañcamam evvaḷavu kūṭa vēṇṭum evvaḷavu kuṟaiyavēṇṭumeṉṟu kaṇakkuc colvatu kūṭāta kāriyameṉṟum curañāṉattaik koṇṭu tīrkka vēṇṭumeṉṟum muṭittārkaḷ.
The art of tuning the pianoforte by Hermann Smith, Page. 54.
“These trials, as they are called, afford at each step a check by which the correctness of the progress may be indicated, or, unfortunately, probably the incorrectness of your first estimates of “how much” and “how little.”
The last is the severest test, as the two notes of which this fifth is formed have been obtained by different series of fifths, and any imperfection in the gradation of the beatings allotted to the previous fifths will mainfest itself here. Hence this fifth, from the frequent harshness and howlings of its beats, has been technically termed the wolf, and strict injunctions are, “Look out for the wolf” Reckon yourself fortunate if no wolf appears.”
“inta nōṭṭukaḷait tirumpat tirumpa vācittup pārttāl evvaḷavu kūṭṭa vēṇṭum ,evvaḷavu kuṟaikkavēṇṭum eṉpatu tiṭṭamākuvatu mallāmal, nām nōṭṭukaḷaic cariyāṉa curattil vaikkiṟōmō allavō eṉṟum namakku niccayamākum. inta aintāvatu aintavatāy (ca-pa poruttamāy) nōṭṭukaḷai curappaṭuttuvatu tāṉ atika kaṣṭam. ēṉeṉṟāl mutalil itaik koñcam kūṭavaittuviṭuvōmāṉāl atu varavara atikappaṭṭuk kaṭaiciyil peruṅkaṣṭattai viḷaivikkum. inta aintām poruttam kātukku iṉimaiyaittarāmal oru ōnāyiṉ ūḷai yaip pōl aṭikkaṭi iruppatāl ataṟku “ōnāy” eṉṟē peyar. piyāṉāvai ṟyūṉ paṇṇum oruvaṉukkuk koṭukkappaṭṭa mukkiya kaṭṭaḷai eṉṉaveṉṟāl “ōnāy varāmal jākkirataiyāyiru. appaṭi ōnāy varāviṭṭāl nī pākkiyavāṉtāṉ” eṉpatē.”
itil tāṅkaḷ Harmonic series  eṉṟu kaṭṭik koṇṭu avatippaṭum 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa mēlnāṭṭu ōnāyiṉ ūḷaiyaip paṟṟi iṅkē collap paṭukiṟatu. mēṟṟēcaṅkaḷil piṟantu vaḷarnta inta ōnāy uruppaṭi iṉṉa teṉṟu teriyāmal taṅkaḷaik kiḻittut tiṉṟuviṭumēyeṉṟu mikavum aṉutāpappaṭukiṟēṉ.
Harmonic series  iṉṉateṉṟum Equal Temperament muṟai iṉṉateṉṟum nāṉ itaṉ muṉ kavaṉikkavillai. āṉāl pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta icait tamiḻiṉ cila kuṟippukaḷaik koṇṭum nāḷatu varaiyum pāṭappaṭṭu varum aṉupōkattaik koṇṭum tīra vicārittu muṭivāṉa vaikaḷaic coṉṉēṉ. itai māṟṟa niṉaippavarkaḷ caṅkītattiṟkē catturukkaḷāvārkaḷ. nāṉ koṭutta 67 kīrttaṉaikaḷil oru piḻaiyāvatu kāṭṭavēṇṭu meṉṟu pirayācappaṭṭuk kaṭaiciyil ‘aṟupattāṟum cariyā yirukkiṉṟaṉa. taṉṉiyāci kīrttaṉattil māttiram kāntāram kūṭi varukiṟatu’ eṉṟu colli vekunēram vātittum capaiyōrāl taḷḷappaṭṭatupōl tāṅkaḷum iruppīrkaḷ. taṅkaḷ 22 curuti muṟaiyum 25 curuti muṟaiyum aṭutta kāṉpareṉsukkuḷḷākavē māṟippōkum eṉṟu nāṉ niccayamāyc colluvēṉ. itu camayattiṟkēṟṟa vitamāy aruttamākum tīrkka taricaṉamalla.
atōṭu ‘nāṉ collivanta kāriyaṅkaḷait tirumpac collukiṟēṉ nīṅkaḷ naṉṟāy vicārittāl teriyum’ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. Equal Temperament muṟaiyaiyum taṅkaḷ muṟaiyaiyum tēvāl avarkaḷuṭaiya muṟaiyaiyum naṉṟāy vicārittu iraṇṭu varuṭaṅkaḷukku muṉṉālēyē avaikaḷukku maṟuppu eḻutiyirukkiṟēṉ. Indian Education eṉṟa pattirikaiyil eḻutiya viṣayaṅkaḷ taṅkaḷ pustakattai aṉucarittēyirukkum. vēṟu viṣayaṅkaḷirukkumāṉāl eḻuti aṉuppuṅkaḷ. kaṭṭāyam pārkkiṟēṉ.
11. “vēṟē vāttiya utaviyillāmal inta artificial iṭai veḷikaḷaip pāṭukiṟa allatu Violin vācikkiṟa evarum avaikaḷaic cariyāyp pāṭuvatu turlapam. taṅkaḷ kuḻantaikaḷum appaṭiyē tavaṟukiṟārkaḷ.”
piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭiya kīrttaṉaṅkaḷiluḷḷa curaṅkaḷai artificial iṭai veḷikaḷaiyuṭaiyavaiyeṉṟu tāṅkaḷ kuṟaivāṉa vārttaikaḷaic collukiṟīrkaḷ. piṭilil vācippatu kūṭāta kāriyam eṉṟum kuḻantaikaḷum appaṭiyē tavaṟukiṟārkaḷeṉṟum collukiṟīrkaḷ. uṇmai maṟaintu tulaṅkāmal pōṉapiṉ uṇmaiyaic collukiṟavarkaḷ paittiyakkārar tāṉē. uṇmaikku etir niṉṟu pōrāṭukiṟavarkaḷ piṉṉāl pāpikaḷ eṉṟu aḻaikkappaṭukiṟārkaḷ. kuḻantaikaḷ pāṭiṉa caṅkītatattiṟku nāṉ kaṇakkuc coṉṉēṉ. ivviraṇṭum uṇmaiyuṭaiyavaiyeṉṟu maṟṟavarkaḷ kāṇumpoḻutu taṅkaḷai ikaḻvārkaḷēyeṉṟu aṉutāpappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
piḷḷaikaḷ oru stāyiyil varum paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷaiyum 24 curutikaḷaiyum varicaiyāyp pāṭik kāṭṭiṉārkaḷē. atil entac curutiyil evvaḷavu kuṟaintateṉṟu kavaṉittīrkaḷ? pāṭik kāṭṭiyavaikaḷ cama aḷavāṉa ōcaiyuṭaiyavaikaḷā yiruntaṉaveṉṟu nāṉ tiṭamākac colluvēṉ. paratar, caṅkīta ratṉākarar pōṉṟa makāṉkaḷ aṅkiruntāl avarkaḷum taṅkaḷ karuttu ‘itutāṉ, itutāṉ’ eṉṟu koṇṭāṭuvārkaḷ. ‘itu viṣayattil nāṅkaḷ tavaṟippōṉōm’ eṉṟu oppuk koḷvārkaḷ. pallāyira varuṭaṅkaḷākat tamiḻ makkaḷ pāṭik koṇṭirukkum curaṅkaḷai yum curutikaḷaiyum coṉṉēṉē yoḻiya takunta cāstira ātāra millāmal nāṉ oṉṟum collavillai. tāṅkaḷ itai aṟiyāmal pōṉālum maṟṟa yāvarum aṟintukoḷvārkaḷ eṉpatu niccayam.
kōṭai iṭiyiṉ cattamum kēṭkāta ceviṭaṉ kātil caṅku ūti eṉṉa pirayōjaṉam? tāṅkaḷ intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum curuti viṣayamāy niṉaittapaṭi yellām collukiṟateṉṟa kuruṭṭāṭṭamāṉa muṟaiyaip piṭivātamāyc cātikkiṟatāka nāṉ kāṇkiṟēṉ. piṭil vācikkiṟa evarum cama iṭaiveḷikaḷuḷḷa curaṅkaḷai vācippatu turlapam eṉṟum appaṭiyē kuḻantaikaḷum tavaṟukiṟārkaḷeṉṟum eṉṉat tuṇikara māyc collukiṟīrkaḷ. piṭil vācitta upāttiyāyariṉ tiṟamaiyāvatu pāṭiṉa kuḻantaikaḷiṉ tiṟamaiyāvatu taṅkaḷukkut teriyātu. appaṭit teriyāmal pōṉālum capaiyil pāṭiṉapoḻutāvatu curutikaḷai aṇu aṇuvākap pirittuk kāṭṭiya poḻutāvatu kavaṉittu aṟintukoḷḷak kūṭiya cura ñāṉam taṅkaḷukkuk koñcamāvatu illai eṉṟu taṅkaḷ viyācattiṉāl terikiṟatu.
karnāṭaka caṅkītattil mikunta pirakkiyāti peṟṟa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi makā vaittiyanāta aiyar avarkaḷ koṇṭāṭumpaṭiyāṉa curañāṉamuṭaiyavarum kēṭṭavar maṉam urukum vitamāyk katai ceyvatilum cākittiyattilu tāḷattilum vāyppāṭṭilum nāḷatu varai yāvarālum koṇṭāṭappaṭukiṟa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi kiruṣṇa pākavatar avarkaḷ kūṭavē cīṣarāyiruntu avaraippōlavē katai ceyvatilum kāṉam ceyvatilum piṭil vācippatilum tērnta vitva cirōmaṇiyeṉṟu tamiḻnāṭu muṟṟilum koṇṭāṭappaṭṭu varukiṟa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarḷaiyā cariyāyppāṭavillai, tavaṟip pōṉārkaḷ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ? karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷaik kīrttaṉaikaḷil varum muṟaippaṭi aṇuvēṉum tavaṟāmal vāttiya utaviyillāmalē pāṭakkūṭiya tērnta ñāṉamuṭaiyavar. avaruṭaiya kalvit tiṟamaiyai kāṉpareṉsil vantirunta karnāṭaka vitva cirōmaṇikaḷ teḷivāy aṟivārkaḷ. avaruṭaiya cāmarttiyam iṉṉateṉṟu tāṅkaḷ terintukoḷvataṟku piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭiya oru kīrttaṉamē pōtum. ataikkēṭṭu nitāṉikkum curañāṉam taṅkaḷukku illāmaiyiṉāl ippaṭic collukiṟīrkaḷ.
paṉṟi vēṭṭaiyāṭukiṟavarkaḷ nīṇṭa īṭṭiyiṉāl kutti atai vataittu vēṭikkai pārttu cantōṣappaṭuvatupōla capaiyiluḷḷa vitva cirōmaṇikaḷaik kuṟai kūṟi tāṅkaḷ cantōṣap paṭukiṟatākat terikiṟatu. ippaṭip piṟarai avatūṟu colli cantōṣappaṭuvatil tāṅkaḷ atika kai tērntavarkaḷ eṉṟu ovvoru kuṟippiṉālum terikiṟatu. tāṅkaḷ kuṟaicollum piṭil upāttiyāyarukku ivviṣayam iṉṉum collap paṭavillai. ēṉeṉṟāl 22 curutiyaic cātikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu cattiyam ceytukoṇṭa tirukkūṭṭattil cērntu taṉyāciyil varum kāntāram tuvāvimcati curutiyiṉ muṟaippaṭi kuṟaintu varavēṇṭumeṉṟu tāṉ paṭittuk koṭutta kīrttaṉaiyaiyē tāṉ kuṟaittup pāṭa, nāṉ pala niyāyamum colli tāṅkaḷ paṭittukkoṭutta kīrttaṉaṅkaḷai vēṇṭu meṉṟu kuṟaittup pāṭukiṟīrkaḷ eṉṟu colla vantirunta vaiṇīka cirōmaṇi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷālum maṟṟum capaiyō rālum ‘tāṅkaḷ colvatucariyalla’ veṉṟu maṟukkappaṭṭatiṉāl caṟṟēṟak kuṟaiya iraṇṭu mātamāka pākavatar avarkaḷ eṉ vīṭṭiṟku varavillai. avarkaḷ vantapiṉ kaṭṭāyam nāṉ avarkaḷukkut terivippēṉ. avarkaḷum taṅkaḷukkup patil eḻutuvārkaḷ.
atōṭu viṭṭuviṭāmal kuḻantaikaḷaiyum kuṟai collukiṟīrkaḷ. kuḻantaikaḷ eṉṟu collum poḻutu peṟṟavaṉukku kumārattikaḷāṉālum taṅkaḷaip pārkkilum tērnta caṅkīta ñāṉamuṭaiyavarkaḷeṉṟu nīṅkaḷ kavaṉikkavillai.
teṉṉintiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum nuṭpa curutikaḷai nāṉ kavaṉikkumuṉ mēṟṟicaiyāriṉ caṅkīta viṣayamum iṉṉateṉṟu aṟintu koḷḷa vēṇṭumeṉṟu virumpi St. Peter’s High School talaimai upāttiyāyarum St. Peter’s Church Organist-m āṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi A.G.piccaimuttu B.A., L.A., avarkaḷaik koṇṭu English Music kaṟṟukoṭukkumpaṭi ceytu Trinity College of Music, London kalācālaiyiṉ parīṭcaiyil eṉatu kumāratti marakatavalli ammāḷ 1914-m varuṣam cūṉ mātam Higher Local  eṉṟa ēḻāvatu parīṭcaiyilum kaṉakavalli ammāḷ 1913-m varuṣam cūṉ mātam Intermidiate eṉṟa nālāvatu parīṭcaiyilum vānaṭicala pās paṇṇi yirukkiṟārkaḷ. eṉ kumāratti marakatavalli ammāḷē intiya kiṟistavar kaḷukkuḷ mutal mutal anta uyartara parīṭcaiyil tēṟiyirukkiṟatu.
makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi tiyākarājapiḷḷai avarkaḷ kumārar makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cāmiyāpiḷḷai avarkaḷiṭattil ārampap paṭippu mutal cumār 100 kīrttaṉaikaḷ paṭittatōṭu araṇmaṉai vaiṇīkar makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi ātimūrtti aiyar avarkaḷ kumārar makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi veṅkaṭācalamaiyar avarkaḷāl vīṇaiyil coṟpap payiṟciyum peṟṟārkaḷ. atōṭu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷāl cumār 100 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ varaiyum veku nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷaik kavaṉittup pāṭum curañāṉamum tāḷañāṉamu muṭaiyavarkaḷāṉārkaḷ. ippaṭi paṭittuk koṇṭu varukaiyil caṅkītattiṟkuriya cila mukkiya amcaṅkaḷum iṭaikkiṭaiyē eṉṉāl collappaṭṭum vantatu. atil eṭuttukkoṇṭa ārōkaṇa avarōkaṇattiṟku kavaṉikkavēṇṭiya aintu vitamāṉa ilakkaṇaṅkaḷaiyum eṉatu camcāram pākkiyam ammāḷukkuk kaṟṟukkoṭuttu kītam irākac cāyaic curukkam jīvacuram mutaliyavaikaḷōṭu cumār āyiram irākaṅkaḷ eḻuti muṭintirukkiṟatu. immuṟaiyai piḷḷaikaḷum aṟivārkaḷ. appaṭic ceyta kītattiliruntu kīrttaṉam eḻutum muṟaiyai kaṟṟuk koṭukka atil tērnta marakatavalli ammāḷāl caṟṟēṟakkuṟaiya 50 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ putiya irākaṅkaḷil putitāy ceyyappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa. mātirikkāka paḻamaiyāṉa irākaṅkaḷilum cila kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ceyyappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
ivaikaḷil cila kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ ākasṭu mātam 19-m tēti naṭanta tañcai caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattiṟku vantirunta capaiyōr muṉ pāṭikkāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. acṭitta piratikaḷum koṭukkappaṭṭaṉa. evarum evvita māṉa kuṟaiyum colla villai. mikavum cāstirōktamum iṉimaiyu muḷḷateṉṟu palarālum koṇṭāṭappaṭṭatu. kuḻantaikaḷum, avarkaḷiṉ tāyārum nāṉum vīṇāka aṅku varavillai. kūṭiya varai intiya caṅkītattiṟkāka eṉṉa eṉṉa ceyya vēṇṭiyatu avaciyamō avaikaḷaic ceyvatiṉ nōkkamākavē aṅku vantōm.
tāṅkaḷ curutiyaip paṟṟi vātikkumpoḻutu tāṅkaḷ collum curutiyiṉpaṭi oru Music Piece ceytu kāṭṭa vēṇṭu meṉṟu oru ciṟu tuṇṭu kaṭitam piraciṭeṇṭukku eḻuti aṉuppiṉēṉ. tāṅkaḷ collāmal pōṉāl yāṉ eṉ muṟaippaṭi collavum ceytu kāṭṭavum tayārā yiruntēṉ. avarkaḷō itu yārāl ceyya muṭiyumeṉṟu colli viṭṭārkaḷ. capaiyiṉ nōkkamaṟintu nāṉum cummāviruntēṉ.
intiya caṅkītattiṟku Staff notation  eppaṭi kuṟikkiṟa teṉṟa viṣayattil Staff notation  for Indian Music eṉṟa talaippuṭaiyatāy mūṉṟāvatu article marakatavalli ammāḷāl vācikkappaṭṭataiyum atil āyappālai, vaṭṭappālai, tirikōṇappālai, caturap pālai eṉṉum nāluvita pālaikaḷukku tiṣṭāntamākak koṭukkappaṭṭa kīrttaṉaṅkaḷaip pāṭik kāṭṭiyataiyum pustakattaiyum tāṅkaḷ pārttīrkaḷē! pārttiruntum tāṅkaḷ kuṟai kūṟuvataik koṇṭu taṅkaḷukku iṅkilīṣ miyūcikkilum takunta ñāṉamillaiyeṉṟu veḷiyākiṟatu.
itōṭu piḷḷaikaḷ kakaṉakutukalam allatu kataṉa kutukalam eṉṟa kīrttaṉaiyaip pāṭumpoḻutu atil piriyappaṭṭa parōṭā camastāṉa Band Master Mr. Fredlis akkīrttaṉaiyait taṉakku Staff notation l kuṟittukkoṭukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu piriyamāyk kēṭṭukkoḷḷa aṉṟu cāyantiram mūṉṟu maṇikkē eḻuti koṭukkappaṭṭu tamatu kaṭaravanal appaṭiyē vācittu capai yōrkaḷai cantōṣappaṭuttiṉārkaḷē. karnāṭaka caṅkītattai veku culapa māy Staff notation l kuṟittuk koṭuttataiyum Band Master Mr. Fredlis atiṉ paṭiyē vācittataiyum tāṅkaḷ kēṭṭuk koṇṭiruntīrkaḷē. ippaṭip paṭṭavarkaḷaiyā nīṅkaḷ kuṟaicollavēṇṭum? aṇu aṇuvāṉa curaṅkaḷai tāṅkaḷ aṟintu koḷḷat tiṟamaiyillāmal aṟintu pāṭukiṟavarkaḷaiyum avatūṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. aṇu aṇuvāṉa curaṅ kaḷaip paḻakukiṟataṟku nāṅkaḷ paṭṭa kaṣṭattai teyvam aṟivār. capai yil vantirunta yāvarum oruvāṟu aṟivārkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ aṟiyāmal pōṉataip paṟṟi nāṉ āccariyappaṭavillai.
taṅkaḷaippōl niṣātam kuṟaikiṟateṉṟu Band Master Mr. Fredlis tarkkittu ‘aṟupatupēr vācikkum poḻutu tavaṟuvāṉāṉāl ataik kaṇṭu piṭikkak kūṭiya cāmarttiya muṭaiyavaṉ nāṉ’ eṉṟu vīram pēciṉār. appōtu paṉṉiraṇṭu perutta nātaṅkaḷaip paḻakum uṅkaḷukkut toṇṇūṟṟāṟil oṉṟāṉa nuṭpacuram varamāṭṭāteṉṟu colli aṉu curaṅkaḷiṉālum aṉupōkattilirukkum irākaṅkaḷiṉ curaṅkaḷālum pāṭikkāṭṭi aṅkirunta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷum intustāṉi kavāykaḷum niṣātam caritāṉ eṉṟu colla uṭaṉē turai eṉṉai maṉṉippuk kēṭṭukkoṇṭār. nāṉum maṉṉittēṉ.
nīṅkaḷum eṉṉaiyāvatu kuḻantaikaḷaiyāvatu piṭil vācitta makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavatar avarkaḷaiyāvatu kēṭṭiruntāl eṅkaḷuṭaiya patiliṉāl taṅkaḷukkuc cariyāṉa aṟivu vantirukkum. aintu nāḷ aṅku iruntōmē. anta nāṭkaḷil ivvitamāṉa kuṟippukaḷil etai yāvatu oṉṟu colli yiruppīrkaḷāṉāl uṅkaḷaic cummā viṭṭirup pōmā? cariyāṉapaṭi niyāyan tīrttiruppōm. ataiviṭṭu ivvaḷavu nāḷāṉapiṉ capaiyaip paṟṟiyum, vantirunta vitvāṉkaḷaip paṟṟiyum, eṉ kuḻantaikaḷaip paṟṟiyum nīṅkaḷ kuṟippukaḷ eḻutuvatu muṟṟilum tavaṟutalāṉa kāriyam. ippaṭippaṭṭavarkaḷukkup patil eḻutāmal viṭuvatu iṉṉum atika keṭutalukkiṭamāku meṉṟu eḻuta niṉaittēṉ. tāṅkaḷ evvaḷavō uyarnta pataviyi liruntum ippaṭi aniyāyamāṉa vārttai kaḷaic colvataip pārkka nāṉ veṭkappaṭukiṟēṉ.
12. “tāṅkaḷ tayār ceyta vīṇaiyai vaittukkoṇṭu kuḻantaikaḷ pāṭiṉapōtu kuṟaittu vaitta iṭaiveḷiyaip pāṭiṉatiṉāl atu kātukku avvaḷavu iṉimaiyāy illai.”
nāṉ tayār ceyta vīṇaiyaik koṇṭu piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭiyatu kuṟainta iṭaiveḷikaḷuḷḷavai kaḷāyiruntatāl kātukku iṉimaiyā yillai eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ pōṭṭirukkum oḻuṅkīṉamāṉa 25 curutikaḷ eṉṟa aḻukkaṭainta mūkkuk kaṇṇāṭiyai eṭuttu viṭṭup pārppīrkaḷāṉāl appōtu tulāmparamāyt teriyum. apacurak kuṭukkai yākiya taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyattai vanta vaḻiyē aṉuppiviṭṭu pūrvat tamiḻ makkaḷ curuti cērkkum muṟaippaṭi ārmōṉiyam ceytu atilāvatu - vīṇaiyilāvatu paḻakip pāruṅkaḷ. appōtu intiyāviṉ pūrva kuṭikaḷākiya tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta kāṉattiṉ cūṭcumam aṟintu colla muṭiyāmal palar palavitamāy apippirāyappaṭṭu nūl eḻutiṉārka ḷeṉṟu aṟivīrkaḷ. kamakamāy vīṇaiyil vācikkavēṇṭiya curaṅkaḷai ataṟkuriya iṉimaiyōṭu ārmōṉiyattil muṟṟilum kāṭṭa muṭiyā teṉṟu tāṅkaḷ aṟiya vēṇṭum.
13. “avarkaḷ piṭiluṭaṉ cērntu pāṭiṉapōtu avarkaḷum piṭil vācittavarum taṅkaḷai yaṟiyāmalē vēṟu ārōkaṇa avarō kaṇaṅkaḷukku māṟiviṭṭārkaḷ.”
piṭil vācitta upāttiyāyarum pāṭiya piḷḷaikaḷum taṅkaḷai aṟiyāmalē vēṟu ārōkaṇa avarōkaṇaṅkaḷukku māṟiviṭṭārkaḷeṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. itu mika naṉṟāyirukkiṟatu. taṅkaḷukkuk karnāṭaka caṅkītamum teriyumeṉṟu itaṉāl veḷippaṭuttukiṟīrkaḷ. enta irākam pāṭumpoḻutu enta irākattiṟku māṟiṉārkaḷ? ataic collāmaṟ potuvākac colvatu mikavum mōcamāṉatu. capaiyil ippaṭi oru kuṟippaic colli yiruppīrkaḷāṉāl aṅkirunta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷ uṅkaḷaic cummāviṭṭirukka māṭṭārkaḷ. avarkaḷellārum uṅkaḷōṭu caṇṭaikku varavēṇṭumā?
ārōkaṇam, avarōkaṇaṅkaḷil kiramam mīṟi vēṟu oru curam kalakku māṉāl neruppil viḻunta puḻuppōl maṉam tuṭikkum aṟivāḷikaḷ piḷḷaikaḷeṉṟāvatu, pākavatareṉṟāvatu pārkka māṭṭārkaḷ. kēṭṭuk koṇṭu cummāyirukkavum māṭṭārkaḷ. vēṟu ārōkaṇaṅkaḷukku māṟi viṭṭārkaḷeṉṟu eṅkaḷaiyum, avaikaḷaik kēṭṭukkoṇṭirunta karnāṭaka vitvāṉkaḷaiyum tāṅkaḷ mōṭaṉam ceyvatu cariyalla.
eṅkaḷ vayiṟṟu āttirattiṟkākavā 1500 rūpāvukku mēl celavu ceytu pala vitamāṉa caṅkaṭaṅkaḷaiyum aṉupavittuk koṇṭu aṅku vantu vēṟu irākaṅkaḷukku māṟṟip pāṭiṉōm? maṟṟavarkaḷ etaṟkākak kēṭṭuk koṇṭintārkaḷ? ēṉ kēṭṭuk koṇṭirukkiṟīrkaḷeṉṟu avarkaḷai nīṅkaḷ kēṭkak kūṭātā? eṅkaḷaip pōlavē avarkaḷaiyum mūṭarkaḷeṉṟu niṉaittuk koṇṭīrkaḷ. ippaṭi jaṉacamūkattaip puṇpaṭuttum vārttaikaḷ colvataip pārkkilum tāṅkaḷ cummāyiruntāl mikap perumaiyā yirukkum.
makārājā avarkaḷ kūṭṭi vaitta capaiyaiyum capaiyil vantirunta vitvāṉkaḷaiyum tāṅkaḷ naṉkumatikkavillai eṉṟu taṅkaḷ vacaṉaṅkaḷiṉāl veḷiyākiṉṟatu. ‘tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ pūrva kāṉattiṉ uṇmaiyai yāvarum aṟintu koḷḷa vēṇṭum; ammuṟaiyē ulakatti luḷḷa caṅkītam yāvaṟṟilum mēlāṉatu; oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu avatippaṭa vēṇṭām’ eṉṟu eṉ conta jaṉaṅ kaḷukkum conta tēcattārukkum ulakattār yāvarukkum uṇmaiyait teriyappaṭutta nāṉ avvaḷavu tūram vantēṉēyoḻiya, ippaṭit taṅkaḷāl avatūṟāṉa kuṟainta vārttaikaḷaik kēṭka varavillai. taṅkaḷai yottavarkaḷ ivvārttaikaḷ colvatum muṟṟilum tavaṟutalāka irukkiṟatu.
14. “avarkaḷ mukkiyamāy māṟippōkiṟa Scale kku ditonal scaleeṉṟu peyar. itaittāṉ Pythagoras uṭaiya skēl eṉṟu cātāraṇamāyc colvārkaḷ.”
itaippaṟṟi nāṉ oru article cīkkiram eḻutuvēṉ. Blaserna eṉpavaruṭaiya ‘Theory of sounds’ eṉṟa nūlaip pōṉṟa maṟṟa nūlkaḷāl tāṉ Pythagoras uṭaiya scale  caṅkīta carittira viṣayattil eṉṉa vēlai ceytirukkiṟateṉpataip paṟṟic cāmāṉya jaṉaṅkaḷ tappāṉa apippirāyam koḷvataṟku iṭamāyirukkiṟatu. eṉṉuṭaiya apippirāyameṉṉa veṉṟāl temperament vanta piṟakutāṉ caṅkītattiṟku oru mukkiya ātāramāka eṇṇappaṭṭatē yoḻiya ataṟku muntiyalla. āti kirēkkarukkuḷ kittāriyaic curuti cērppatil upayōkappaṭuttappaṭṭa cutta skēl muṟaikaḷil itu oṉṟāyiruntatu. itu veku caukariyamāyirunta paṭiyāl inta skēlai ātāramākak koṇṭē vāttiyaṅkaḷukku notation  eḻuta ārampittārkaḷ. antak kittāriyiṉ tantikaḷai muṟukkiṉāl araiccuram varaikkum uyarttakkūṭiya vitamāy atu amaikkappaṭṭataṉāl enta skēl avaciyamō atai vācikkumpaṭiyāyc coḷakariyam ēṟpaṭṭatu. taṟkāla piṅkār allatu vīṇaiyil meṭṭukaḷil illāta curaṅkaḷai eppaṭit tantiyai iḻuppataṉāl kamakamāy vācikkiṟōmō appaṭittāṉ. inta ditonal scale āṉatu terintavaraiyil kirēkka caṅkītattil upayōkappaṭuttappaṭavillai. atāvatu oru irākamāvatu Pythagoras muṟaiyāyc curuti cērtta cutta curaṅkaḷāl uṇṭāṉatalla. Byzantine Empire (mukamatiya rājāṅkam) irunta kālattil caṅkītamē teriyāta cilar Pythagoras uṭaiya kaṇakkai ōṭṭiviṭṭārkaḷ. taṟkālam Just intervals eṉṟāl eṉṉaveṉṟu teriyāta paṇṭitarkaḷ 3033/4 uḷḷa kāntāram 405 uḷḷa taivatameṉṟu taṇṇīrpaṭṭa pāṭamāy eppaṭic collukiṟārkaḷō appaṭittāṉ atuvum.”
cama aḷavuḷḷa ōcaiyuṭaiyatāyirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟa pūrva tamiḻ muṟaippaṭi ceyta vīṇaiyil kaṇṭa nātattiṉpaṭiyē tamiḻ makkaḷ pūrvam vaḻaṅki vantatum taṟkālam tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ vaḻakkatti liruppatumāṉa caṅkītattaiyē piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭiṉārkaḷ. atait tāṅkaḷ ‘artificial iṭaiveḷikaḷ’ eṉṟu patiṉōrāvatu vākkiyattilum ‘nāmāyk kūṭak kuṟaittu vaittuk koḷḷum curaṅkaḷālāṉa caṅkītam aruvaruppāṉatu’ eṉṟu oṉpatāvatu vākkiyattilum, ‘kuṟaittu vaitta iṭaiveḷikaḷuṭaiya curattil pāṭiyatiṉāl atu iṉimaiyāyillai’ eṉṟu paṉṉiraṇṭāvatu vākkiyattilum, ‘taṅkaḷai aṟiyāmalē vēṟu ārōkaṇa avarō kaṇaṅkaḷukku māṟiviṭṭārka’ḷeṉṟu patiṉmūṉṟām vākkiyattilum collukiṟīrkaḷ. ivaikaḷaik kavaṉikkumpoḻutu Equal Temperament muṟaikkum Pythagoras muṟaikkumuḷḷa nāta vittiyācam iṉṉateṉṟu tāṅkaḷ teḷivāka aṟintu koḷḷavillai; ōcaiyai aṟintu nitāṉikkum tiṟamaiyum taṅkaḷukku illai eṉṟu tōṉṟukiṟatu. ēṉ caṅkītattai upattiravap paṭuttukiṟīrkaḷ?
Just intervals eṉṟāl iṉṉateṉṟu kaṇakkup perukkik koṇṭupōṉa tēvāl 3033/4 vaiparēṣaṉil 33/4 vaiparēṣaṉ ēṉ taḷḷiṉār eṉṟu kāraṇam collāmal ēṉ miraṭṭukiṟīrkaḷ? avar tappitamāyc ceyta kaṇakkai tāṅkaḷ ēṉ ātāramāka eṭuttuk koṇṭīrkaḷ? ātāra caṭcam 240 vaiparēṣaṉ eṉṟu vaittuk koṇṭu 2/3 x 2/3, 2/3 x 2/3 x 2/3 eṉṟu perukkik koṇṭupōṉa tantiyiṉ piṉṉattiṟku ōcaiyiṉ alaikaḷ kaṇṭupiṭitta tappāṉa muṟaiyaiyē tāṅkaḷum eṭuttuk koṇṭu cātikka vantirukkiṟīrkaḷ. 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa piṉṉaṅkaḷ miccamillāmal vakukkappaṭa muṭiyāta eṇkaḷ eṉṟu puḷḷi pōṭṭuk koṇṭu niṟpataiyum appaṭiyē perukkumpoḻutu stāyikkuriya 1, 2, 4, 8 pōṉṟa muḻu ilakkaṅkaḷ kiṭaikkāmal āñcanēyar vālpōlap pōkap pōka nīṇṭupōvataiyum eṭuttuc coṉṉavuṭaṉē kāṉpareṉsil vantirunta anēka vitvāṉ kaḷukkum maṟṟum aṟivāḷikaḷukkum itu cariyāṉa muṟaiyalla eṉṟu takunta kāraṇam colli ‘itil āṭcēpaṉai irukkumāṉāl colla vēṇṭu’meṉṟu pala taṭavai kēṭṭēṉē. oruvarum oṉṟum pēca villaiyē. tāṅkaḷum aṅku iruntīrkaḷē. oru vārttai vāy tiṟantu coṉṉīrkaḷā? taṅkaḷukku ēṉ appaṭippaṭavillai? appōtu cummā iruntuviṭṭu āṟu mātattiṟkup piṟaku eṉṉa āravāram?
oṉṟirukka maṟṟoṉṟaic collum aṟivāḷikaḷiṉ col ettaṉai nāḷaikku niṟkum? maṉōvākkuk kāyaṅkaḷ mūṉṟilum oṉṟākak kāṇappaṭum oru cattiyam, cuvarkka, mattiya, pātāḷam eṉṉum mūṉṟu ulakattilum oṉṟākavē nilaittirukkum. appaṭi yillātavai “piḻaikkiṟa piḷḷaiyāṉāl piṟanta uṭaṉē cākātā”? eṉṟu collum parikācavākkiyampōl ākumē. taṅkaḷ ārmōṉiyamum aṉṟē tolaintatē. uyiraṟṟa oṉṟaik kaṭṭik koṇṭu ettaṉai nāḷ avatippaṭuvīrkaḷ. nāṟippōkumē.
āyiṉum tāṅkaḷ ēḷaṉam ceykiṟa paṇṭitarkaḷ kūṭiya cīkkiram uṅkaḷ kaṇakkaiyum ārmōṉiyattaiyum kaṇṭittu uṅkaḷukku eḻutu vārkaḷ. ‘intiya caṅkītam mēṟṟicaiyiliruntu oru airōppiyar vantu taṉṉai eṭuttu niṟutta vēṇṭumeṉṟu āvalāyk kāttuk koṇṭirukkiṟatu’ eṉṟu coṉṉa collukku intiyāviṉ muṉṉōr kaḷaiyum avarkaḷiṉ muṟaikaḷaiyum aṉupōkattaiyum pāḻ ceyyat tāṅkaḷā talaiyeṭukka vēṇṭum? taṅkaḷuṭaiya kuṟippukaḷ (Remark)pārkkum poḻutu oṉṟumillāta coṟkaḷ pōliruntālum viṭamuḷḷa pāṇaṅkaḷaippōl varuttattait tarukiṉṟaṉavē.
15. “taṅkaḷ kuḻantaikaḷuṭaiya kāṉamāṉatu Jackruddin ālum maṟṟavarkaḷālum atikamākap pukaḻap paṭṭapōtilum atu evvitattilum rucu eṉṟu colla muṭiyātu.”
‘taṅkaḷ kuḻantaikaḷuṭaiya kāṉamāṉatu cākruṭīṉālum maṟṟavar kaḷālum atikamāyp pukaḻappaṭṭapōtilum atu evvitattilum rucu eṉṟu collamuṭiyātu’ eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷē. oru nalla vārttaiyāvatu pūraṇamāyc collakkūṭātā? colvatilum oru nañcu vaittā colla vēṇṭum. capaiyil vantirunta caṟṟēṟakkuṟaiya 500 pērkaḷum koṇṭāṭumpaṭi nāṅkaḷ avarkaḷukku eṉṉa ceytōm? muṉpiṉ eṅkaḷai avarkaḷukkut teriyumā? iṉiya kītattaik kēṭṭatiṉ nimittam ataikkoṇṭāṭiṉārkaḷ.
kāṉpareṉs ārampattil teyvavaṇakkam piḷḷaikaḷ colla vēṇṭumeṉṟu purōkirāmil kuṟittiruntārkaḷ. mutal mutal aṭāṉā kīrttaṉam pāṭappaṭṭatu. ārampittu mutal aṭi collum poḻutē piḷḷaikaḷ pakkamirunta Mrs. Atya Begum Fyze Rahimin iṉiya kuraluk  kīṭupaṭṭu anēka kālam paḻakiṉavarkaḷpōl piriyaṅkāṭṭiṉārkaḷ. ataṉ piṉ ‘taṉ vīṭṭiṟku varavēṇṭumeṉṟum, taṉṉōṭu Tea  cāppiṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟum, taṉ pāṭṭaik kēṭka vēṇṭumeṉṟum, piḷḷaikaḷ taṉakkāka iṉṉum cila pāṭṭukaḷ taṉ vīṭṭil pāṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟum’ kēṭṭuk koṇṭārkaḷ. avarkaḷ kēṭṭukkoṇṭapaṭiyē nāṅkaḷum ceytōm. avarkaḷ pāṭiya poḻutu nāṅkaḷ mikavum āccariyappaṭṭōm. iṉiya kuralum pattiracamāṉa poruḷum irākaṅkaḷiṉ muṟaiyum kēṭka mika iṉimaiyāyiruntaṉa. caṅkītattil avarkaḷ avvaḷavu aṟivuṭaiyavarkaḷā yiruntataṉāl allavō piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭṭil piriyappaṭṭārkaḷ?
iṉṉum cilar mutal pallaviyaik kēṭṭapiṉ kīrttaṉattiṉ poruḷum irākattiṉ amaitiyum kaṇṭu taṅkaḷ kaṇkaḷai mūṭic camāti nilaiyil niṉṟārkaḷ. vēṟu cilar āṉantak kaṇṇīr corintārkaḷ. his haiṉas makārājā avarkaḷum ‘pāṭṭu eṅkiruntu varukiṟatu. yār pāṭukiṟār’? eṉṟu vicārikka ārampittārkaḷ. capaiyōr palarum arumaiyāṉa pala kuṟippukaḷ perumaiyāyp pēcikkoṇṭārkaḷ. caṟṟēṟak kuṟaiya 500 pēr appōtu kūṭiyiruntārkaḷeṉṟu uttēcikkiṟēṉ. ivarkaḷil uṇmaiyāyc caṅkītattai appiyācam paṇṇiṉavarkaḷum aṟintavarkaḷum 300 pērāvatu irukkalām. ivarkaḷālum yāvarālum pukaḻappaṭṭa kuḻantaikaḷiṉ kāṉam tāṅkaḷ oruvarukku māttiram aruvaruppāyiruntataṟkuk kāraṇameṉṉa? his haiṉas makārājā makā rāṇiyavarkaḷum rāja kuṭumpattārum lakṣmi vilācattil piḷḷaikaḷiṉ pāṭṭaik kēṭṭapōtu ‘piḷḷaikaḷiṉ pāṭṭu mika naṉṟāyiruntatu avarkaḷukku mikavum naṉṟi pārāṭṭukiṟōm’ eṉṟu piriya vacaṉam coṉṉārkaḷē. tāṅkaḷum appōtiruntīrkaḷē. taṅkaḷukkuc cariyāṉa caṅkītam kēṭṭup paḻakkamillātataṉāl ippaṭic collukiṟīrkaḷ eṉṟu eṇṇukiṟēṉ.
his haiṉas makārājā makārāṇi avarkaḷālum intiyāviṉ caṅkītattil tērnta ellā vitvāṉkaḷālum oṉṟupōl pukaḻappaṭṭa kītam uṅkaḷukku aruvaruppā yirukkiṟateṉṟu aṅkēyē colliyiruppīr kaḷāṉāl taṅkaḷaiyum oru tukkaṭā pāṭac collip pukaḻntiruppēṉ. capaiyār yāvarālum aruvarukkappaṭṭiruppīrkaḷ. appaṭiyāṉāl āṟu mātattiṟkup piṟaku ippaṭi pitaṟṟamāṭṭīrkaḷ. taṅkaḷ apacuramuḷḷa ārmōṉiyam uṅkaḷ kātaik keṭuttu viṭṭatu eṉṟu nāṉ niccayam colvēṉ. in nōy tīra kīlayāttil taila muṇṭō? aintu jūrikaḷ alla 300kku mēṟpaṭṭavarkaḷ ‘ām’ eṉṟu colvatai oruvar māṟṟic colla eṉṉa ātāramirukkiṟatu? itu aṉiyāyattilum aṉiyāyam aṟiyāmaiyilum aṟiyāmaiyē.
karnāṭaka caṅkīta muṟaikkum intustāṉ muṟaikkum cila pētaṅkaḷ uṇL. ivaikaḷ iraṇṭum vevvēṟāyirāmal iraṇṭum oṉṟu cērntu oru kīrttaṉattai aḻaku paṭutta vēṇṭumeṉpatu eṉṉuṭaiya mukkiya nōkkam. ivviraṇṭum vevvēṟāka niṉaippavarkaḷ kūṭa tiruptiyaṭaiyak kūṭiyatāyirukkumāṉāl tāṅkaḷ māttiram taṉittu niṉṟāl ivviraṇṭi lum taṅkaḷukkuc ciṟitum kēḷvi yillaiyeṉṟē colla vēṇṭiyatā yirukkiṟatu.
piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭiya kīrttaṉam curuti muṟaikaḷukku rucuveṉṟu taṅkaḷai nāṉ collac coṉṉēṉā? allatu capaiyāraiyāvatu colla vēṇṭumeṉṟu kēṭṭuk koṇṭēṉā? teṉṉāṭṭiṉ tamiḻmakkaḷ pāṭi varum caṅkītattai vaṭa nāṭṭil intustāṉ caṅkītam pāṭuvōr oppuk koḷḷuvārkaḷā? oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu vātāṭum vaṭanāṭṭil 96 nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ vaḻaṅkukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu coṉṉāl aṟintu koḷvārkaḷā? ākaiyiṉāl evvitamāṉa muṭivum (recalūṣaṉum) colla nāṉ niṉaikkavillai.
‘oru stāyiyai 24 curutikaḷāka vakuttu atil iraṇṭu alaku kuṟaittu 22 eṉṟu kaṇakkuc coṉṉa pūrva tamiḻ nūliṉ karuttaṟiyāmal oru stāyiyil 22 eṉṟu maṟṟavarkaḷ tavaṟutalāyc collukiṟārkaḷ. nāṉ intat taṭavai viyācam vācittuk kāṭṭa muṭiyātu. avviṭattuk kāṉpareṉsiṉ naṭavaṭikkaiyaip pārttuk koṇṭu aṭutta kāṉpa reṉsil vācikkiṟēṉ’ eṉṟu tivāṉcākip makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P.mātavarāv C.I.E.avarkaḷukku Mr. V.N.Bhatkandi B.A.,B.L. avarkaḷukkum kaṭitam eḻutiyum nāṉ vara vēṇṭumeṉṟum curutikaḷaip paṟṟic colliyē tīravēṇṭumeṉṟum vaṟpuṟuttik kēṭṭuk koṇṭatiṉāl curutikaḷaip paṟṟi eḻuti varum eṉṉuṭaiya puttakam muṭintum muṭiyāmalumirukkaiyil eṉ vēlaikaḷai ellām pōṭṭuviṭṭu pala kaṣṭaṅkaḷaiyum mēṟkoṇṭu aṅku vantēṉ.
iṭattukku nāṉ putitāyiruntataṉālum tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ mēlāṉa caṅkīta ñāṉam avviṭattiṟkup putitāyirukkumāṉatiṉālum nāṉ atikamāka eṉ vārttaikaḷaic celavaḻikkavillai. āṉālum aṅku vantirunta aṟivāḷikaḷ āḻntu kavaṉikkumpaṭi cila ariya viṣayaṅkaḷaip puttakamāka accaṭittuk koṭuttum curukkamāy 31/2 maṇi nēram viyākkiyāṉam ceytum kāṭṭiṉēṉ. āyappālai, vaṭṭappālai, tirikōṇappālai, caturappālai eṉṉum nālu pālaiyāka taṅkaḷ kāṉattai vakuttu 12,000 irākaṅkaḷ pāṭi vanta tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ muṟaiyil nālu aṭṭavaṇaikaḷil taṟkālattil vaḻaṅkum 67 kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ eḻuti ataṉpaṭiyē capaiyiṉ muṉ rucuppaṭuttik kāṭṭiṉēṉ. innālu aṭṭavaṇaikaḷil tāṅkaḷ piramātamākac collum 5, 6 irākaṅkaḷait tēṭip piṭittu ataṉpaṭi pāṭippārttāl taṅkaḷaip piṭitta apacura ñāṉam uṭaṉē nīṅkiviṭum. taṅkaḷ collai nampit talaiyāṭṭal koṇṭavarkaḷum kavaṉittāl niccaya puttiyuṇṭākiviṭum. taṅkaḷukkut terinta cila irākaṅkaḷil nuṭpa curaṅkaḷ varuvatu pōl iṉṉum ērāḷamāṉa irākaṅkaḷil ciṟu curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu tāṅkaḷ kaṇṭu koḷvīrkaḷ. kirakacuram māṟṟuvataṉāl mūṉṟu curutikaḷ kiṭaittaṉa eṉṟu coṉṉatupōl ataṟku eṉṉa kāraṇam colluvīrkaḷ?
‘capaiyil yārukkāvatu āṣēpamiruntāl collaṭṭum. iṉṉum teḷivākac collak kūṭiyavaikaḷaic collukiṟēṉ. kēṭkiṟavarkaḷ taṉittu vantālum collat tayārāyirukkiṟēṉ’ eṉṟum, kaṇita viṣayamāka 2/3, 3/4 ākak kaṇṭupiṭittuk koṇṭu pōkum curaṅkaḷ caṅkītattiṟkuc cariyāṉa aḷavait tarātu eṉṟum pala niyāyaṅkaḷ colli, Geometrical Progression paṭiyē cariyāṉa curaṅkaḷ kiṭaikkum kaṇitam kāṭṭi, ‘āṣēpaṉaiyirukkumāṉāl colla vēṇṭu’meṉṟum capaiyōraip pārttuk kēṭṭukkoṇṭēṉē. kēṭṭukkoṇṭa iṭattil maṟuttu oruvarum kēṭka villaiyē eṉṟu varuttappaṭṭēṉ. kēṭṭiruntāl, oru maṇi nēramalla iraṇṭu mūṉṟu maṇi nēramāṉālum eṭuttuk koṇṭa curuti viṣayattaip pūraṇamāy aṟintu koḷḷumpaṭi collat tayārā yiruntēṉ.
tāṅkaḷ nālām nāḷ naḻuvalāyc collōṭu collāyc coṉṉa iraṇṭu kuṟippukaḷukku iraṇṭu nimiṣamtāṉ patil collak kiṭaittatu. āṉāl 3/4 maṇi nēram collumpaṭi viṭṭuviṭṭārkaḷ. cāppāṭṭukku vaḻakkamāyp pōkum nērattaip pārkkilum atika nēram ākiviṭṭatu. appōtum ‘tāṅkaḷ ētāvatu āṣēpaṉai colvatāyiruntāl colla vēṇṭu’ meṉṟu kēṭṭapoḻutu collātiruntīrkaḷ. colliyiruppīr kaḷāṉāl tēvāl avarkaḷiṉ tavaṟutalāṉa kaṇakkaiyum at tavaṟutalil cellum taṅkaḷuṭaiya kaṇakkaiyum eṭuttukkāṭṭi ammuṟaippaṭi vīṇai yil curuti stāṉaṅkaḷaik kāṭṭit taṅkaḷ muṟai tavaṟutaleṉṟu oppuk koḷḷumpaṭi ceytiruppēṉ. nāṉ taṅkaḷiṭattil perumai pārāṭṭuvatāka niṉaiyātirukka mikavum vaṇakkamāyk kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ.
uṇmai yirukkumāṉāl nāṉ ēṉ vāy tiṟantu collakkūṭātu? pallāyira varuṭaṅkaḷākap pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta nuṭpamāṉa curutimuṟai ivvaḷavu kālamum aṟintu koḷḷak kūṭāmal pōyiṟṟē yeṉṟu varuttappaṭukiṟēṉ. uḷḷapaṭi maṟṟavarkaḷ atai aṟintu koḷḷa vēṇṭiya pirayattaṉam eṭuttuk koḷḷāmal pōṉāl nāṉ eṉ tēcattiṟkum eṉ jaṉaṅkaḷukkum eṉ pāṣaikkum turōkiyāvēṉ. nāṉ pūrvattil illātavaikaḷaic collukiṟēṉ eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ eṇṇā tirukkumpaṭi kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ. curuti viṣayamāka muṟṟilum ārāyntu pārkkāmal avaravarkaḷ taṅkaḷ taṅkaḷukkuk kiṭaitta cila curutikaḷaik kaṇṭupiṭittatākak koṇṭu vantu viṭṭārkaḷ. iru kuruṭaṉukkuk kāṭṭiya kokkuppōl kēṭāy muṭintatu.
oru kuruṭaṉukku oru piḷḷai piṟantatu. atu pāl puraiyēṟi iṟantu viṭṭatu. tukkam vicārikka vanta oruvaṉiṭattil pāl eppaṭiyirukkum aṇṇā eṉṟu kuruṭaṉ kēṭṭāṉ. avaṉ kokkup pōl irukkum eṉṟāṉ. pakkattilirunta vēṟoruvaṉaik kokku eppaṭiyirukku meṉṟu kēṭṭāṉ. avaṉ muḻaṅkaiyaiyum muṉṉaṅkaiyaiyum kokkuppōl vaḷaittuk kuruṭaṉ kaiyai ataṉ mēl vaittut taṭavip pārkkac colli, ‘kokku ippaṭittāṉ irukkum’ eṉṟāṉ. kuruṭaṉ uṭaṉē taṉ taṭiyai eṭuttuk koṇṭupōyk kokkup pōl oru kaiyai maṭakkik kāṭṭik koṇṭu ‘intap periya kokkai eppaṭi piḷḷaikkuk koṭuttāy’ eṉṟu taṉ peṇcātiyai aṭittāṉ. avaḷ kūkkuraliṭṭāḷ. itupōl taṅkaḷuṭaiya 25 curutiyum irukkiṟatē.
mirāj paṭṭaṇattu Mr.Krishnaji Mahadev Gokhaleavarkaḷ 22 curutikku mēṟpaṭṭu nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ varum 83 irākaṅkaḷaip pāṭik kāṭṭiṉārka ḷeṉṟu coṉṉa tāṅkaḷ irupattaintu māttiram ēṉ eṭuttuk koṇṭīrkaḷ? caṅkīta ratṉākararuṭaiya apippirāyattiṉpaṭi irupattiraṇṭai yum taḷḷi ³ Mr.Krishnaji Mahadev Gokhale caṅkīta vitvāṉuṭaya apippirāyattai yum taḷḷi naṭuvil irupattaintu eṉṟa kokkaik koṇṭu vantāl eṅkaḷāl oppukkoḷḷa muṭiyavillaiyē. nāṅkaḷ kaṣṭappaṭumpaṭi ceyvatu intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkivarum nuṭpamāṉa curutikaḷ iṉṉavaiyeṉṟu aṟiyāta taṅkaḷ kavaṉak kuṟaivēyoḻiya vēṟalla. taṅkaḷaip pōṉṟavarkaḷ rucu veṉṟu colliviṭṭāl karnāṭaka caṅkītattil pāṇṭittiya muḷḷavarkaḷ oppuk koḷvārkaḷō. karnāṭaka caṅkītattil pāṇṭittiya muṭaiyavarkaḷuṅkūṭa vēṇṭumeṉṟu kutarkkam colvārkaḷāṉāl tāṅkaḷ collak kēṭpāṉēṉ.
taṅkaḷaip pōl 1000 kiḷameṉṭs turaikaḷai oṉṟāyccērttu urukki vārttatupōṉṟavarum piḷḷaikaḷukkup paṭittuk koṭukkiṟavaru mākiya makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi pañcāpakēca pākavataravarkaḷ 67 kīrttaṉaikaḷilum oru piḻaikūṭa kaṇṭupiṭikka muṭiyāmal eppaṭiyāvatu oṉṟil oru kuṟai colla vēṇṭum eṉṟu tīrmāṉittu, ‘taṉṉiyāciyil varum kāntārattaip piḷḷaikaḷ kūṭṭip paṭikkiṟārkaḷ. atu 22 curutiyiṉpaṭi kuṟaintu varavēṇṭiyatu’ eṉṟu piṭilil vācittuk kōkaraṇam, kajakaraṇam ellām ceytārkaḷ. makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi makā vaittiyanāta aiyaruṭaiya cīṭaril oruvarum karnāṭaka caṅkītattil tērntavarumāṉa paḻamāṟaṉēri makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cāmināta aiyar avarkaḷum ataṟku ottup pāṭiṉārkaḷ. appōtu niṣātam kūṭutalāka varuvatai vīṇaiyil kāṭṭa, oppuk koṇṭārkaḷ. niṣātam pōlavē, ‘kāntāramumkūṭa varavēṇṭum. illaiyāṉāl ataṟku ca-pa- oṟṟumai yillai’ yeṉṟu nāṉ coṉṉēṉ. appōtu maicūr vaiṇīka vitvāṉ makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷum maṟṟa vitvāṉkaḷum ‘kāntāram kūṭa varāmal pōṉāl atu taṉṉiyāciyāka māṭṭātu. piḷḷaikaḷ pāṭuvatu cariyāyirukkiṟatu’ eṉṟu tīrmāṉittārkaḷ. karnāṭaka nāṭṭil nuṭpamāyk kavaṉikkiṟatu pōla vaṭanāṭṭil ataik kavaṉikkavillai eṉṟu nāṉ varuttappaṭavumillai. piṟar ataṉ arumaiyait terintu koḷḷavillai eṉṟu kuṟaicollavumillai. curutiyaip paṟṟiya aṟiyāmaiyum kutarkkamum nīṅkic cariyāṉa aṟivu varum kālattil ataṉ arumaiyai aṟivārkaḷ.
16. “tāṅkaḷ stāyiyaic caripākamāka vakuppataippaṟṟi eṉ apip pirāyattaic collukiṟēṉ. intiya caṅkītamāṉatu ippōtutāṉ tivviyamāṉa pataviyilirukkiṟatu.”
stāyiyaic caripākamāka nāṉ vakuppataippaṟṟi evvaḷavu tāṅkaḷ parikācam ceyya vēṇṭumō avvaḷavu parikācam ceyya cila kuṟippukaḷ collukiṟīrkaḷ. attaṉai parikācamum taṅkaḷukkē collappaṭṭavai yeṉṟu tāṅkaḷ aṟiyātirukkiṟīrkaḷ. intiya caṅkītamāṉatu ippōtutāṉ tivviyamāṉa pataviyilirukkiṟatu eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. taṅkaḷ muṟaip paṭiyē atu taḷḷappaṭṭatē. piṉ yār muṟaipṭi tivviyamāṉa nilaiyi lirukkiṟatu?
17. “ca-pa eṉṟa oṟṟumai ātāramākak koṇṭa enta caṅkīta muṟaiyum muṟṟilum cariyāṉa oṟṟumaiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷālāṉatāyirukka vēṇṭum.”
ca-pa muṟaiyai ātāramākak koṇṭa enta caṅkīta muṟaiyum muṟṟilum cariyāṉa oṟṟumaiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷālāṉatāyirukka vēṇṭu meṉṟu oppukkoḷḷukiṟīrkaḷ. ivvuttama apippirāyattai nāṉ mikavum oppukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ. ca-pa muṟaiyil oru stāyiyil paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷ kiṭaikka vēṇṭumeṉṟa pūrvatamiḻ muṟaiyaiyē iṅkē collukiṟīrkaḷ. ca-pa muṟaiyil curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭippataṟku 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa muṟai cariyāṉataṉṟu. curañāṉattiṉāl kaṇṭu piṭikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ icait tamiḻ nūlil teḷivāyc colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ.
ēṟṟiya kuraliṉi yeṉṟiru narampiṉ - oppak kēṭkum uṇarviṉaṉāki
ammuṟai Geometrical Progression paṭi curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷum varavēṇṭu meṉṟu vaṟpuṟuttic collukiṟatāka irukkiṟatu.
immuṟaiyil pūrva tamiḻmakkaḷ toṭṭa curattiṟku ēḻāvatu ēḻāva tākavum aintāvatu aintāvatākavum oru rāciyil 12 curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭittu.
varaṉmuṟai maruṅkiṉ aintiṉum ēḻiṉum-uḻaimuta lākavum uḻaiyī ṟākavum
kuraṉmuta lākavum kuralī ṟākavum
ovvoru curattilum ca-pa, ca-ma muṟaiyāy ovvoru alakum ataṟkuk kuṟaintu varukiṟa nuṭpa curaṅkaḷum ca-pa, ca-ma muṟaiyil porunti varavēṇṭumeṉṟu ulakattār oruvarum aṟintu koḷḷāta tivviya pataviyaic colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ. ‘eṉ muṟaiyē intiya caṅkītattiṟku tivviyamāṉa pataviyait tantatu’ eṉṟu tāṅkaḷ tīrkkataricaṉam collukiṟatu pōlirukkiṟatu.
oru stāyiyil 12 curaṅkaḷum 24 curutikaḷum maṟṟum nuṭpa curutikaḷum Geometrical Progression paṭi tantiyiṉ enta aḷavil varukiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu kaṇṭu avaṟṟiṉpaṭi meṭṭukaḷ vaittu aṉu pōkattilirukkum irākattaip pāṭikkāṭṭiyapōtu ‘caṅkītattiṟkup putiya ulakam tōṉṟi irukkiṟatu, iṉimēl curutikaḷai vicārikka vēṇṭiya avaciyamillai, ivai pōtum, Mr. tēvāl Mr. kiḷameṇṭs avarkaḷ curuti muṟai pātāḷattiṟkut taḷḷappaṭṭatu’ eṉṟu kūṭiyirunta kaṉavāṉkaḷum, aṟivāḷikaḷum collit taṅkaḷukkuḷḷa cantōṣattaik kāṭṭiṉārkaḷē. ataittāṉō tāṅkaḷ tīrkkataricaṉamākac collukiṟīrkaḷ? allatu yāvarālum takunta pariṣaiyiṇ mēl aṉupavattiṟku ottuvara villai eṉṟu aruvaruttut taḷḷiya ārmōṉiyam tivviyapatattait tantateṉṟu maṉacāṭcikku virōtamāyc collukiṟīrkaḷō?
ēṉeṉṟāl eṉṉuṭaiya muṟai ca-pa vai ātāramākak koṇṭatu. muṟṟilum cariyāṉa oṟṟumaiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷālāṉatu. taṅkaḷ muṟaiyō muṟṟilum caṅkītattiṟku ottu varāta curaṅkaḷuṭaiyatu. 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟa piṉṉa eṇkaḷiṉāl perukkik koṇṭupōy oru iṭattil talaiyait taṭṭiyum maṟṟoru iṭattil kālai veṭṭiyum carippaṭuttiyatu. ivaikaḷaip paṟṟik karuṇāmirta cākaram iraṇṭām pākattil pōtumāṉapaṭi colli yirukkiṟēṉ.
18. “ātikālattil cāstirikaḷukku cutta oṟṟumaiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷ aviḻkkappaṭakkūṭāta oru muṭiccuppōl iruntatu. tantiyiṉ aḷavāl curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu aṟinta piṟaku tāṉ cariyāṉa vaḻi avarkaḷukkut terintatu.”
āti kālattu cāstirikaḷukku cutta oṟṟumaiyuḷḷa curaṅkaḷ aviḻkkappaṭāta muṭiccup pōliruntaṉa. avarkaḷāl aviḻkkak kūṭā tirunta muṭiccait tāṅkaḷ aviḻttu  viṭṭīrkaḷ. tantiyiṉ aḷavāl kaṇṭupiṭikka vēṇṭumeṉṟu aṟinta piṟakutāṉ cariyāṉa vaḻi avarkaḷukkut terintatu eṉṟu collukiṟīrkaḷ. kātiṉāl ca-pa viṉ oṟṟumaiyai aṟintukoḷḷa vēṇṭiyirukka maṭṭap palakaiyiṉāl 2/3, 3/4 eṉṟu tantiyil aḷantu pōvatu vanta piṟakutāṉinta viparītaṅkaḷellām uṇṭāyiṉa. āṉāl itai meccik koḷḷukiṟīrkaḷ. Pythagoras eṉpavarāl itu ēṟpaṭṭatu. ataṟku muṟpaṭṭa tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ caṅkīta muṟaiyai nīṅkaḷ kavaṉippīrkaḷāṉāl 2/3, 3/4 muṟaiyākac curaṅkaḷaik kaṇṭupiṭippatu cutta aṟiyāmai eṉṟu colluvīrkaḷ.
ōcaiyai aḷappatu kātō, maṭṭappalakaiyō? oruvaṉai maṭṭap palakaiyiṉāl aḷantu iṉṉa uyaramuḷḷavaṉeṉṟum tarācil niṟuttu ittaṉai eṭaiyuḷḷavaṉeṉṟum colliviṭalām. avaṉukkuḷ maṟain tirukkum jīvacaktiyaiyum uttama eṇṇaṅkaḷaiyum aḷappatu etaṉāl muṭiyum? aṉupōkattiṉālum maṉatiṉālum māttiram kaṇṭu koḷḷalām. eṭaiyiṉāl vilai tīrmāṉikkappaṭum vayirattiṟkum kuṇattiṉāl vilai matikkappaṭāta rattiṉattiṟkum oppāṉa curutiyai maṭṭappalakai aṟiyumā? curañāṉattil tērntavaṉē ca-pa viṉ oṟṟumaiyai aṟivāṉ. ca-pa viṉ oṟṟumaiyai aṟinta piṉ pa vai ca vāka vaittuk koṇṭu ataṉ mēl pa aṟivāṉ. immuṟaiyil oru stāyiyai irācivaṭṭamākap pirittu ēḻāvatu ēḻāvatāka varum paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭu piṭittirukkiṟārkaḷ. atai aṟiya muṭiyātavarkaḷ oru stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ eṉṟum 25 curutikaḷ eṉṟum 53 curutikaḷ eṉṟum curutikaḷ aṉantam eṉṟum pitaṟṟuvārkaḷē yoḻiya uṇmaiyaik kāṇamāṭṭārkaḷ.
19. “āṉāl ippaṭic curaṅkaḷ kaṇṭu piṭippatu kaṣṭameṉṟu terintum anta cāstiri etaṟkum payantāṉō? illai, pōy viḻuntu tāṭi oru muṟaiyaik kaṇṭupiṭittāṉ. appērppaṭṭa cāstirikaḷ intiyāvilum kirēkka tēcattilum oruvēḷai ekiptu, ācīriyā, cīṉā tēcaṅkaḷilum kiḷampi cāstirōktamillāta oru caṅkīta muṟaiyai ēṟpaṭutti ellā skēlkaḷum stāyiyai camapākaṅkaḷākap pirippatiṉāl ēṟpaṭukiṟavaikaḷ eṉṟu collic cātittārkaḷ. ellā cāstirikaḷum ivvita muṟaiyaiyē uṇṭākkiṉārkaḷ. oru cāṇ allatu oru muḻattaik koṭukkappaṭṭa aḷavāka niṉaippatu pōl ellā iṭaiveḷikaḷukkum potuvāṉa oru cama aḷavu irukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu niṉaittārkaḷ. intap potuvāṉa cama aḷavu curaṅkaḷukkuḷḷa atinuṭpamāṉa ciṟu vittiyācantāṉ. itai ātāramāka vaittuk koṇṭu taṅkaḷ kālattiluḷḷa vitvāṉkaḷāl upayōkikkappaṭṭa iṭaiveḷikaḷukku veku vicittiramāṉa vitamāyum veku cāmarttiyamāṉa vitamāyum appaṭi ettaṉai nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷ irukkum eṉṟu kaṇṭu piṭittārkaḷ.”
ippaṭi ca-pa, ca-ma muṟaiyai aṟintu koḷḷāta cāstirikaḷ aṉu pōkattilirukkum caṅkītattil eṉṉa eṉṉa curam curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu nitāṉittu ārāyntu pārkkāmal tamakku etirppaṭṭa vaḻiyellām ōṭi vāykku vanta tellām uḷaṟi puttimāṉkaḷaip pōl curuti muṟai eṉṟu pustakam eḻuta ārampittārkaḷ. ētō taṅkaḷukkuk kiṭaitta cila nūlkaḷaip pārttu avaṟṟiṉ irakaciyam viḷaṅkāmaiyāl muṉṉum piṉṉumāyc collit tūṣittārkaḷ. oru stāyiyai camapākamākap pirikka vēṇṭum eṉpatu oruvarukkum teriyāta irakaciyampōl eṇṇik koṇṭu oru ēṇiyait tiṣṭāntam coṉṉārkaḷ. ēṇiyiṉ paḻukkaḷait tiṣṭāntamākac colliyum oru cāṇil oru viraṟkaṭaiyaiyum oru muḻattil mūṉṟu viraṟkaṭaiyaiyum kūṭakkuṟaittu vaittuk koṇṭāl pātakamillai eṉpatu pōlac curamum curutikaḷum muṉpiṉṉāy varalā meṉṟu kaṇakkuk koṭuttārkaḷ. ippaṭippaṭṭa aḷavukaḷiṉāl namatu kāṉamirukkiṟa teṉṟu vāyc camarttākap piracaṅkittum viyācam eḻutiyum intiyāvil periya vitvāṉkaḷeṉṟu koṇṭāṭumpaṭi cila nāḷ kaḻittārkaḷ. taṅkaḷ muṟaippaṭi ārmōṉiyam ceytu parōṭāvil kūṭiya āl intiya miyūcik kāṉpareṉsil akappaṭṭuk koṇṭārkaḷ. ārmōṉiyattilirukkum curaṅkaḷ ca-pa muṟaiyāy oṟṟumai yuḷḷavai yeṉṟum cama iṭaiveḷikaḷuṭaiyavai yeṉṟum cātittārkaḷ. āṉāl cama iṭaiveḷikaḷuṭaiyatāy taṟkālattil aṉupōkattilirukkum curaṅ kaḷukkuk kuṟaintu varukiṟa teṉṟu kaṇṭārkaḷ. kuṟaintu varukiṟa teṉṟu capaimuṉ oppuk koḷḷum nalla eṇṇam vantālum āṟu mātam ākiṟataṟkuḷ vantuviṭṭatu aiyā paḻaiya kutarkkam vantuviṭṭatu. capaiyi luḷḷa yāvarālum āṣēpikkappaṭāmalirunta teṉṉintiya curuti muṟai yaik kōṇal eṉṟu colla ārampittu viṭṭārkaḷ. Equal Temperament eṉṟu ēḷaṉam ceytārkaḷ. ‘etaṟkum payappaṭāmal aṅkumiṅkumāy viḻuntu cāṭi oru muṟaiyaik kaṇṭupiṭittāṉ’ eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. ‘ip pērppaṭṭa payittiyakkāraṉ intiyāvilum kiḷampi cāstirōktamillāta oru caṅkīta muṟaiyai ēṟpaṭuttiṉāṉ’ eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. paritāpam! paritāpam!!

Introduction to the study of Indian Music Page.5.
The ancient believed that if the octave were divided into twenty two roughly equal parts all the notes in use could be obtained. They called these small intervals “Srutis” and spoke of intervals of two Srutis three Sruits and four Srutis and of raising or lowering a note by one Sruti or more. They believed that all the “Shuddh” and Vikrit notes had Srutis to themselves. The author concludes, from a study of Bharata’s Natya Shastra and the Sangit Ratnakar of Sarangdev that their system in reality involved the use of 25 notes to the octave and not 22 as they imagined (Sec appendix E.)
oru stāyiyāṉatu ēṟakkuṟaiya 22 camapākaṅkaḷākap pirikkappaṭṭāl avaṟṟiluḷḷa ellā curaṅkaḷum akappaṭṭuppōkum eṉṟu pūrvattār nampiṉārkaḷ. intac ciṟiya iṭaiveḷikaḷukku avarkaḷ curutikaḷ eṉṟu peyariṭṭārkaḷ. mēlum iraṇṭu curuti iṭaiveḷikaḷ mūṉṟu allatu nālu curuti iṭaiveḷikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟum oru cuvarattaik kūṭṭiyāvatu kuṟaittāvatu piṭikkalāmeṉṟum coṉṉārkaḷ. cutta curaṅkaḷum vikruti curaṅkaḷum curutikaḷālāṉavai eṉṟum nampiṉārkaḷ. inta nūlai eḻutiṉavar parata nāṭṭiya cāstirattaiyum cāraṅkatēvaruṭaiya caṅkīta ratṉākarattaiyum ārāynta piṟaku colvateṉṉaveṉṟāl ‘avar kaḷuṭaiya muṟaiyāṉatu stāyiyil avarkaḷ niyamattiṉpaṭi 22 alla 25 curaṅkaḷ uḷḷatāyirukka vēṇṭum’ eṉpatē.

Verse 47 :- When Ni take the first Sruti of Sa, it is Kaishik; and when it take two, it is Kakali. These are the two Vikrits of Ni
Such are the twelve Vikrits. The total of Shuddh and Vikrit Svara as is nineteen.
Note :- The above classification of Vikrits is inexact and confused. It was probably in vogue among musicians, and Sarangdev took it as he found it. Out of the twelve Vikrits; seven, namely. Chyut Sa, Ma. And Pa, antara and Sadharan Ga, Kaishik and Kakali Ni are new, the rest are old Svaras with new names.
47-vatu aṭi:- niṣātam caṭcamattiṉ mutal curutiyil pēcumpōtu atu kaicikamākum. iraṇṭāvatu curutiyil pēcumpōtu atu kākaliyākum. ivaikaḷē niṣātattiṉ iraṇṭu vikrutikaḷ.

kavaṉippu. inta vitamāy vikruti curaṅkaḷaik kaṇakkiṭuvatu tappu māttiramalla. maṉakkuḻappattai uṇṭupaṇṇuvataṟkum iṭamāyirukkiṟatu. akkāla caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷukkuḷ ippaṭippaṭṭa upayōkam iruntirukka vēṇṭum. cāraṅkatēvar taṉ kaṇ kaṇṭatai eḻuti vaittirukkiṟār. 12 vikruti curaṅkaḷil, cutta ca, ma, pa, antara ka, cātāraṇa ka, kaicika kākali niṣātaṅkaḷākiya ēḻum putitu. maṟṟavai paḻaiya curaṅkaḷ tāṉ. āṉāl putu pērkaḷ avaikaḷukkuk koṭupaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa.
