makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi vaiṇīka cikāmaṇi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷ rippōrṭṭai itaṉpiṉ pārkka.
The opinion of M.R.Ry. Vynika Sikamani Seshanna Avl., of Mysore, on the Question of Srutis.
It gave me great pleasure to attend the Music Conference held on the 11th September last in Tanjore by Rao Sahib Abraham Pandither Avergal and preside over the Committee of experts appointed to examine the Srutis used in Indian Music. Rao Sahib Abraham Pandither Avl. has been making research in the field of Music for several years past and in testing the accuracy of scientific propositions he has had a peculiar advantage in the skilful and marvellous singing of his daughters who have attained high proficiency in the science and art of music. The question that was to be settled in the Conference was one relating to the number of Srutis used in our Music and Rao Sahib Abraham Pandither Avergal’s exposition of them in the light of ancient Tamil works was quite in keeping with the practice now obtaining according to those works, the Sthayi being divisible into 24 Srutis and not 22 as given in Sanskrit works. Half of the 24 coincide with the 12 notes now in use and the other half distribute themselves between these. According to our knowledge the 22 Srutis will not coincide with the 12 Swarams. The 24 Srutis can become 48, or 96 as per Tamil works, and there is no hesitation in saying that the 24 Srutis are correct.
These 12 Srutis are found used in some of the modern Ragas and the division of the Octave into 24 Srutis is quite a practical way of dividing the Sthayi; the Tamil works go still further and state that those 24 Srutis are divisible into 48 and even 96 Sub Srutis.
I do not doubt that the sub-division is reasonable. I am led to think that the correct intonation of the fundamental 12 notes is a work of great labour and skill, and that of the24 Srutis also. The 24 Srutis are attainable after a very high degree of proficiency. Though some of the 48 or 96 Srutis are skipped over while singing or playing, it is almost impossible to locate them definitely and point them out to the observer. For the requirements of the musician, it is enough if he can master the 24 Srutis. But I must not fail to note that the voices of the daughters of Abraham Pandither Avergal are flexible to a wonderful degree and they may, with further cultivation of the art, be able to sound the series of the 48 Srutis also. To the average musician the subject will be a sealed book.
All lovers of music must, therefore, be grateful to the learned Rao Sahib Abraham Pandither Avergal for the unselfish work he has been doing in the cause of Music.
(Sd.) VYNIKA SIKAMANI SESHANNA.
Mysore.
curutikaḷaip paṟṟi maicūr vaiṇīka cikāmaṇi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyam.
cepṭampar௴ 11௳ tañcaiyil rāv cāyap M.āpirakām paṇṭitaravar kaḷāl kūṭṭappaṭṭa caṅkīta kāṉpareṉcil ācarāyirunta intiya caṅkīta curuti vicāraṇaikkeṉṟu ēṟpaṭuttappaṭṭa kamiṟṟikku nāṉ piraciṭeṇṭā yirunta viṣayamāṉatu eṉakku mikunta cantōṣattait koṭuttatu.
paṇṭitaravarkaḷ caṅkīta viṣayattil anēka varuṣaṅkaḷāy uḻaittu vantirukkiṟārkaḷ. tāṅkaḷ ceykiṟa cāstira viṣayamāṉa caṅkatikaḷ caritāṉāveṉṟu cōtittuppārppatil avarkaḷukku atika mukkiyamāṉa oru cātakam ēṟpaṭṭirukkiṟatu. ateṉṉaveṉṟāl caṅkīta cāstirattilum ataṉai aṉupōkattilum atikamāyt tēṟiyirukkiṟa avarkaḷ kumārattikaḷ pāṭum aticayikkattakka arumaiyāṉa caṅkītamē.
intak kāṉpareṉcil niccayikkumpaṭi kuṟikkappaṭṭa viṣayam eṉṉa veṉṟāl, nam caṅkītattil upayōkikkappaṭum curutikaḷ ettaṉai yeṉpatē. itu viṣayattil paṇṭitaravarkaḷ paḻamaiyāṉa tamiḻ nūlkaḷai ātāramākak koṇṭu curutikaḷai vistarittatu taṟkālam annūlkaḷiṉ pirakāram aṉupōkattilirukkum muṟaikku muṟṟilum ottatākavē yiruntatu.
avarkaḷ vistaritta muṟaippaṭi stāyiyai camaskiruta nūlkaḷ colvatu pōl 22 eṉṟu pirikkāmal 24 eṉṟu pirikkiṟārkaḷ. inta 24 il pāti curaṅkaḷ taṟkālam aṉupōkattilirukkum 12 curaṅkaḷtāṉ. maṟṟa 12um ivaikaḷukkiṭaiyē niravappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. namakkut terinta varaiyil 22 curuti muṟaikkum 12 curutikaḷukkum oru nāḷum poruttam varātu. tamiḻ nūlkaḷil colliyirukkiṟapaṭi inta 24 curutikaḷ, 48 ākavum 96 ākavum varalām. 24 curuti muṟai cariyāṉateṉṟu oppuk koḷvataṟkuk koñca mēṉum taṭaiyillai.
taṟkālam pāṭappaṭum anēka irākaṅkaḷil inta 12 curaṅkaḷ upayōkattilirukkiṉṟaṉa. stāyiyai 24 ākap pakuppatu muṟṟilum aṉupōkattiṟku otta cariyāṉa muṟaiyē. āṉāl tamiḻ nūlkaḷil colliyirukkiṟapaṭi intac curutikaḷ itilum nuṭpamāka 48 curutikaḷākavum 96 curutikaḷākavum pirikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
ippaṭi nuṭpa curutikaḷākap pirikkiṟatu niyāyantāṉ eṉpataṟkuc cantēkamillai. 12 curaṅkaḷai varicaiyāyc colluvatu atikak kaṣṭam. tiṟamaiyuḷḷavarkaḷ māttiram appaṭic colla muṭiyum. 24 curutikaḷaic colluvatum appaṭiyē. āṉāl atikamāyt tērnta vitvāṉkaḷ tāṉ itaic cātaṉai ceyya muṭiyum. pāṭumpōtum, vāttiyam vācikkum pōtum, 48, 96 eṉṟa atika nuṭpamāṉa curaṅkaḷaik kamakamākak kāṇpikka lāmē yoḻiya antac curutikaḷ pēcum iṭaṅkaḷaik kuṟippiṭṭu kēṭpavar aṟiyumpaṭi collutal kūṭāta kāriyamāyirukkiṟatu. āṉāl caṅkīta vitvāṉukku 24 curutikaḷaip pāṭam paṇṇiviṭṭāl atuvē caṅkīta viṣayattiṟkup pōtum.
paṇṭitaravarkaḷuṭaiya kuḻantaikaḷiṉ cārīram eppērppaṭṭa caṅkītat tiṟkum vaḷaintu koṭukkakkūṭiya āccariyappaṭattakka iṉimaiyuḷḷatu. (ippōtu avarkaḷ 24 curutikaḷai varicaiyāyc collukiṟārkaḷ.) āṉāl iṉṉum koñcam pirayācattuṭaṉ muyaṟcippārkaḷāṉāl avarkaḷ 48 curuti kaḷaiyum kūṭa varicaiyāyc collakkūṭiyavarkaḷ. āṉāl mattimamāṉa caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷukku inta vittai oru nāḷum varātu.
ākaiyāl caṅkītattai virumpum yāvarum kalviyil ciṟanta nammuṭaiya (Rao Sahib) paṇṭitaravarkaḷ yātoru naṉmaiyaiyum karutāmal caṅkītattiṟkeṉṟē ceytu varukiṟa vēlaikkāka naṉṟi pārāṭṭak kaṭamaip paṭṭirukkiṟārkaḷ.
(oppam) vaiṇīka cikāmaṇi cēṣaṇṇā,

Translated from English.			(True Copy)
The Opinion of M.R.Ry. Vynika Stromani Venkataramanadas Avl.,
Samasthana Vidwan, Vizianagaram.
RESPECTED AND DEAR SIR,
We are all well here and I request you to let me know often about your welfare.
I was very anxious to attend the 7th Conference of the Tanjore Sangeetha Vidva Mahajana Sangam which was held at Tanjore on the 19th of August 1916. But I was detaired here owing to the marriage of the Yuva Raja of this Samasthanam. I regret I had no opportunity to pay you a personal visit owing to the constant musical engagements I had here since the wedding.
I feel glad that I hav had the privilege of travelling with you to Baroda to attend the All India music Conference held there in March of last year, to have heard your discourse on Srutis at the said Conference and to have been present at the demonstrations made by Srimati Maragathavalli Ammal and Kanagavalli Ammal on the Srutis of Karnatic music both at Baroda and at Madras in the presence of M.R.Ry.Sabesa Iyer Avargal.
I can assure you that the 12 Swarams you demonstrated on the Veena are the Swarams of modern Karnatic music. The minuter Srutis used in connection with these Swarams are generally played as Gamakams. But the only mistake in modern music is that the Gamaka Swarams are mentioned as having different kinds of measurements having different irregular intervals. We who have practised the 12 ancient Srutis on the Veena, were ignorant as to how the 22 Srutis should be adjusted on it, and were in doubt for years as to what the 22 Srutis were.
I was very much pleased when you proved before the Vidwans at Baroda that the 22 Srutis system of Saranga Dev was incorrect, that there were only 12 Swarams to the Octav by the SA-PA principle, that each of these Swarams was divided into2 Srutis thus foring the series 24, that ganam was made in the minuter Srutis 48 and 96 of the Octave. I was also cleared of the doubt as regards the 22 Srutis. But my joy reached its utmost limit when Keertanams were sung where these 12, 24, 48 and 96 Srutis were used. This demonstration is beyond the imagination of any Vidwan nor could it be sung by any.
Wheni Srimathi Maragathavalli Ammal and Kanagavalli Amal sang Keertanams in the minute Srutis I was carried into the regions of ecstasy. I have seen many places from the Himalayas to Cape Comorin and I have made the acquaintance of many a musical expert. But I have not found any one to equal Srimati Maragathavalli Ammal in musical ear. When the audience at Baroda listened to her singing how she brought into prominenc even the most insignificant Sruti their joy knew no bounds. Many clapped hands out of sheer joy, spoke words of deep appreciation, an said that a new era had dawned for the musical worl. I was lost in admiration when I witnessed all this novelty.
I was anxious to see how this demonstration work would come off in the Tanjore Conferenc. So I regret very much that I was unable to be present. I was also sorry that I had to disappoint you twic owing to my indisposition. I am explaining your system of Srutis to many an inquirer. I am eagerly looking forward to meting you in person and enjoy the music. I wish God’s blessings on your daughters and other children.
VIZIANAGARAM, 									I remain,
17th May 1917 								Yours sincerely,
								(Sd.) VENKATARAMANADAS

vijayanakaram,

Respected and Dear Sir,
ivviṭam ṣēmamm, ṣēmamttiṟku aṭikkaṭi terivikkumpaṭi kēṭṭukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ.
1916 ām varuṣam ākasṭu mātam 19m tēti tañcaiyil naṭanta caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattiṉ ēḻāvatu kāṉpareṉsukku nāṉ vara mikavum piriyamāyiruntēṉ. āṉāl ivviṭam camastāṉattil yuvarājā vukku kaliyāṇamāṉatāl nāṉ varakkūṭavillai. ataṟkuppintiṉa nāṭkaḷil kaccērikaḷ aṭikkaṭi ēṟpaṭṭukkoṇṭiruntatāl ituvaraiyum varukiṟataṟku cantarppamumillai eṉṟu varuttappaṭukiṟēṉ.
1916ām varuṣam mārccu mātattil parōṭāvil naṭanta āl intiya miyūcik kāṉpareṉsukku taṅkaḷōṭu payaṇam ceyyavum, curutikaḷaip paṟṟi kāṉpareṉsil tāṅkaḷ ceyta piracaṅkattaik kēṭkavum srīmati marakatavalli ammāḷ, kaṉakavalli ammāḷ karnāṭaka kīrttaṉaṅkaḷil varum nuṭpa curutikaḷaippāṭi vīṇaiyil rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭiṉa poḻutum ataṉ piṉ paṭṭaṇattil vantu makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi capēcaiyar avarkaḷukku nuṭpa curutikaḷai rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭiṉa poḻutumkūṭa irukkumpaṭiyāka nērnta taippaṟṟiyum eppoḻutum cantōṣamaṭaintu koṇṭirukkiṟēṉ.
tāṅkaḷ vīṇaiyil rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭiya 12 curaṅkaḷum nam karnāṭaka caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varukiṟa curaṅkaḷē. atōṭu vaḻaṅki varum nuṭpamāṉa cila curaṅḷai kamakamāy nām vaḻaṅki varukiṟōm. āṉāl kamakamāy varukiṟa curaṅkaḷ peritum ciṟitumāṉa iṭaiveḷikaḷuṭaiyaṉavāy pala aḷavil collappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. 12 curattiṉ pūrva vaḻakkattaiyum vīṇai yiṉ amaippiṉpaṭi paḻakiya nāṅkaḷ 22 curutiyai itil amaikkat teriyā malum paḻaka muṭiyāmalum 22 curuti iṉṉateṉṟu collamuṭiyāmalum anēka nāḷ kalaṅkiṉōm.
tāṅkaḷ parōṭā kāṉpareṉsil vitvāṉkaḷ muṉ oru stāyi yil 22 curutikaḷ varukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu coṉṉa caṅkīta ratṉākarar muṟai cariyāṉatallaveṉṟum pūrva tamiḻ nāṭṭiṉ muṟaippaṭi oru stāyiyil ca-pa muṟaiyāy 12 curaṅkaḷ tāṉ amaikiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum ovvoru curamum iraṇṭu alakāyp pirikkappaṭṭu 24 curutikaḷāka vaḻaṅki vantārka ḷeṉṟum atōṭu oru stāyiyai 48 ākavum 96 ākavum pirittu nuṭpa curutikaḷil kāṉam ceytārkaḷeṉṟum rucuppaṭuttikkāṭṭiyapoḻutu nāṉ mikunta cantōṣamaṭaintēṉ. oru stāyiyil 22 curuti yeṉṟa mayakkam eṉaiviṭṭu nīṅkiṟṟu. atōṭu 12, 24, 48, 96 eṉṟa curuti muṟaiyil taṉit taṉi pala kīrttaṉaṅkaḷ pāṭi tiṣṭāntap paṭuttiṉapoḻutu nāṉ aṭainta cantōṣattiṟku aḷavillai. itu enta vitvāṉkaḷiṉālum maṉatiṉāl niṉaikkakkūṭiyatumalla vāyiṉāl collikkāṭṭakkūṭiyatumalla.
srīmati marakatavalliyammāḷum, kaṉakavalli ammāḷum nuṭpa curutikaḷil collik kāṭṭiyapoḻutu mey maṟantu paravacamāṉēṉ. nāṉ kaṉṉiyākumari mutal imayamalai varaiyum pala iṭaṅkaḷ cuṟṟip pārttirukkiṟēṉ. anēka caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷōṭum, cura ñāṉikaḷōṭum pala nāḷ paḻakiyirukkiṟēṉ. āṉāl srīmati marakatavalli ammaḷaippōla nuṭpa curañāṉamuṭaiyavarḷai nāṉ pārttatillai. nilaippaṭāta nuṭpa curaṅkaḷil kārvai koṭuttu collikkāṭṭiyataip pārtta capaiyār yāvarum āṉantamaṭaintārkaḷ. āṉantattiṉāl kai koṭṭiṉārkaḷ. āci moḻikaḷ palavum kūṟiṉārkaḷ. caṅkītattiṟkup putiya ulakam tōṉṟiyirukkiṟateṉṟu colli āṉantittārkaḷ. ivaikaḷellām eṉakku āccariyamum nūtaṉamu māyt tōṉṟiṉa.
tañcai caṅkīta vityā makājaṉa caṅkattil ivaikaḷ eppaṭi rucuppaṭuttappaṭumō eṉṟu pārkka āvalāyiruntēṉ. āṉāl eṉṉāl varakkūṭāmal pōṉataippaṟṟi mikavum varuttappaṭukiṟēṉ. atōṭu nāṉ varukiṟēṉ eṉṟu iraṇṭu taṭavai eḻutiyum varakkūṭāmal acaukkiyam ēṟpaṭṭataip paṟṟi mikavum vicaṉikkiṟēṉ. curutiyaip paṟṟi vicāritta palarkkum taṅkaḷāl collappaṭṭapaṭiyē viḷakkic collik koṇṭum varukiṟēṉ. kūṭiya cīkkirattil avviṭam vantu mukkiyamāy nēril vicārittu cantōṣappaṭa viruppamuḷḷavaṉāyirukkiṟēṉ. kuḻantaikaḷukku eṉ ācīrvātam.
iṅṅaṉam,
taṅkaḷ uṇmaiyuḷḷa,
(oppam.) vēṅkaṭaramaṇatās.

nāṉkām pākam muṟṟiṟṟu


puttakattōṭu cērntu varavēṇṭiyavai.
āyappālai, vaṭṭappālai, tirikōṇappālai caturappālaikaḷil varum curutikaḷ ittaṉai yeṉpatu.
itai vācikkum kaṉavāṉkaḷē!
ituvaraiyum colli vantavaikaḷil cilappatikārattiṉ utaviyāl teḷivākat terintavaikaḷaiyum teḷivāy arttam ceyyakkūṭiyavai kaḷaiyum pala kuṟippukaḷiṉāl ivaikaḷāka irukkalāmeṉṟu niccayikkak kūṭiyavaikaḷaiyum maṭṭum iṅku eḻutiṉēṉ. taṟkāla caṅkītattiṟkum aṉupavattiṟkum ottuvarāta evvita apippirāyamum illai eṉṟu kāṇkiṟēṉ. aṉupavattiṟku varakkūṭiyavaikaḷ evaikaḷō avaikaḷai māttiram eṉṉāl kūṭiyavarai pūrva nūlkaḷiṉ ātārattuṭaṉ colli yirukkiṟēṉ. aṅkuc colliyiruppavai mika nuṭpamākaviruntālum avaṟṟiṟkuc colliyirukkum virivāṉa aṉupavam yāvum avaikaḷi liruntu arttamākak kūṭiyavaikaḷē yoḻiya vēṟillai. pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta curuti muṟai mikunta tērcciyum atika nuṭpamum teḷivum uṭaiyateṉṟu nāṉ tuṇintu colvēṉ.
atōṭu ivaikaḷ ellāvaṟṟaiyum nāṉ oruṅkē aṟintapiṉ innūl eḻutavillai. appōtaikkappōtu teyva kirupaiyiṉāl teḷivāy viḷaṅkiṉa ovvoṉṟaiyum eḷitil viḷaṅkumpaṭi pala mukamāyc colla nēriṭṭatu. appaṭi nāṉ colliyintālum ēṟṟa camayattil kiṭaitta pūrva nūlkaḷiṉ ātārattiṉ karuttum atuvā yirukkiṟateṉṟu kaṇṭu mikunta cantōṣamaṭaintēṉ. pūrva nūlkaḷiṉ karuttukaḷai ārāyumpoḻutum avaikaḷait tiṣṭāntappaṭuttik kāṭṭum poḻutum eṉṉōṭu kalantu cantōṣikkum oruvar illāmal varuntukai yil teyvam tāmē kūṭaviruntu appōtaikkappōtu pūrvamāyuḷḷa mēṟkōḷkaḷaik kāṇumpaṭi ceytataikkoṇṭu ūkkamaṭaintēṉ. eḻutiyavaikaḷ yāvum kūṭiyavarai cariyāyirukkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟu eḻutiyapiṉ kiṭaitta mēṟkōḷkaḷiṉāl aṟintēṉ. avaikaḷil pustakam muṭintapiṉ curutikaḷaippaṟṟi cuvāmi virutai civañāṉayōkikaḷ, tañcāvūr caṅkīta vityāmakājaṉa caṅkattil coṉṉa icai marapu veṇpāvai iṅkuc colvatu yāvarukkum upayōkamāyirukkumeṉṟu nampukiṟēṉ.
		“āyattuk kīrā ṟaṟunāṉku vaṭṭattuk
		kēyuṅkō ṇattuk kiraṭṭipput-tūyavicai
		nuṇmaik katiliraṭṭi nōṉalaku mōrnilaikkiṅ
		keṇmūṉṟu kēḷvikoṇ ṭeṇ.”
itaṉāl oru stāyiyil āyappālaikkup paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅka ḷeṉṟum vaṭṭappālaikku irupattu nāṉku curutikaḷ eṉṟum tirikōṇap pālaiyil 48 curutikaḷ, eṉṟum caturappālaiyil 96 curutikaḷ eṉṟum vaḻaṅki vantārkaḷeṉṟu teḷivāka aṟikiṟōm.
icai nuṇmai eṉṟatāl ataṟku mēṟpaṭṭut teḷivākac collavum, kātiṉāl kēṭkavum muṭiyāteṉṟu varaiyaṟuttuc coṉṉatāka niṉaikkakkūṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. itaṉ muṉ curutikaḷaip paṟṟic collumiṭattil curutikaḷ oṉṟutāṉ. curutikaḷ iraṇṭutāṉ. curutikaḷ mūṉṟu vitam, curutikaḷ nāṉku vitam, curutikaḷ oṉpatu vitam, curutikaḷ irupattiraṇṭu vitam, curutikaḷ aṟupattāṟu vitam, curutikaḷ aṉantantāṉ eṉṟu curutikaḷiṉ niccayam iṉṉateṉṟu teriyāmal coṉṉa vārttaikaḷum curutikaḷ 25, 27, 53, 42, 66 eṟu coṉṉavarkaḷiṉ aṉupōkattiṟku varāta niccayamillāta vārttaiyumpōl illāmal itu mikat teḷivākavum aṉupōkattiṟku varakkūṭiyatākavum tiṭṭamākavu mirukkiṟatu.
curutikaḷ aṉantantāṉ eṉṟu colliviṭṭapiṉ evar etaic coṉṉālum atellām poruntum eṉṟu arttamākiṟatu. itu cantēkap paṭṭavarkaḷ oḷintu koḷḷa aṭaikkalastāṉam pōliruntatiṉimittam curutikaḷaippaṟṟi mayakkam uṇṭāyiṟṟu.
āṉāl icai nuṇmai atāvatu icaiyil nuṭpamāṉa aḷavu oru stāyiyil 1/96 eṉṟu colvatai nām kavaṉikkum poḻutu kātiṉāl kēṭkavum vāyiṉāl collavum kūṭāta ōcai ataṟku mēlillai eṉat teḷivāka varaiyaṟuttuc colliyirukkiṟār eṉṟu terikiṟatu. pala ōcaiyiṉ alaikaḷ cērntu oru curutiyāṉālum 1/96 āṉa icai nuṇmaikku mēl ōcaiyiṉ alai collavum kēṭkavum kūṭiyatalla eṉṟu vīṇaiyil, nām pirattiyaṭcamāy aṟivatē pōtum eṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ. ataṟkuk kuṟainta curuti illai yeṉpatu niccayam.
teḷivākac collum icait tamiḻ nūlkaḷ muṉṉāṭiyē namakku kiṭaikkātataṉāl virivāka eḻuta vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu. icaittamiḻ nūlkaḷil oṉṟākiya icaimarapu eṉṉum nūliṟ cilapakutikaḷ tiruvāvaṭu tuṟai ātīṉattaic cārnta puttakacālaiyil iruppatākak kēḷvip paṭukiṟōm. icceyyuḷil collappaṭum curutik kaṇakkukaḷai aṉucarittē itaṉmuṉ pala pākaṅkaḷ collappaṭṭiruppataṉāl aṟivāḷi kaḷukku itu pōtumeṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ.
2. ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷiṉ peyar pūrva tamiḻp peyarē camaskiruta peyaralla eṉpatu.
curaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiyum curutikaḷaip paṟṟiyum nāṉ eḻuti varum puttakattiṉ nōkkamaṟiyāta cilar taṟkālam vaḻaṅki varum caṅkīta muṟaikaḷai māṟṟiyirukkiṟēṉ eṉṟum māṟṟappōkiṟēṉ eṉṟum camaskiruta pāṣaiyil eḻutiya caṅkīta ratṉākarariṉ apippirāyaṅkaḷai muṟṟilum māṟṟi viṭṭēṉ eṉṟum pala āṣēpaṉai collit tamiḻil taṅkaḷait tērntavarkaḷeṉṟu collikkoṇṭu vēṇṭumeṉṟē tamiḻ moḻiyōṭu pala aṉṉiya moḻikaḷaik kalantu tamiḻaik keṭuttuk koṇṭirukkum tamiḻ vitvāṉkaḷ cilaraik kutarkkam ceyyumpaṭit tūṇṭiviṭṭārkaḷ. avarkaḷ kēṭṭa pala kēḷvikaḷukkut takunta patil appōtaik kappōtu colliyirukkiṟēṉ.
atil oruvar ‘ca ri ka ma pa ta ni’ eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷum ṣaṭjamam, riṣapam, kāntāram, mattimam, pañcamam, taivatam, niṣātam eṉṟa camaskiruta vārttaikaḷiliruntu piṟantirukkiṉṟaṉa. camaskiruta uccarippiṉpaṭi ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷum vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟaṉa. tāṅkaḷ ivaikaḷukku nūtaṉamāy vēṟu peyarkaḷ koṭuttu viṭṭāl mikavum naṉṟāyirukkum’ eṉṟu coṉṉārkaḷ. ṣaṭjama, riṣapa, kāntāra, mattima, pañcama, taivata, niṣātaṅkaḷiliruntē ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa eḻuttukkaḷ vantirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu palarum eṇṇuvatiṉāl avai appaṭiyalla veṉṟu teḷivuṟac colla vēṇṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. 60m pakkattil ivaikaḷaip paṟṟic ciṟitu colliyiruntālum, ivaikaḷaiyum cērttup pārppatu cantēka nivarttikku ētuvākumeṉṟu eṇṇukiṟēṉ.
ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum mutal mutal tamiḻ moḻiyilēyē vaḻaṅki vantaṉaveṉṟum caṅkīta cāstiram mut tamiḻil oṉṟāyirunta teṉṟum pala kuṟippukaḷāl aṅkaṅkē colli yirukkiṟōm. avaṟṟuḷ,
		“ca ri ka ma pa ta ni yeṉ ṟēḻeḻuttāṟ ṟāṉam
		variparanta kaṇṇiṉāy vaittut - terivariya
		vēḻicaiyun tōṉṟu mivaṟṟuḷḷē paṇpiṟakkuñ
		cūḻmutalāñ cuttat tuḷai”
eṉṟu cikaṇṭi māmuṉivar coṉṉa veṇpāvaik kavaṉikkum poḻutu iṭaiccaṅka kālattilēyē, ca, ri, ka, ma pa ta ni eṉṟu ēḻu curaṅkaḷ collum vaḻakkamiruntatākat terikiṟatu.
iṭaiccaṅka kālattilirunta ivarukku muṉṉum mutaṟcaṅka kālattil akattiyarālum avarukku muṉṉirunta kalaivallōrālum tamiḻ nāṭṭilēyē iyal icai nāṭakameṉṉum muttamiḻum vaḻaṅki vantaṉaveṉṟu teḷivāy aṟiyakkūṭiyatāyirukkiṟatu. akkālattu nūlkaḷ namakkuk kiṭaikkavillai. āṉālum mutaṟcaṅkattil vaḻaṅki vanta muṟaippaṭiyē iṭaiccaṅkakālattum vaḻaṅkiyirukka vēṇṭum. ammuṟai yaiyē cikaṇṭi māmuṉivarum iṭaiccaṅka kālattilum coṉṉār.
camaskiruta pāṣaiyil caṅkīta nūl eḻutiya aintām nūṟṟāṇṭi liruntu paratar, patiṉmūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭilirunta caṅkīta ratṉākarar pōṉṟavarkaḷukku vekukālattiṟku muntiyatu immuṟaiyeṉṟu aṟivōm. pūrvamāyuḷḷa tamiḻ nāṭṭiṟkup pēccup paḻakttilillāta ēṭṭu moḻiyaik koṇṭu vanta āriyar tamiḻ nāṭṭil vaḻaṅkumpala kalaikaḷai yum, taṅkaḷ pāṣaiyil tiruppuvataṟkāka ariya vēlaikaḷ ceytu vantārkaḷ. avarkaḷil caṅkīta ratṉākarar oruvar. avar tamiḻ moḻiyil vaḻaṅkum caṅkītattiṟku nūl eḻutukaiyil tamiḻ nūlukkum, camaskiruta nūlukkum vittiyācam tōṉṟumpaṭi pala kāraṇap peyarkaḷaiyum, katai kaḷaiyum colliyiruntālum avaikaḷ muṟṟilum poruntātavaikaḷ eṉṟu teḷivāka aṟikiṟōm. utāraṇamāka, tiruveṇkāṭu (cuvētā raṇiyam,) maṟaikkāṭu (vētāraṇiyam,) tiruvaiyāṟu (pañcanata ṣēttiram,) kuṭamūkku (kumpakōṇam,) tiruvāvaṭutuṟai (kōmutti ṣēttiram,) tiruviṭaimarutūr (mattiyārccuṉam,) puliyūr (viyākkirapuram) ciṟṟampalam (citamparam,) tāyumāṉavar (mātarpūtīsvarar) mutaliyavai tamiḻ vārttaiyiṉ nērāṉa moḻipeyarppeṉṟum aṟivōm. ivaikaḷaippōlavē itaṉ muṉṉum irākaṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷai māṟṟi vaittiruppatākac colliyirukkiṟōm. karuṇāmirta cākaram mutal puttakam mūṉṟām pākam kāṇka.
māṟṟiya ūrp peyarkaḷaik kavaṉikkaiyil avaikaḷ pūrvamāy mikap paricuttamāka eṇṇappaṭṭaṉaveṉṟum kaṭavuḷaruḷ peṟṟa periyōrāl pāṭal peṟṟavaiyeṉṟum tamiḻ makkaḷāl koṇṭāṭap paṭṭavaiyeṉṟum nām aṟivōm. tiruvaiyāṟu eṉum col aintu paricuttamāṉa natikaḷ ōṭum iṭam eṉṟu poruḷ paṭukiṟatu. itaiyē pañcanata ṣēttirameṉṟu peyar māṟṟi vaḻaṅkiṉālum taṟkāla tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki varukiṟa peyar pūrvat tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta paḻaiya peyarēyoḻiya camaskirutatti liruntu vanta peyaralla veṉṟu teḷivāka aṟivōm. appaṭiyē atil eḻuntaruḷi teyvattiṟku aiyāṟappaṉ eṉṟu peyar vaḻaṅkukiṟatē.
icait tamiḻil vaḻaṅki varum ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa ēḻu kuṟip peḻuttukkaḷiṉ viparam icaittamiḻ nūlil virivāyc colli yirukkalām. avaikaḷ ippoḻutu kiṭaikkātataṉāl nām pala vitamāy niṉaikka ētuvākiṟatu. caṅkīta ratṉākarar ṣaṭjamam, riṣapam, kāntāram eṉum curaṅkaḷukku oru vitamākavum, mattimam pañcamam eṉṉum curaṅkaḷukku vēṟu oru muṟaiyākavum taivatam niṣātaṅkaḷukku maṟṟoru vitamāka vum kāraṇam kāṭṭip peyar kaṟpittār.
mattiyāy varuvataṉāl atāvatu ātāra caṭjattukkum mēl caṭjat tukkum naṭuviluḷḷa tantiyil caripātiyil varuvatāl mattimam eṉkiṟār.
ēḻu curaṅkaḷil aintāvatāy varuvataṉāl pañcamam eṉṟār. āṉāl arai cura muṟaippaṭi ēḻāvatāka varukiṟatu. itupōlavē nālāvatākavum, āṟāvatākavum, mutalāvatākavum, kaṭaiciyākavum varuvataṟkum peyar kaṟpittiruntāl naṉṟāyirukkum.
iṉṉum riṣapattiṉ kuralai ottiruppataṉāl riṣapam eṉṟār. maṟṟaiya eḻuttukkaḷukkum itu pēril kāraṇam kāṭṭi yāṉaiyiṉ (kajam) kuralai ottiruppatāl niṣātattai ka eṉṟum, kutiraiyiṉ (asvam) kuralai ottiruppatāl taivatattai a eṉṟum, kuyil (kōkilam) ōcaiyai ottiruppatāl pañcamatti kō eṉṟum, kiravuñcapaṭciyiṉ ōcaiyai ottiruppatāl mattimattai ki eṉṟum, mayiliṉ (mayūram) ōcaiyai ottiruppatāl ṣaṭjamattai ma eṉṟum collalāmē, itupōl iv veḻuttukkaḷai mutalākat toṭaṅkum vārttaikaḷ ettaṉaiyō irukkiṉṟaṉavē.
mēlum ka ca ṭa ta pa ṟa eṉṟa valleḻuttukkaḷ melleḻuttukka ḷōṭum, iṭai eḻuttukkaḷōṭum, maṟṟa uyirmey eḻuttukkaḷōṭum moḻikku mutalilum - naṭuvilum ōcai māṟupaṭṭu vevvēṟu vitamāy uccarikkappaṭuvatai aṟiyāmal ēḻu curaṅkaḷiṉ mutal curamāṉa sa camaskiruta eḻuttāyirukkiṟataṉāl camaskirutattiliruntē curaṅkaḷ vantirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟum anēkar collik koḷḷukiṟārkaḷ.
ṣaṭjamam eṉpatu āṟu curaṅkaḷai aṭakkikkoṇṭiruppateṉṟum āṟu iṭaṅkaḷiliruntu piṟappatiṉāl ataṟku ṣaṭjamam eṉṟu peyar vantateṉṟum ākaiyiṉāl curaṅkaḷ camaskirutattilintu vantaṉaveṉṟum palar collak kēṭṭirukkiṟēṉ. caṟṟuk kūrntu kavaṉittāl appaṭiyalla veṉpatu teḷivākat teriyum.
eppaṭi eṉṟāl ṣaṭjamam eṉpatiluḷḷa ṣaṭu, ṣaṭvarkkam, ṣaṭūrmi, ṣaṭrākam, ṣaṣṭi eṉum vārttaikaḷilpōla āṟu eṉṉum poruḷaik kuṟikkiṉṟatu. jam eṉpatu piṟakkiṟatu, piṟappikkiṟatu, piṟakkiṟataṟku iṭamā yirukkiṟatu eṉṟu arttamām. ṣaṭjamattiliruntu ri ka ma pa ta ni ca eṉṟa ēḻu curam piṟantāl māttiram oru stāyi pūraṇamākum. mutal ātāra ṣaṭjamam tāyāṉāl atiliruntu
ri ka ma pa ta ni ca eṉṟa ēḻu curaṅkaḷum piḷḷaikaḷākap piṟakkum. ēḻu piḷḷaikaḷiliruntu tāyaiyotta ca eṉṟa peṇṇiṉāl maṟṟum ēḻu curaṅkaḷ piṟakkum. tāyaippōl oru peṇkuḻantai piṟakkāmal pōṉāl tārastāyiyum, mantara stāyiyumillāmal pōkumē.
mēlum ṣaṭjam āṟu iṭattiliruntu piṟakkiṟateṉṟu collukiṟārkaḷ. pāṣaiyiṉ eḻuttukkaḷ palavum āṟu iṭaṅkaḷiṉ utavi yiṉāl uccarikkap paṭukiṉṟaṉavaveṉṟu colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ. āṉāl ṣa eṉṟa eḻuttu āṟu iṭattiliruntu uṇṭākiṟatākac collappaṭa villai. aṭittoṇṭai, uṇṇākku, nuṉinākku eṉṟum mūṉṟu mukkiya māṉa iṭaṅkaḷil iraṇṭoru aṅkaṅkaḷ cērntu ōcaikaḷ piṟakkumē yoḻiya āṟu iṭaṅkaḷilumiruntum oru eḻuttup piṟappatu kūṭāta kāriyam. 
mēlum ṣaṭjam eṉṟa vārttaiyiṉ mutal eḻuttukkum sa ri ka ma eṉṟa curaṅkaḷiṉ mutal eḻuttukkum evvita campantamumillai. ṣa, sa vāka vaḻaṅkukiṟataṟku evvita ātāramumillai. āṉāl ca eṉṟa tamiḻ eḻuttu sa vāka melintu varukiṟataṟkup pala utāraṇam colli yirukkiṟēṉ. (karuṇāmirta cākaram mutal puttakam nāṉkām pākam 59-m pakkam kāṇka.) tamiḻ vaḻakkiṉpaṭi sa eṉṟu varalāmēyoḻiya camaskiruta muṟaippaṭi appaṭi varuvataṟku koñcamēṉum niyāyamillai.
ruṣapam eṉṟa vārttaiyiliruntu ri eṉṟa meyyeḻuttu varuvataṟku evvita ātāramumillai. kāntāram eṉṟa colliṉ mutal eḻuttu ka eṉṟu varuvataṟku taivatam eṉṟa vārttaiyiṉ tai eṉṟa mutal eḻuttu ta eṉṟu āvataṟkum ātāramillai. itaṉāl ca ri ka ma pa ta ni eṉṟa eḻuttiṟkuk kāraṇam kaṟpikka vantavar colliya kāraṇam cariyāṉatalla veṉṟu tōṉṟukiṟatu.
itōṭu ka, pa, ta eṉṉum curaṅkaḷ camaskiruta eḻuttukkaḷiṉ mūṉṟām ōcaiyaiyuṭaiyavaikaḷāka vaḻakkattilirukkiṉṟaṉa. itaṉāl camaskirutattiliruntē curaṅkaḷ vantirukka vēṇṭumeṉṟu yāvarum eṇṇa iṭamākiṟatu. āṉāl valleḻuttiṉ ōcai muṉ piṉ varum melleḻuttāl camaskiruta eḻuttukkaḷiṉ ōcaipōl uccarikkappaṭukiṟa teṉṟu itaṉmuṉ karuṇāmirta cākaram mutal puttakam iraṇṭām pākattil pala utāraṇaṅkaḷōṭu colliyirukkiṟōm.
kāntāram, taṉakkup piṉvarum ma eṉṟa melleḻuttālum, pañcamam taṉakku muṉ varum ma eṉṟa melleḻuttālum taivatam taṉakkup piṉvarum na eṉṟa melleḻuttālum ōcai māṟuvataiyum itupōl anēka iṭaṅkaḷil ōcaimāṟi tamiḻil veku vārttaikaḷ pūrvakālan toṭṭu vaḻaṅki varuvataiyum kavaṉittāl iccantēkamum nīṅki viṭum.
3. capta curaṅkaḷaippaṟṟi makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi nārāyaṇa cāstirikaḷ apippirāyam
curaṅkaḷiṉ ōcaikaḷaippaṟṟi nāṉ oruvāṟu colliyiruntālum, ivaikaḷai ārāya vēṇṭumeṉṟu tiruvaiyāṟu ḷuyaḷēmacavai College Senior Professor āṉa makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi nārāyaṇa cāstiri avarkaḷukkut terivittu caṅkīta ratṉākarar eḻutiya iraṇṭu pustakattaiyum koṭukka avarkaḷ avvāṟē ārāyntu eḻutiyirukkum kaṭitam aṭiyil varumāṟu :-
“makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi rāv cāyap M.āpirakām paṇṭitar avarkaḷ naṉku ārāyntu ippōtu iyaṟṟiya karuṇāmirta cākarameṉum caṅkīta cāstirattai naṉṟāy uṇarntu cāraṅkatēvar ceyta caṅkīta iratṉā karattai ārāyntu pārttatil tōṉṟiṉa viḷakkattai ulakattōrkaḷ aṟiyap piracurap paṭuttukiṟēṉ. atāvatu :-
cāraṅkatēvar vivaritta ca, ri, ka, ma, pa, ta, ni eṉkiṟa ēḻu curak kuṟikaḷ kāraṇap peyaruḷḷavaikaḷeṉpatu. iṭukuṟippeyar eṉṟu meyppittu viḷakkukiṟa B.c. ilirunta cikaṇṭimāmuṉivar aruḷic ceyta icainūlukku virōtappaṭukiṉṟatu. aṉṟiyum ṣaṭjā eṉṟa patattiliruntu ca vum ruṣapa eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ri yum, kāntāra eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ka vum mattima eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ma vum, pañcama eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu pa vum, taivata eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ta vum, niṣāta eṉkiṟa patattiliruntu ni yum, vantaṉa eṉṟu uraikkil kṣa eṉkiṟa camaskiruta aṭcaram sa eṉkiṟa māṟutalai aṭaivataṟkum, ru eṉkiṟa camaskiruta uyir eḻuttu ri eṉṟu camaskiruta meyyeḻuttāka māṟukiṟataṟkum kā eṉkiṟa tīrkkam ka eṉṟu kuṟukuva taṟkum, taivata eṉpatil ta eṉṟu akāra vaṭivamaintu varuvataṟkum yātoru camaskiruta viyākaraṇa piramāṇam kāṇamuṭiyāmaiyālum ṣaṭja mutaliya ēḻu pataṅkaḷum kāraṇac coṟkaḷ eṉṟu kāṭṭuvaṟkāka riṣapa, kāntāra, taivata eṉkiṟa mūṉṟu pataṅkaḷiṉ poruḷ ārāycciyil curaṅkaḷai cammantittavaikaḷākavē cāraṅkatēvar vivarippatāl ṣaṭja mattima, pañcama, niṣāta eṉkiṟa uraikaḷ curaṅkaḷaiyē cammantittateṉak kūṟuvatu kiramamillāmaiyum apanniyāyattaiyum ṣaṇṭa, rutam, kātram, maturam, paṭṭalam, tairiyam mutalāṉa camaskiruta pataṅkaḷil mutal akṣaramāka atippiracaṅkippatālum tirāviṭarkaḷ amaitta iṭukuṟip peyarai māṟṟuvataṟkeṭutta puraṭṭupāyameṉṟu tīrmāṉikkappaṭukiṟatu.
ca, ka, ta eṉkiṟa ōcaikaḷ tamiḻp pāṣaikkuriyatallāviṭilum kirantāṭcarattil paḻaiya cāmavēta ēṭukaḷil hūm eṉṟu eḻutiyatu him eṉṟu olippatupōl tamiḻilum ciṟcila cantarppaṅkaḷil ca, ka, ta, ja, ta, pa, ṭa, pa olippatu tiṭṭameṉṟu Mr. Rao Sahib paṇṭitar avarkaḷ ௸ karuṇāmirta cākarattil eṭuttu vivarittiruppatu mika viyakkattakkatu. mataṅkar mutaliya varkaḷ uraittālum niyāyattiṟku icaiyāmaiyāl mūṭa paktiyai māttiram muṉṉiṭṭu inta irupatām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ nākarīkattil nilai niṟutta muṭiyātu. nāratar mutaliya māmuṉivarkaḷ aruḷicceyta camas kiruta caṅkīta nūlkaḷ piṟkālattiya vaitīka camaskiruta paṇṭitarkaḷ caṅkītattai tuvēṣittatāl pulappaṭātu uṇmaiyillāmaiyai tākkuvatā yiṟṟeṉṟu tiṭṭamāy eṭutturaikkat tuṇiyalāṉēṉ.
(oppam) nārāyaṇa cāstirikaḷ.

Dear Sir,
Thanks for your kind pamphlet. Your adversary’s opinion I treat with contempt of the most sovereign character. He leaves the main issue and proceeds to strike shadows. His tasts are certainly of a very low order, especially when he expressed his contempt for his audience to please whom we went all the way to Baroda. I know he is an intelligent man. Not that he can’t but he won’t - understand you. You can awake a really sleeping man but not a man who pretends to sleep. Do you know when the Report of the Baroda Conference will be out? Did you hear anything about it from Mr. Bhatkandi.
(Sd.) M.S.RAMASAMY IYER.

SATYA VILAS,
VIZIANAGARAM,
26th March 1917.
Dear Sir,
Many thanks for the two Pamphlets “Mr.E.Clements on Indian Music” and your remarks on his second letter. Kindly excuse me for the delay I made in acknowledging the above two books. From the very beginning I was reading with interest your replies to Mr.Clements. as I was away from here I could not write to your earlier. Day before yesterday I had a long talk with my friend Mr. Veena Venkataramana Doss, the famous Veena Player. He explained to me your theory of Srutis and I read the book with much interest. There was also another Veena Player Sriman K. Padmanabhaswamy Garu who was also a court musician in the time of the late Maharaja. He is also of opinion that your theory of Srutis is correct. Mr. Venkata Ramanadoss showed me your wire and he said that he is proceeding to you in 2 or 3 days. I am extremely happy to hear that you are a Vidwan of Vidwans in spite ofyour multifarious duties. On the 16th instant Vynika Sikamani Seshanna came here in connection with the mariage festivities of the Yuva Raj and I had some talk with him about the musical controversy between you and Mr.Clements. He also tells me that your system of Music is quite correct. He has much regard for you and, I think, you quite deserve it.
Mr. Venkata Ramanadoss was telling me that you have a music Conference every year at Tanjore. Will you please let me know the month in which you have it? I am glad you are happy father of two ladies who are well accomplished in music. I was hearing of their high attainment in music. Is the report (full) of the first All Indian Music Conference published? I have also written to my friend Mr. V.N.Bhatkhande and I think he will send me a copy of it.
I request you to send me a copy of Karunamirtha Sagaram, as soon you publish to it.
If the book is published in Tamil I am sorry I am quite unable to read and if the book is published in Telugu or English or even Sanskrit, I can easily go through it.
*      *      *      *      *     *      *      *      *      *     *      *      *      *      *
I dont think Mr.Clements will write any more articles after having a bitter Pill from you. Honest criticism is always desirable and praiseworthy, but criticism with spite is always abominable.
Once more thanking you for your two small Pamphlets.
With best regards,
I remain,
Yours very faithfuly,
(Sd.) K.L.NARASINGA ROW
SATYA VILAS,
VIZIANAGARAM,
26th March 1917.

“intiya caṅkītattaippaṟṟi Mr.kiḷameṇsuṭaiya apippirāyamum avaruṭaiya iraṇṭāvatu kaṭitattiṟku maṟuppum” eṉṟa ciṟu puttakaṅkaḷai aṉuppiyataṟkāka anēka vantaṉam collukiṟēṉ. pustakaṅkaḷ vantu cērntaṉa eṉṟu oppukkoḷvatil tāmatamāṉataṟkāka maṉṉikkumpaṭi kēṭṭukkoḷḷukiṟēṉ. kiḷameṇṭs turaikkut tāṅkaḷ eḻutiya maṟuppai ātimutal veku piriyattōṭu vācittēṉ. nāṉ ūril illātapaṭiyāl itaṟku muṉ eḻutakkūṭāmaṟ pōyiṟṟu. pērpōṉa vīṇai vitvāṉākiya eṉ cinēkitar vēṅkaṭaramaṇatās avarkaḷuṭaṉ nēṟṟaikku muntiṉa nāḷ vekunēram pēcikkoṇṭiruntēṉ. avar taṅkaḷ curuti muṟaiyai eṉakku viḷakkik kāṭṭiṉār. nāṉ taṅkaḷ pustakattaip piriyattuṭaṉ vācittēṉ. kālañceṉṟa makārājāviṉ kālattil camastāṉa vitvāṉāyirunta srīmāṉ patmanāpasvāmikāruvum appoḻutu kūṭa iruntār. avarum taṅkaḷiṉ curutimuṟai cariyeṉṟē apippirāyap paṭukiṟār. tāṅkaḷ aṉuppiṉa tanti camācārattai vēṅkaṭaramaṇatās avarḷ eṉṉiṭattil kāṇpittu iraṇṭoru tiṉattil taṅkaḷiṭam pōvatākac coṉṉārkaḷ. taṅkaḷukkup pala vēlai tontaravukaḷiruntum caṅkīta viṣayattil vitvāṉkaḷukku vitvāṉāy viḷaṅkukiṟīrkaḷ eṉṟu kēḷvippaṭuvatu eṉakkuc collamuṭiyāta cantōṣattai uṇṭākkukiṟatu. 16-m tētiyaṉṟu vaiṇīka cikāmaṇi cēṣaṇṇā avarkaḷ yuvarājāviṉ kaliyāṇa viṣayamāy iṅku vantiruntapōtu taṅkaḷukkum kiḷameṇṭs turaikkum caṅkīta viṣayamāyuḷḷa tarkkattaippaṟṟiavarkaḷiṭam ciṟitu nēram pēcikkoṇṭiruntēṉ. avarkaḷum taṅkaḷ curutimuṟai muṟṟilum cariyeṉṟu eṉṉiṭam coṉṉārkaḷ. taṅkaḷiṭam avarkaḷukku veku apimāṉam. atu takutiyē eṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ.
tāṅkaḷ ovvoru varuṣamum tañcaiyil oru kāṉpareṉs kūṭṭuvatāka vēṅkaṭaramaṇatās avarkaḷ eṉṉiṭam coṉṉārkaḷ. atu naṭakkum mātattait tayavuceytu eṉakkut terivippīrkaḷā? caṅkītattil tērccipeṟṟa iraṇṭu kumārattikaḷ taṅkaḷukku uṇṭeṉak kēḷvippaṭṭuc cantōṣamaṭaikiṟēṉ. avarkaḷ pāṇṭittiyattaippaṟṟi nirampak kēḷvip paṭṭēṉ. āl intiya kāṉpareṉciṉ mutalāvatu mīṭṭiṅkaip paṟṟiya rippōrṭ piracuramāyviṭṭatā? eṉ cinēkitar pātkaṇṭa avarkaḷukkum itaippaṟṟi eḻutiyirukkiṟēṉ. avarkaḷ eṉakku atil oru kāppi aṉuppuvārkaḷ eṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ.
taṅkaḷuṭaiya “karuṇāmirta cākaram” veḷiyāṉavuṭaṉ atil eṉakku oru kāppi aṉuppumpaṭi pirārttittuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ.
atu tamiḻil eḻutappaṭṭiruntāl eṉṉāl vācikka muṭiyātu. āṉāl teluṅku allatu iṅkilīṣ allatu camaskiruta pāṣaiyil eḻutappaṭṭiruntālum nāṉ eḷitil vācikkakkūṭum.

uṅkaḷuṭaiya kacappāṉa māttiraiyaic cāppiṭṭa kiḷameṇṭs turai iṉimēl enta viyācamum eḻutat tuṇiyamāṭṭār eṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ. uṇmaiyāṉa maṟuppu eppōtum avaciyamāṉatu. atai nām viyantu koḷḷa vēṇṭiyatu. āṉāl varmattuṭaṉ kūṭiya maṟuppu eppōtum aruvarukkappaṭattaktu. taṅkaḷuṭaiya iraṇṭu pustakaṅkaḷukkāka maṟupaṭiyum vantaṉam aḷikkiṟēṉ.

Vakil.
Dear Sir,
Many thanks for your kind Pamphlet. I stand in admiration that you possess such an exact and extensive erudition in matters musical. I know South India would not have come out so triumphant in the Baroda Conference, if you had not been present there. But what about he Conference? Is there no second Conference? Probably the Baroda Conference had a special aim i.e., putting down Deval & Co. That over, people there have gone to sleep! Why don’t you convene a similar Conference here and invite people from other parts as well? You are the properest person I think. Praying for your long life and prosperity.
2-4-1917. 									I am every yours,
(Sd.) M.S.RAMASWAMI AIYAR.

TANJORE, MUNICIPAL CHAIRMAN.
Dear Sir,
My best thanks have been due to you, for a long time, for having kindly sent me your replies to the criticism of Mr.Clements. I have perused the papers with great interest and pleasure.
You have made, the Science of Indian Music the study of a life-time, and have brought to bear upon it, a clear intellect, calm judgement, and above alla passionate lov of the Art. No wonder the results are so valuable.
I was present at the last musical Conference in your house, some months back, and witnessed the frank and systematic manner in which the discussions were conducted. You have also been kind enought to explain to me your views, with practical illustrations - both vocal and instrumental - by your accomplished daughters. Their performance is, I need hardly say - exquisite.
I am sure that the fairness and correctness of your expositions, will eventually be acknowledged by Mr. Clements, and other controversialists, and full justice rendered to your labour of lov in so dificult an agreeable a field of research.
Yours sincerely,
(Sd.) R.CHAKRAPANI RAO,

R.CHAKRAPANI RAO, B.A., 							TANJORE,

The Social Reform Advocate - 7th April 1917.
The Srutis in Indian Music
This book is a refutation of the position taken up by Mr.E.Clements that there are 32 Srutis in the Indian octave and is in reply to a letter from this gentleman to the Rao Sahib controverting the position assumed by the Rao Sahib. The reply sometimes oversteps the bounds of controversial dignity and is full of humorous bits which are not always graceful.
The question at issue between the disputants is as to whether there are 22 or 24 Srutis in the octave and primarily whether the octave divisions are of equal temperament or unequal and according to some natural scale.
Mr.Clements claims that the scales used are naturl scales and that the system of equal temperament is quite alien to Indian music. On the other hand the Rao Sahib claims that the Indian scale is one based on equal temperament and so the octave is divided into 12 semitones, these being further sub-divided into 24 quarter tones and so on. His qrgument receives strong testimny from some verses on Isai Tamil in an ancient Tamil work of about the 3rd century A.D., which show that in the South at any rate the system of equal temperament was in vogue. The question is rather a difficult one to decide without the opportunity of hearing the melodies rendered according to both systems. The Rao Sahib certainly has the better of the argument and if his dictum is true it will be much easier for Hindu music lovers to evolve a regular system which can be used by the ordinary person with a certain amount of ease.
As far as one can gather the special harmonium constructed by Mr.Clements and produced before the Baroda Conference failed entirely to give a correct interpretation of Indian ragas and did not commend itself to the musical experts present.
It is a great pity that the report of this Baroda Conference has not yet been published. It is to be regretted that musical questions of this sort should become matters of bitter controversy rather than matters of serious and friendly discussion.
It is hoped that other will take up this matter and try to work it out by careful experiment rather than by reference to ancient classics.
Both protagonists are to be commended for the study which they have given to Indian music; and the Rao Sahib is to be congratulated upon his careful researches into ancient classics as well as upon his scientific experiments upon the notes themselves. We hope that His Highness the Maharajah of Baroda will shortly summon another Conference on Indian music and that the question of the Stutis in present use may be settled once for all so that an ordered system may be built up.
As it is, we have to decide upon insufficient evidence for one side or the other, and in a matter which will vitally affect Indian Music in the future. If Mr. Clement’s position is adopted, then Indian Music must either return to its chaotic condition or else become a kind of westernised product. If on the other hand the Rao Sahib is correct, there willbe no difficulty in accurately rendering all Indian notes and in teaching Indian Music according to a thoroughly scientific system. It may be said that the practice in the South has always very largely folowed the method commended by the Rao Sahib while the North has relied far more upon tradition for the production of the proper notes. This fact partly accounts for the positions taken up by the two protagonists, Mr. Clements having lived in the North and not having come into contact with Carnatic Music.
The Social Reform Advocate 7th April 1917.

tañcai rāv cāyap M.āpirakām paṇṭitar avarkaḷāl eḻutappaṭṭatu.
intiya caṅkīta stāyiyil 22 curutikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu apippirāyap paṭukiṟa kiḷameṇṭs turaiyaik kaṇṭittu itu eḻutappaṭṭatu. rāv cāyap avarkaḷiṉ apippirāyattai maṟuttu kiḷameṇṭs turai eḻutiyataṟku itu patil. inta maṟuppāṉatu cila camayaṅkaḷil tarkkattukkuriya oru perumaikku irukkavēṇṭiya ellaiyaik kaṭantu viṭukiṟatu. atil cilēṭaip pirayōkamāṉa tukkaṭākkaḷ ērāḷamāyiruppatāl cila camayaṅkaḷil avvaḷavu cukamāyillai.
iru vātakkārarukkum uḷḷa vivātam eṉṉaveṉṟāl stāyiyil uḷḷa curutikaḷ irupattiraṇṭō, irupattunāṉkō eṉpatum avaikaḷ camapākamuḷḷavaiyō allatu oḻuṅkīṉa iṭaiveḷikaḷālāṉa Natural  skēlaic cērntavaiyō eṉpatumtāṉ.
kiḷameṇṭs turai intiya caṅkītattil upayōkikkappaṭukiṟa skēlkaḷ iyaṟkaiyil amaintuḷḷa Natural  skēlkaḷ eṉṟum cama iṭaiveḷikaḷālāṉa skēl intiya caṅkītattiṟku muṟṟilum anniya meṉṟum apippirāyappaṭukiṟār. āṉāl maṟupaṭcattil rāv cāyap avarkaḷ intiya caṅkīta skēl cama iṭaiveḷikaḷuḷḷateṉṟum, stāyi yil 12 araiccuraṅkaḷ eṉṟum, iṉṉum nuṭpamāṉa 24 mutaliya curaṅkaḷ atil uṇṭeṉṟum collukiṟārkaḷ. ki.pi.3m nūṟṟāṇṭil eḻutappaṭṭa ātittamiḻ nūlākiya icaittamiḻil uḷḷa cila cūttiraṅkaḷaik koṇṭu rāv cāyap avarkaḷ taṉ koḷkaiyaip palamāy stāpikkiṟārkaḷ. itaṉāl maṟṟa iṭaṅkaḷil illāviṭṭālum teṉṉāṭṭil cama iṭai veḷikaḷuḷḷa muṟai upayōkattiliruntatākat terikiṟatu. iru muṟaippaṭi yum irākaṅkaḷ pāṭappaṭuvatai nēril cōtittaṟintāloḻiya entakkaṭci cariyeṉṟu colluvatu kaṣṭam. vivātattaip pārttāl rāv cāyap avarkaḷ colluvatutāṉ atika niccayamāṉa uṇmai. avarkaḷ koḷkai cariyāyirukkum paṭcattil intiya caṅkītattil piriyappaṭṭavarkaḷ cātāraṇa jaṉaṅkaḷum eḷitil kaṟkumpaṭiyāṉa oru muṟaiyai atiliruntu uṇṭākkuvatu veku culapamāyirukkum.
puttakattal collappaṭuvataik kavaṉittāl taṉ koḷkaikkeṉṟu vicēṣamāyc ceyyappaṭṭa curuti ārmōṉiyamāṉatu parōṭā kāṉpa reṉciṉ muṉ kiḷameṇṭs turaiyāl araṅkēṟṟappaṭṭa pōtu intiya rākaṅkaḷaic colvatil muṟṟilum tavaṟippōṉatumallāmal aṅku vantirunta caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷāl kaṇṭaṉam paṇṇappaṭṭatu eṉṟum aṟikiṟōm.
inta parōṭā kāṉpareṉcaippaṟṟiya rippōrṭ iṉṉum piracura mākātatu paritāpam. caṅkītattiṟkuriya viṣayaṅkaḷ cinēka viṣayamāy tarkkikkappaṭāmal kaṭum vivātattiṟkuḷḷāvatu vicaṉikkappaṭattakkatē.
maṟṟavarkaḷ ivviṣayattait tāṅki pūrva nūlkaḷiṉ ātārattai atikamāyp pārāṭṭāmal aṉupava viṣayamāy avaikaḷ caritāṉā eṉṟu parīṣai pārppārkaḷ eṉṟu nampukiṟōm.
intiya caṅkītattil ārāycciceyta viṣayamāka iruvarum pukaḻappaṭa vēṇṭiyavarkaḷ. pūrva nūlkaḷai jākkirataiyāy ārāynta viṣayattilum curutikaḷ viṣayamāy avarkaḷ ceytirukkiṟa cāstira ārāyccikaḷaiyum kavaṉittāl nām rāv cāyap avarkaḷukku vāḻttutal collak kaṭamaip paṭṭirukkiṟōm. His Highness  parōṭā makārājā avarkaḷ cīkkiram intiya caṅkīta ārāyccikkāka iṉṉumoru kāṉpareṉcu kūṭṭuvārka ḷeṉṟu nampukiṟōm. appōtu taṟkāla paḻakkattilirukkum curutikaḷ ivai yeṉṟu oruvita muṭivu ēṟpaṭumāṉāl caṅkītattiṟku oru oḻuṅkāṉa muṟaiyum stāpikkappaṭalām.
āṉāl ippōtu kāriyaṅkaḷ eppaṭi irukkiṟateṉṟāl, piṟkāla intiya caṅkītattai nilai niṟuttavēṇṭiya oru viṣayattaippaṟṟip pōtu māṉa ātāramillātirukka nām irupakkattaip paṟṟiyum ētāvatu oru muṭivu collavēṇṭiya nilaimaiyil irukkiṟōm. kiḷameṇṭs turai colvatu cariyāṉatu eṉṟu nām muṭivu coṉṉāl, oṉṟu, intiya caṅkītam muṟkālattil irunta kuḻappamāṉa nilaimaikkut tirumpum allatu intiya caṅkītam mēṟṟicai caṅkītattālāṉatāyviṭum. āṉāl rāv cāyap avarkaḷ colluvatu cariyeṉṟu oppukkoṇṭāl intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅkum ellā curutikaḷaiyum carivarap pāṭuvatil kaṣṭa mirātu. intiya caṅkītattai muḻuvatum cāstira muṟaiyuṭaṉ yāvarukkum colliyum vaikkalām. teṉṉāṭṭār rāv cāyap avarkaḷ collukiṟa muṟaiyaiyē kaiyāṭi vantirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟu collalām. āṉāl vaṭanāṭṭārō cariyāṉa curuti viṣayattil paramparaiyai aṉucarikkiṟār kaḷēyoḻiya maṟṟappaṭiyalla. iruvarum vevvēṟu kaṭciyai eṭuttuk koṇṭataṟku oru kāraṇameṉṉaveṉṟāl kiḷameṇṭs turai iruppatu vaṭanāṭu. avar karnāṭaka caṅkītattaiyē kēṭṭatillai. rāv cāyap avarkaḷō teṉṉāṭṭilē piṟantu vaḷarntavarkaḷ.

New India, Madras 21st April, 1917.
Few Remarks on Messrs K.B.Deval’s 22 Srutis and E.Clement’s (I.C.S.) 24 and 25 Srutis, by Rao Sahib M.Abraham Pandither.
(The Lawley Electric Printing Press, Tanjore)
This little pamphlet of 16 pages is intended to be a criticism on the views of Messrs. Deval and Clements regarding the number of Srutis used in Indian music. This is a much-discussed point in the theory of Indian music and we do not think that definite conclusion has been come to on it till now. It is very difficult to see how any such conclusion can be arrived at. No system of music denies the fundamental 7 notes and there we have the common basis of all kinds of music. With regard to the different Srutis employed there may and must be differences.
The pamphlet is obviously too technical to be of any use to the lay reader; but one who studies it throughly will find much food for thought. Mr.Pandither takes exception to some of the opinions of Mesrs. Deval and Clements, but we do not feel sure if some of the author’s statements cannot be takne exception to. The author pronounces opinions but does not seem to prove them from the standpoint of those whose views he criticises. There is one observatin which is certainly true and which every musician will acknowledge as such; and that is :- “when the swarams are arranged in equal semi-tones in an octave, the change of gramam would not result in any new swaram. The same applies to the scale with 22 Srutis also. No new swaram can possibly occur in the middle in spite of the change of gramam. The general opinion is that however the Srutis might be changed for a gramam, the total number of Srutis cannot possibly more than 22. Change of gramam is only relative and no intrinsic alteration can take place in the mutual relation between the different Srutis of a scale by such a change.
The tables on pages 4. 14 and 15 are very instructive and throw a flood of light on many of the obscurities in the theory of Indian music. Our author must have taken a good deal of trouble in preparing them, and we congratulate him theoreon.
One observation we would make here. After all there does not seem to be much practical use is discussing the question about the number of Srutis. There is no difference of opinion as far as the r2 primary Srutis are concerned; and as for the intermediate Srutis, each individual musician is automatically using some of them. While experts employ them consciously and make diliberate use of them in the variation of a tune, an ordinary singer unconsciously makes use of some of them. And, again, it may be asked why there should be only 22 or 24 or 25 Srutis; in fact interval between any two consecutive Srutis can be divided into many sub-divisions and the Srutis resulting there from may be used-at lease those of them which produce a pleasing effect on the hearer. A self-consistent system can he developed with any or all of these divisions and different authors in ancient India have evidently followed their own different systems though some of them approach one another to a very great extent.	
										R.S.

Mr. tēvāl avarkaḷuṭaiya 22 curutiyaip paṟṟiyum, Mr.kiḷameṇṭs avarkaḷuṭaiya 24, 25 curutikaḷaip paṟṟiyum makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi rāv cākēp āpirakām paṇṭitar avarkaḷ eḻutiya ciṟu puttakattaip paṟṟiya cila kuṟippukaḷ.
16 pakkaṅkaḷaṭaṅkiya intac ciṟu puttakamāṉatu intiya caṅkītattil vaḻaṅki varum curutikaḷaip paṟṟiya kiḷameṇṭs tēvāl ivarkaḷuṭaiya koḷkaiyaik kaṇṭippataṟkāka eḻutappaṭṭirukkiṟatu. intiya caṅkīta cāstira curuti viṣayamāṉatu palarālum pala apippirāyaṅkaḷ collap peṟṟatāyiruppatāl ituvaraiyilum ataippaṟṟi muṭivāṉa apippirāyam collappaṭavillai. appaṭi muṭivāṉa apippirāyam colluvatum ilēcalla. ellāvita muṟaikaḷum capta curaṅkaḷai oppukkoḷvatāl itaiyē ellā muṟaikaḷukkum potuvāṉa ātāramākak koḷḷalām. āṉāl upayōkikkappaṭum curutikaḷ viṣayattil vittiyācamāṉa apip pirāyaṅkaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉa. appaṭi iruppatuvum avaciyamē.
intac ciṟu puttakamāṉatu cāstira viṣayattaip paṟṟic colluva tāl caṅkītan teriyātavarkaḷ atai aṟivatu kūṭiyakāriyamalla eṉṟu terikiṟatu. āṉāl atai uḷ nuḻaintu paṭittuppārppavarkaḷ yōcikkum paṭiyāṉa anēka kāriyaṅkaḷai atil kāṇpārkaḷ. paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kiḷameṇṭ tēvāl ivarkaḷuṭaiya koḷkaikaḷil cila tappu eṉṟu collukiṟārkaḷ. āṉāl appaṭi avarkaḷ kaṇṭippatu cila viṭaṅkaḷil cariyalla eṉṟu namakkuppaṭukiṟatu. nūlāciriyar kiḷameṇṭs tēvāl avarkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyaṅkaḷaik kaṇṭikkiṟārkaḷ. āṉāl atu viṣayaṅkaḷ tappu eṉṟu rucu oṉṟum collavillai. āṉāl avarkaḷ colluvatil oru apippirāyam muṟṟilum cariyeṉṟu ovvoru caṅkītak kārarum oppukkoḷḷa vēṇṭiyatu. ateṉṉa veṉṟāl, oru stāyi yiluḷḷa curaṅkaḷ cama aḷavuḷḷavaikaḷāy irukkumpōtu kirāmam māṟṟiṉāl putitāy oru curamum uṇṭākātu eṉpatē. inta apippirāya māṉatu 22 curuti muṟaikkum ottu irukkiṟatu. kirakam māṟṟiṉapōtilum naṭuvil putu curam uṇṭākavē muṭiyātu. cātāraṇamāy oppuk koḷḷap paṭṭa apippirāyam eṉṉaveṉṟāl curutikaḷ enta vitamāy kirāmam māṟṟiṉālum oru stāyiyiluḷḷa curutikaḷ 22 kku mēl irātu eṉpatē. kirāmam māṟṟutalāṉatu camayattukkut takuntapaṭi nērum. appaṭi māṟṟuva tiṉāl stāyiyiṉ curaṅkaḷukkuḷḷa tāratammiyam orunāḷum māṟātu.
nālām patiṉālām, patiṉaintām pakkaṅkaḷil koṭuttirukkum aṭṭavaṇaikaḷ atika pirayōjaṉamuḷḷavai. intiya caṅkītattiluḷḷa atika karukalāṉa pākaṅkaḷai avaikaḷ teḷivāy eṭuttuk kāṇpikkiṉṟaṉa. nūlāciriyar ivaikaḷait tayār ceyvatil atika pirayācai yeṭuttirukka vēṇṭiyatu. itaṟkāka avarkaḷukku vāḻttutal collukiṟōm.
nām iṅkē collavēṇṭiya kāriyam oṉṟuṇL. ateṉṉa veṉṟāl curutikaḷiṉ tokaiyettaṉaiyeṉṟu pōr purivatu atika pirayōcaṉattaittarātu. 12 curutikaḷ irukkiṟateṉpataip paṟṟi anēkamāy oṟṟumaiyāṉa apippirāyam irukkiṟatākat terikiṟatu. naṭuvil varum curutikaḷai avaṉavaṉ taṉakkut tōṉṟiyapaṭi oru muṟaiyil kaṭṭup paṭāmal upayōkittu varukiṟāṉ. āṉāl caṅkīta vitvāṉō avai kaḷait terintu upayōkikkiṟāṉ. cātāraṇamāyp pāṭukiṟa oruvaṉ taṉṉaiyaṟiyāmalē avaṟṟil cila curutikaḷai upayōkikkiṟāṉ. mēlum ēṉ 22 allatu 24 allatu 25 curutikaḷ tāṉ oru stāyiyil uṇṭeṉṟu colla vēṇṭum? aṭuttāppōl uḷḷa iraṇṭu curutikaḷukku naṭuvi luḷḷa iṭaiveḷiyai ettaṉaiyō ciṟiya camapākaṅkaḷāka vakuttu avaikaḷil kātukku iṉimaiyāṉavaikaḷai upayōkikkalām. ivaikaḷil etaiyāvatu allatu attaṉaiyaiyum ātāramāka vaittukkoṇṭu takuti yāṉa oru muṟai stāpikkappaṭuvatu kūṭiyatē. pūrva intiyamakkaḷ taṅkaḷ taṅkaḷ muṟaiyaiyē vaḻaṅki vantirukkiṟārkaḷ. āṉāl avaikaḷil cilarukkuḷ oruvitamāṉa oṟṟumaiyiruntatākat terikiṟatu.
To the Editor, New India, Madras.
aiyā,
Mr.tēvāl, Mr.kiḷameṇṭs I.C.S. avarkaḷiṉ curuti muṟaikaḷaip paṟṟi eḻutiya puttakattiṟku R.S. eṉṟu kaiyoppamiṭṭavar eḻutiya apippirāyattil curutiyaip paṟṟi muṟṟilum ovvāta cila kuṟippukaḷaik kavaṉittēṉ. karuṇāmirta cākarattil 346-349 ām pakkaṅkaḷilum maṟṟiṭaṅkaḷilum viparam colliyirukkiṟōm.
‘oru stāyiyiluḷḷa curaṅkaḷ cama aḷavuḷḷavaikaḷāyirukkiṉṟaṉa veṉṟu ovvoru caṅkītakkārarum muṟṟilum cariyeṉṟu oppuk koṇṭāl ataṉāl kirakam māṟṟum poḻutu naṭuvil ciṟu curam uṇṭāka muṭiyātu. avaikaḷuṭaiya tāratammiyam oru nāḷum māṟātu’ eṉṟu colvatu muṟṟilum uṇmaiyē. itaṉāl oru stāyiyil 22 curutiyil kiraka māṟṟuvataṉāl 25 curutikaḷuṇṭākiṟateṉṟu pustakam eḻuti 25 curutiyil ārmōṉiyam ceytu piracuritta Mr.kiḷameṇṭs avarkaḷuṭaiya muṟai muṟṟilum cariyallaveṉṟu collavēṇṭumallavā? itaittāṉ tappeṉṟu rucuppaṭuttiyirukkiṟōm. pala mukamākak kaṇṭittumirukkiṟōm. inta orē kuṟippaikkoṇṭu Mr. kiḷameṇṭs tēvāl avarkaḷuṭaiya apippirāyam yāvum taḷḷappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟu aṟiyalām. itaittāṉē avarum eḻutukiṟār. piṉṉaiyēṉ eṉṉaik kuṟai kūṟa vēṇṭum?
‘curutikaḷiṉ tokai ettaṉai yeṉṟu pōrpurivatu atikap pirayō jaṉattait tarātu eṉṟum ēṉ oru stāyiyil 22, 24, 25 curutikaḷtāṉ uṇṭeṉṟum colla vēṇṭum? ataṉpiṉ iraṇṭu curutikaḷukku naṭuviluḷḷa iṭaiveḷikaḷai ettaṉaiyō ciṟiya cama pākaṅkaḷāka vakuttu avaikaḷai upayōkikkalām eṉṟum avaṟṟai ātāramāka vaittuk koṇṭu takutiyāṉa oru muṟai stāpippatu kūṭiyatē eṉṟum’ eḻutuvatu muṉṉukkup piṉ virōtamāyirukkiṟatu. curutikaḷaip paṟṟiya kaṇakku kaḷaiyum nuṭpa curutikaḷ vaḻaṅki varum kīrttaṉaikaḷiṉ aṭṭavaṇai yaiyum kavaṉittiruppārāṉāl ippaṭi eḻutamāṭṭār.
maṟṟum eṉ muṟaiyaip paṟṟi caṅkīta viṣayamāṉa naṟkuṟippukaḷaip piracurañ ceytataṟkāka naṉṟiyuḷḷavaṉāka irukkiṟēṉ.
tañcai, 1-6-17. 						       K.āpirakām paṇṭitar.
parōṭā āl-intiya miyūcik kāṉpareṉs rippōrṭ.

karnāṭaka caṅkītam
The Christian Patriot, 2nd June 1917
oru stāyiyil ettaṉai curutikaḷ allatu kāl curaṅkaḷ uṇṭu eṉṟa kēḷvitāṉ patil colvataṟku atika kaṭiṉamāṉa kēḷvikaḷil oṉṟu - ataiviṭak kaṭiṉamāṉa kēḷviyē kiṭaiyātu eṉṟu nām collukiṟatillai. itu viṣayamāy iraṇṭu caṅkītakkārarāvatu ēka apippirāyam collukiṟatillai. kāl curaṅkaḷ varappeṟāta airōppiya caṅkītattil oru stāyiyil ēḻu svaraṅkaḷaiyum 12 arai svaraṅ kaḷaiyum stāpittirukkiṟārkaḷ. curaṅkaḷukkiṭaiyiluḷḷa veḷikaḷaic camamākap pirittu avarkaḷ taṅkaḷ maṉatiluḷḷa eṇṇaṅkaḷai maṟṟavar ilēcil kirakikkumpaṭiyāṉa vitamāy noṭṭēṣaṉil eḻuti vaittatu mallāmal piyōṉō mutaliya vāttiyaṅkaḷilum atē vitamāy nilaiyāṉa svaraṅkaḷai ēṟpaṭutti caṅkītam yāvarum eḷitil kaṟṟuk koḷḷumpaṭiyāṉa oḻuṅkukaḷaiyum ceytirukkiṟārkaḷ. āṉāl nām intiya caṅkītattaip paṟṟi ippaṭi oru oḻuṅku irukkiṟatākac colla muṭiyātu. ivvita oḻuṅkai stāpikkumuṉ oru stāyiyil ettaṉai curutikaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉaveṉpatai niccayamāy muṭivāy stāpittāltāṉ intiya caṅkītattai oḻuṅkupaṭuttuvatil ēṟpaṭum kaṣṭaṅkaḷil oṉṟu nivirttiyākum. mutalāvatu curuti viṣayattaip paṟṟi eḻutiṉavar cāraṅkatēvar. ivar 13-vatu nūṟṟāṇṭil anēka narampukaḷ mīṭṭiya vīṇai allatu cōṉamīṟṟar mūlamāy oru stāyiyil 22 ciṟiya iṭaiveḷikaḷ uṇṭeṉṟum, iṭaiveḷikaḷukku curutikaḷ eṉṟu peyareṉṟum eḻutiyirukkiṟār. vaṭa intiyāvil perumpālum vaḻakkattilirukkiṟa intustāṉi caṅkītattiṟku ātāram inta cāraṅkatēvaruṭaiya koḷkai yē. coṟpa varuṣaṅkaḷukkuḷ taṟkālattuḷḷavarkaḷ avaruṭaiya apip pirāyattai cāstira viṣayamāy ārāycci ceytu atiṉ tāratam miyaṅkaḷaik kaṇṭupiṭikkat toṭaṅkiyirukkiṟārkaḷ. avarkaḷukkuḷ Mr.tēvāl Mr.kiḷameṇṭs mutaliyavarkaḷaic collalām. tēvāl eṉpavar kaṇakkukaḷiṉ mūlamāy atai stāpikkap pirayācappaṭṭār. Mr.kiḷameṇṭs eṉpavarum atēvita apippirāyattai stāpikka muyaṉṟatil 22 curutikaḷuḷḷa skēl tāṉ cātāraṇamāyuḷḷatu eṉṟum, āṉāl avaikaḷukkiṭaiyiluḷḷa iṭaiveḷikaḷ caṟṟu peritāyiruppatāl cāraṅkatēvaruṭaiya 22 curutikaḷukkumēl oru stāyiyil 24 allatu 25 curutikaḷ varalāmeṉṟum collukiṟār. āṉāl namakku avaciyamāy vēṇṭiyavaiyellām inta 22 curutikaḷukkuḷ aṭaṅkiṉatu eṉṟu iruvarum apippirāyappaṭṭu ataṟkēṟṟa vitamāy oru curuti ārmōṉiyamum uṇṭu paṇṇiṉārkaḷ. āṉāl itu parōṭāvil naṭanta āl intiyā miyūcik kāṉpareṉcil cariyāṉatallaveṉṟu taḷḷappaṭṭatu.
Mr.āpirakām paṇṭitaravarkaḷ-avarkaḷaiviṭa karnāṭaka caṅkītattil pāṇṭittiyamuḷḷavarkaḷ teṉṉintiyāvil kiṭaippatu aritu-tēvāl kiḷameṇṭs mutaliyavarkaḷ eṭuttukkoṇṭa kakṣi tappu eṉṟu avarkaḷuṭaiya koḷkaikaḷaik kaṇṭikkiṟārkaḷ. Mr.kiḷameṇṭsuṭaiya iraṇṭāvatu kaṭitattiṟkup paṇṭitaravarkaḷ eḻutiṉa maṟuppilum. tēvāluṭaiya 22 curutikaḷaiyum kiḷameṇṭsuṭaiya 24 allatu 25 curutikaḷaiyum kaṇṭittu eḻutiṉatālum ivarkaḷ iruvaruṭaiya koḷkaikaḷum teṉṉintiyāvil orunāḷum nilaipeṟātu eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṇpittirukkiṟārkaḷ. cāraṅkatēvar colluvataṟku mēl iraṇṭu nōṭṭukaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu tēvāl taṉ kaṇakkukaḷil kāṇpippatāl tēvāluṭaiya skēlum cāraṅkatēvaruṭaiya skēlum oṉṟalla eṉṟum cāraṅkatēvaruṭaiya skēlil varum curaṅkaḷaip peṟuvataṟkāka avai kaḷaik koñcam kuṟaittu avar colluvatu kaṇakku viṣayattil utaikkiṟateṉṟum paṇṭitaravarkaḷ rucuppaṭuttiyirukkiṟārkaḷ. kiḷameṇṭs turaiyum cāraṅkatēvaruṭaiya curutikaḷukku mēlāka iraṇṭu mūṉṟu putu curutikaḷaik kātukku iṉimaiyāyirukkiṉṟaṉaveṉṟa kāraṇat tiṟkākap putitāy uṇṭu paṇṇukiṟatiṉāl avarum picakippōyirukkiṟār eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟārkaḷ. ippaṭi ovvoru vitvāṉum taṉ iṣṭap pirakāram curutikaḷai uṇṭupaṇṇalām eṉṟāl tāṉum iraṇṭu mūṉṟu curaṅkaḷ māttiramalla anēkam putu curaṅkaḷai uṇṭupaṇṇak kūṭum eṉṟu paṇṭitaravarkaḷ apippirāyappaṭukiṟārkaḷ. ēṉeṉṟāl cāraṅkatēvaruṭaiya curuti iṭaiveḷikaḷ karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṟku ēṟkāta periya iṭaiveḷi kaḷuḷḷavaiyāy irukkiṉṟaṉa. tokaiyāyc colla vēṇṭumāṉāl Mr.paṇṭitaravarkaḷ kiḷameṇṭs turaikku muṟṟilum virōtamāṉa apippirāyattai ātāramāka vaittu vēlai ceykiṟārkaḷ.
kiḷameṇṭs turaiyuṭaiya ātāra apippirāyam eṉṉaveṉṟāl nāmāy cariyāy vaittuk koṇṭa kaikaḷālāṉa cama iṭaiveḷikaḷuḷḷa araiccuraṅkaḷālāṉa caṅkītam aruvaruppāṉatu. ivvita iṭaiveḷikaḷ vantu nuḻainta kālamutal airōppiya caṅkītam cīr kulaintu varukiṟatu eṉpatutāṉ. mēṟṟicai caṅkītam inta aruvaruppaik kaḷaintu muṉṉōruṭaiya iṉimaiyāṉa cama iṭaiveḷikaḷillāta Natural  skēlukku eppōtu tirumpum eṉṟu āvalōṭu kāttiruppatākavum kiḷameṇṭs collukiṟār. intiya caṅkītam cama iṭaiveḷi kaḷuṭaiyatāy irātatāl tāṉ atu atika iṉimaiyuḷḷatāyirukkiṟatu eṉṟu avar apippirāyappaṭukiṟār. āṉāl etirkkaṭciyilō Mr.paṇṭitaravarkaḷ stāyiyai 24 cama pākaṅkaḷāka vakuttatiṉāl tāṉ karnāṭaka caṅkītam attaṉai aḻakum, cuttamum, ciṟappum, makimaiyum porunti yiruppatākac colliyirukkiṟārkaḷ. taṉakku ātāramāka anēkamāyiram varuṣaṅkaḷukku muṉṉirunta tamiḻ nūlkaḷai mēṟkōḷākac colli appōtu iruntatupōlavē taṟkālattilum karnāṭaka caṅkītam irukkiṟatu eṉkiṟārkaḷ. tamiḻ vitvāṉkaḷ stāyiyai 48, 96 cama pākaṅkaḷākap piritta nuṭpa curaṅkaḷai upayōkikkiṟārkaḷ eṉṟāl karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṉ arumaiyum, iṉimaiyum, vistāramum ātmāvai nirappip paravacap paṭuttattakka nuṭpamum vistāramumuḷḷatu eṉṟu eṭuttuc collavum vēṇṭumā? parōṭāvil kūṭiyirunta pirapala vitvāṉkaḷ Mr.paṇṭitaravar kaḷuṭaiya kalvittiṟamai vāynta kumārattikaḷiṉ caṅkītattaip pukaḻntu koṇṭāṭiṉatu āccariyamalla.
curutikaḷaip paṟṟiya kaṭiṉamāṉa kēḷviyaip paṟṟi atil tērnta pulavarkaḷ caṇṭaipōṭumpaṭi nām viṭṭuviṭṭu paṇṭitaravarkaḷiṉ poṟumaiyuṭaṉ kūṭiya pirayācattaip paṟṟip pēcuvōm. maṟṟavēlait tontaravukaḷiṉ mattiyil poṭṭerittuppōṉa ōlai ēṭukaḷai ārāynta teṉṉintiya caṅkītattaippaṟṟip pūrvat tamiḻ ñāṉikaḷ coṉṉataip paṇṭitaravarkaḷ veḷippaṭuttiyirukkiṟārkaḷ. avarkaḷ ceyta ārāycci yāṉatu avarkaḷuṭaiya caripākamuḷḷa 24 curutimuṟaiyai stāpikkiṟatu. itai ivarkaḷ kaṇakkukaḷiṉ mūlamāy rucuppaṭuttiṉatu mallāmal taṉ kumārattikaḷaik koṇṭu vitvāṉkaḷ āccariyappaṭumpaṭiyāka vīṇai pāṭṭu mutaliyavaṟṟālum rucuppaṭuttiyumirukkiṟārkaḷ. taṟkālam tirāviṭa ruṭaiya kalvi mutaliyavai tirumpa uyirppikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. atu viṣayattil āriyarkaḷ teṉṉintiyāvil piravēcikkum muṉṉatākavē teṉṉintiyar tam conta nākarīkam, kavittiṟamai, caṅkītam, ciṟpavēlai, cittirameḻututal mutaliya kalaikaḷil ciṟantu viḷaṅkiṉārkaḷ eṉṟu ulakattukku veḷiyākkappaṭukiṟatu. intac camayattil ātit tamiḻariṉ mēlāṉa caṅkītat tērcciyai eṭuttu stāpikkumpaṭi oru intiya kiṟista varukkuk koṭuttu vaittatāṉatu mēṉmaiyē. āriyaruṭaiya nākarīka māṉatu maṟṟak kalaikaḷaic cūḻntu koṇṭatupōlavē caṅkīta vittaiyum āriya uṭaiyait tarittuk koṇṭatil anta cāstirattil upayōkap paṭum vārttaikaḷ anēkam māṟiṉa pōtilum, tamiḻc caṅkītattiṉ mukkiya amcam allatu uyir appaṭiyē māṟāmal iruntu camaskiruta caṅkītattaiviṭa mēleḻumpi uyarntu caṅkītattil piriyaṅkoṇṭa āyira māyiram āṉmākkaḷai cantōṣappaṭuttikkoṇṭu varukiṟatu. karnāṭaka caṅkītattaippaṟṟi oḻuṅkuṭaṉ colli vistarikkum paṇṭitaravarkaḷuṭaiya karuṇāmirta cākaram eṉṉum nūl eppōtu veḷiyākumeṉṟu āvaluṭaṉ etirpārkkiṟōm. itaṟkiṭaiyil karnāṭaka caṅkītattiṟkeṉṟu avvaḷavu cilākkiyamāṉa nūlai eḻutiya paṇṭitaravarkaḷukku vāḻttutal collukiṟōm. taṅkaḷ takappaṉāruṭaiya muṟaiyai rucuppaṭuttuvatil tamatu mēlāṉa tiṟamaiyaik kāṇpitta avarkaḷ kumārattikaḷukkum vāḻttutal collukiṟōm.
S.I.
(True Translation)
muṭivurai
kaṭavuḷ kirupaiyāl ipputtakattiṉ muṭivaikkāṇap peṟṟōm. itait toṭarntu kavaṉittu vanta aṉparkaḷē! pūrvattamiḻ makkaḷ, tām vaḻaṅki vanta icait tamiḻākiya caṅkītattil mikat tērntavarkaḷā yiruntārkaḷeṉṟum, curuti viṣayamāy mika mēlāṉa patattaic colli yirukkiṟārkaḷeṉṟum, avaikaḷē taṟkālam vaḻakkattilirukkiṉṟaṉa veṉṟum iṉi varuṅkālattilum nilaittirukkak kūṭiyavaiyeṉṟum meyppippatu pōtum eṉpataṟku utaviyāka, pūrva tamiḻ nāṭṭaip paṟṟiyum, tamiḻ moḻiyaippaṟṟiyum tamiḻ icaiyaippaṟṟiyum, muttamiḻaiyum vaḷarttu vanta pāṇṭiya aracarkaḷaip paṟṟiyum, muccaṅkaṅkaḷaippaṟṟiyum, icaiyil tērnta pulavarkaḷaip paṟṟiyum, cila colla vēṇṭiyatu avaciya māyiṟṟu.
atōṭu curuti viṣayamāyp palar apippirāyaṅkaḷaiyum, caṅkīta ratṉākarar, pārijātakkārar mutaliyavarkaḷiṉ apippirāyaṅkaḷaiyum, kaṇita mūlamāy viḷakkik kāṭṭi, avaikaḷ taṟkāla kāṉattiṟkup porutta muḷḷavaiyalla eṉṟu collit, tamiḻ nāṭṭil pūrvantoṭṭu vaḻaṅki vanta nālu pālaikaḷaiyum, nālvakai yāḻkaḷaiyum, avaṟṟil vaḻaṅki varum navvālu jātikaḷaiyum, patiṉāṟu jātippaṇkaḷaiyum eṭuttukkāṭṭi, ca-pa muṟaiyāy oru stāyiyil amaiyum paṉṉiraṇṭu curaṅkaḷukkum, vaṭṭappālaiyil vaḻaṅki varum 24 curutikaḷukkum, ataṉ mēl tirikōṇap pālai, caturappālaikaḷil vaḻaṅki varum 48, 96 āṉa curutikaḷukkum, lākarita muṟaippaṭi ceṇṭs kaṇakkum, vaiparēṣaṉ kaṇakkum, oru stāyiyil curam, curutikaḷ amaiyum aḷavu kaṇakkum, avvaḷavil kiṭaikkum ōcai yiṉpaṭi taṟkāla aṉupōkattil vaḻaṅkivarum kīrttaṉaikaḷukku nālu aṭṭavaṇaiyum, koṭukka vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu.
atōṭu 1916 varuṣam mārccu mātam 20-ām tēti, his haiṉas keykvār makā rājā avarkaḷ kūṭṭi vaitta āl intiya miyūcik kāṉpa reṉsil araṅkēṟṟi, yāvarālum oppuk koḷḷappaṭṭa viṣayattaip paṟṟiya kaṭitappōkku varattum, āṣēpaṉaikaḷum, avaikaḷukku maṟuppum, ittuṭaṉ cērkkavēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu. rippōrṭṭu iṉṉum varavillai.
1916 varuṣam ākasṭu mātam 19m tēti kūṭiya tañcai caṅkīta vityā makā jaṉa caṅkattil pañcāyattār muṉṉilaiyil naṭanta viṣayaṅkaḷum, pañcāyattār tīrmāṉamum, iccaṅkattiṟku talaimai vakitta parōṭā, tivāṉ cākip makā-rāca-rāca-ciṟi V.P. mātavarāv C.I.E.avarkaḷiṉ muṭivāṉa apippirāyaṅkaḷum, cērkkappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa.
curutiyaip paṟṟic colli vanta pala kaṉavāṉkaḷum, nūlāciriyar kaḷum tamakkut tōṉṟiyapaṭi colliyiruppatāl, avarkaḷ matattaik kaṇṭittu, pūrva tamiḻ makkaḷ vaḻaṅki vanta icait tamiḻiṉ ilakkaṇamē mikac ciṟantateṉṟu meyppikka vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu. curutikaḷaip paṟṟi iṉi orukkālum cantēkam uṇṭākātirukkavum, avaikaḷait tiṭṭamāyaṟintu koḷvataṟkum, ituvē pōtumeṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ. taṟkālam caṅkītaṅ kaṟṟukkoḷvōrukku evai avaciyameṉṟu tōṉṟiṟṟō, avaikaḷai maṭṭum iṅku eḻutiṉēṉ. aṟiviṟ ciṟanta periyōr, itil kāṇappaṭum kuṟṟaṅkaḷai maṉṉittu, kuṇamāṉavaikaḷai virutti ceyya vēṇṭu meṉṟu mikavum vaṇakkamāyk kēṭṭuk koḷḷukiṟēṉ.
iraṇṭām puttakam.
ciṟantateṉṟu yāvarālum koṇṭāṭappaṭum teṉṉintiyāvil vaḻaṅkivarum irākaṅkaḷaip paṟṟi, mutaṟputtakamāka eḻutip piracurikka niṉaitta nāṉ, tañcai caṅkīta vityā makā jaṉa caṅkattil curutikaḷaip paṟṟi uṇṭāṉa vātattai muṉṉiṭṭu, avaikaḷ caṅkītattiṟku mukkiya māṉavai eṉṟum palarāl pala cantēkam ēṟkak kūṭiyavai eṉṟum, aṟintu teṉṉintiya caṅkītattiṉ curutikaḷaip paṟṟi mutal puttamāka eḻuta vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu.
iṉivarum iraṇṭām puttakattil, irākaṅkaḷum, oru ārōkaṇa avarōkaṇattil kītam uṇṭākkum muṟaiyum, avaṟṟiṉ jīva curam kaṇṭu piṭikkum vaḻiyum, irāka cañcāram ceyyum vitamum collappaṭum. itu putitāka oru irākam uṇṭākkuvataṟku utavuvatu māttiramallāmal, paḻamaiyāyp pāṭivarum irākaṅkaḷil piḻaikaḷait tiruttik koḷḷavum utaviyāka irukkum. curañāṉam vantavarkaḷukku innūl mika arumai yāṉatu. ulakiṟku cūriyaṉ, cantiraṉum antakaṟku kaṇṇum pōla caṅkīta vitvāṉkaḷukku iṉpan tarattakkatu. accil irukkiṟatu. viraivil veḷi varum. eḻuvakait tōṟṟamāy, avaiyāvaṟṟiṉ uyirāy, uyiril uṇar vāy, uṇarvil aṟivāy, aṟivil āṉantamāy, āṉantattil kītamāy, kītattil ilayamāy āṉanta niruttamiṭum ellām valla perumāṉiṉ tiruvaruḷai vēṇṭukiṟōm.
tañcāvūr 							        K.āpirakām paṇṭitar.
1-6-1917.
mutaṟ puttakam muṟṟiṟṟu.
